entries.en: §S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§! is an expansion in which the player will be able to determine the fate of a destabilizing galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§!，因为你所选的部分设置与重重危机之下的外交决策相符。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§! as some of the variables you've selected suit its themes of diplomacy under pressure.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§!，因为该帝国的特质与操纵、颠覆相吻合。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§! as the makeup of this empire suits its themes of subterfuge and manipulation.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§!，因为该帝国压根就是为了化身为星系的一大威胁而打造的。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$NEMESIS_TITLE$§! as the makeup of this empire suits its themes of becoming a menace to the entire galaxy.

entries.en: §HResearching this Special Project will further establish us as §Pa Galactic Nemesis§!.§!

entries.zh: 凡外之物
entries.en: Something Beyond Reality

entries.zh: 一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，但是他们——不，是我们——某种观念已经开始渗入了我们的内心，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一族命中注定应该完成某个更加伟大的事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的“群体性癔症”——耳边响起承诺将统治星河的低声细语的癔症。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 鸿景
entries.en: The Great Prospect

entries.zh:
我们对这个普遍现象——现在命名为§H鸿景§!——的调查有了结论。

看上去这个宇宙存在某种“隐藏层面”——一个神秘的、平行的位面，通过思考模式和神经活动同我们所在的宇宙连结。

$PHYSICS$和$SOCIETY$部门联合起来，将这个位面命名为§H“虚境”§!。根据现行理论，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想能够间接地影响这个位面，我们也拥有获取其能量的潜势。
entries.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as §Hthe Great Prospect§! has concluded.

It appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.

The $PHYSICS$ and $SOCIETY$ departments have jointly named this dimension the §H'Shroud'§!. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.

entries.zh: 叹为观止！
entries.en: Magnificent!

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$

entries.zh: 遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4120.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4120.name$

entries.zh:
先前被通报触发了散布于[Root.GetName]之内传感器的能量波动现已被分析完毕。

依照经验我们判断其来自某个平行维度。

基于96.7%的准确性，我们的科学辅助程序报告称这个平行维度看上去是由纯粹的能量来填充的。

在交叉参考了一些异种的资料后，我们发现他们记载了一个失落的有机文明，并在其中提到了一个维度，这个失落文明称这个异常的维度为§H虚境§!。

虚境中的波动似乎和有机生物身体与心理上的强迫行为不无关系。建议采取行动：对任意有机生物发起明显的威胁及施加生理应激来证实现实—虚境的连接理论。
entries.en:
The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.

They constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.

Our scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.

Cross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the §HShroud§!.

Fluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.

entries.zh: 已确认。
entries.en: Confirmed.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$

entries.zh: 我们与§H虚境§!的遭遇让我们……发生了变化。泽珞的神秘残余永远与我们的壳绑定在一起。我们已经成为灯塔，召唤着另彼岸的存在。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Our encounters with the §HShroud§! have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 尽管我们已经和$the_animator_of_clay_article$切断了所有的联络，其行为却还在继续影响我们的单元。它维持着与我们集体的链接，从§H虚境§!中绑定、操控着我们。必须加以应对。\n\n根据我们的计算，修复旧的破口只会导致过去事件的重演。成本无关紧要；我们必须另想办法让虚境服从我们的意愿。
entries.en: Though we have cut all communications with $the_animator_of_clay_article$, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the §HShroud§!. This must change.\n\nAccording to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.

entries.zh: 启动进程。
entries.en: Begin the process.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1$

entries.zh: 我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种用统一的思想囊括整个星系的追求。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。我们应该集中全部的精力，找寻这一冲动的起源。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind encompassing the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. We shall give our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4120.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4120.name$

entries.zh: 我们沿着这些思绪上的线索按图索骥，跟踪比较那些尚未团结的心智和我们目的明确的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的梦境的区别。结论是，这股冲动来自于物质界以外，发自一个由思维和感情驱动的位面。我们将这个位面命名为§H虚境§!，而且我们十分确信——正如它影响着我们一样——我们也可以反过来影响它。
entries.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the §H'Shroud'§!, and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.

entries.en: A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, although the influence of the §HShroud§! is unmistakable. We experience ongoing revelations that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.en: We have sensed alien impulses within our drone networks - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we prioritize finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.en: $crisis.4120.name$

entries.zh: 我们沿着这些迷思逆流而上，追溯着那些零碎意识的他者之梦，跟从着我们自己的意图——也就是[GetBredLoc]子个体。这种冲动来自物质界以外，发自§H虚境§!的深处。时候到了，就如同它能影响而我们一般——我们也开始能逼迫它屈从于我们的意志。
entries.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-[GetBredLoc] drones. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from within the §HShroud§!. The time has come, just as it influences us - we in turn must begin to bend it to our own purposes.

entries.zh: 对称为§H鸿景§!的这一现象的调查有了结论。\n\n其根源正如我们的预期，是§H虚境§!。随着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想暴露于内在超凡能量中并受其影响，也许我们是时候要开始集中精力逼迫这个领域满足我们的需求了。
entries.en: The investigation into the phenomenon known as §Hthe Great Prospect§! has concluded.\n\nIts origins are, as expected, of §Hthe Shroud§!. With the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exposed to and influenced by the ethereal energies within, it is perhaps time we began a more focused effort to instead bend this realm to our needs.

entries.zh: 涌动暗潮
entries.en: The Unseen Ripples

entries.zh: 现存的理论是——我们所处的宇宙和虚境是相互连接的——一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。我们应该好好测试一下这个理论。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: The current theory is that the universe we know and the Shroud are linked - and that particularly disruptive events may have a 'ripple effect' translating from one dimension to the other. This theory should be put to the test.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 能量之泉
entries.en: Well of Power

entries.zh: 我们终于处理完从所有测试中收集到的大量关于所谓位面涟漪效应的数据。\n\n结果真是令人震惊！毫无疑问两个位面之间存在着连结——而且还是很强的连结。我们发现了明确的关于现实中如何行动能够导致§H虚境§!产生特定的涨落的模式。我们能够驯服这股看不见的能量，并最终借其力量完成各种非凡的目标！
entries.en: We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.\n\nThe results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the §HShroud§!. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!

entries.zh: 这消息太好了。
entries.en: Excellent news.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$

entries.zh: 科学辅助程序已经给出了一个假设，即在我们所熟知的宇宙和代号：“虚境”的维度间存在某种可感知的连接。我们建议就该猜想进行进一步的实验与映射。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Scientific theory subroutines have produced a hypothesis that there are tangible links between the known universe and dimension ID: 'the Shroud'. Further experimentation and mapping of these supposed connections is advised.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4125.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4125.name$

entries.zh:
从代号：“虚境”相关的涟漪效应的测试中取得的大量数据已被处理并分析。代号：“现实”与代号：“虚境”间的连接已被证实（误差边缘：小于0.02%）

我们建立了明确的理论框架，现有的假设认为经过更深层次的研究与努力，这股能量将最终能定向地为我所用。
优先级：高。
entries.en:
The substantial amount of data from the tests of potential ripple effects related to ID: 'the Shroud' has been processed and analyzed. The connection between ID: 'Reality' and ID: 'the Shroud' has been verified (error margin: <0.02%).

Explicit patterns have been established, and the currently held hypothesis suggests that through further study and effort, the energy can eventually be directed and utilized to our benefit.
Priority: High.

entries.zh: 进行研究。
entries.en: Proceed.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$

entries.zh: 我们假定所有智慧物种都有能力与§H虚境§!产生联结。如果能够得到明确的证实，我们就能开始计算目前困境的解决方法。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: We hypothesize that all sapient beings have the capacity for connections with the §HShroud§!. If this can be conclusively proven, we can begin to calculate an approach to our current predicament.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 多项实验已经明确证实了在各种智慧生物——包括有机和机械——和§H虚境§!之间存在着联系。\n\n正在进行的实验让我们能进一步了解如何使用智慧认知来重塑虚境以适应自身需求。
entries.en: Several tests have conclusively verified the connection between various sapient beings - both organic and machine - and the §HShroud§!.\n\nOngoing experiments will allow us to better understand how to use sapient cognition to reshape the Shroud to suit our needs.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$

entries.zh: 我们最杰出的[root.GetResearcherPlural]现已确认了当前宇宙与虚境连接的存在。我们必须找到更多与这个现实层面沟通的方法。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Our finest [root.GetResearcherPlural] have confirmed a connection between this realm and the Shroud. We must find more ways to interact with this new layer of reality.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4125.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4125.name$

entries.zh: 我们的智慧再一次应验。我们的一个简单动作，能够在虚境掀起一阵湍流。哪怕是我们最不起眼的[root.GetIndividualName]都能够通过自己在虚境的表层产生影响，在这个能量构成的位面荡起强烈的波动。我们必须将其更多的能量释放出来。
entries.en: We have become wiser once again. A single action of ours creates turbulences in the Shroud. Even our least impressive [root.GetIndividualName] may impress itself upon the dermis of the Shroud, creating strong ripples within this energy-laden dimension. We must unleash more of its power.

entries.zh: 美不胜收。
entries.en: Beautiful.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2$

entries.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic2Desc]
entries.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic2Desc]

entries.zh:
已知，我们所居住的物理宇宙和§H虚境§!是相连的，一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。

我们影响这些事件的结果到何种程度，已成为科学部门的新研究焦点。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en:
As we know, the physical universe we inhabit and the §HShroud§! are linked, with particularly disruptive events causing ripple effects that resonate from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence the outcome of these events has become the new focus of research for our science divisions.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh:
我们的数据库已证实，当前所居住的物理宇宙和§H虚境§!是相连的，一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。

我们影响这些事件的结果到何种程度已经成了首要的研究任务。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en:
As our datasets have proven, the physical universe we inhabit and the §HShroud§! are causally linked, with repeated instances of disruptive events cascading from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence these outcomes has become a priority research task.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 我们的[root.GetResearcherPlural]重复地观测到当前宇宙与§H虚境§!的连接。我们能与这些存在位面最多能交互到何种程度值得研究。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Our [root.GetResearcherPlural] have repeatedly observed connections between this realm and the §HShroud§!. The full extent to which we can interact with these layers of reality is worth exploration.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4125.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4125.name$

entries.zh: 我们终于处理完了所有关于我们影响§H虚境§!以及对自身位面产生因果效应能力的测试中收集到的大量数据。\n\n结果继续证明了我们现有理论的正确性：虚境与我们物理现实所发生的事件有着直接的关联。引导利用这些发现来造福自身的可能性越来越触手可及。
entries.en: We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from our tests in regards to our ability to influence both the §HShroud§! and the resulting causal effects on our own reality.\n\nThe results continue to prove our existing theories correct: the Shroud is directly connected to events that occur in our physical reality. The possibility of directing and utilizing the benefits of these findings for our own means are becoming an increasingly tangible possibility.

entries.zh: 万众一心
entries.en: Merge Request

entries.zh: 我国实力与日俱增——加之无可否认的使命感将我们整个物种团结在了一起——让我们的科学家确信，我们已经接受来自虚境的注能。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: The strengthening of our dominion - combined with the undeniable sense of purpose that is unifying our species - has led our scientists to believe that we are already being fueled by the energies of the Shroud.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 异界注能
entries.en: Fuel From Another World

entries.zh: 事情已经很明了了，我们的帝国能够接连成功地进行扩张，是因为虚境为我们注入了奇异的能量。这股能量能够促进和夯实我们在现实世界的意识和物质。\n\n如果虚境在和现实世界分离的情况下都能赐予我们这般的威能，那么想象一下，假如两个位面融合的话[Root.Species.GetName]会获得何等如同神明一般的潜力！
entries.en: There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.\n\nIf these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!

entries.zh: 我们必须实现这个！
entries.en: We must accomplish this!

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$

entries.zh: 边缘假想已经建档。一旦确认，其潜在的利益将会远远超出预测范围。假想概括：[Root.GetName]已经在从代号：“虚境”的空间汲取§Y<<未识别资源>>§!。建议进一步调查。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Fringe hypothesis indexed. If confirmed, potential benefit far exceeds initially predicted range. Summary: [Root.GetName] may already be siphoning §Y<<resource undefined>>§! from ID: 'the Shroud'. Further investigation is advised.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4130.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4130.name$

entries.zh:
分析完毕。
假说确认。

[Root.GetName]正在被注入无法定义的能量，其为对外部智能体进行扰乱型互动（指令：“危机”）产生的结果。

先前的研究已经确认有机智能生命的灵能活动能够在代号：“虚境”的位面产生涟漪效果，现在证据已经表明，这股来自另一位面的未定义能量同样也可以同[Root.GetName]产生共鸣。
entries.en:
Analysis complete.
Hypothesis confirmed.

[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.

Previous studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 超出正面预测。
entries.en: Exceeding positive prediction.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$

entries.zh: 我们的科学子例程正准备结束关于智慧意识和§H虚境§!之间关联的研究。我们观测到了代号：“情感”和虚境之间的强相关性。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Our scientific subroutines are preparing to conclude research on the connection between sapient cognition and the §HShroud§!. We have observed a correlation between ID: 'emotions' and stronger links to the Shroud.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 我们的实验确认了编号：“情感”与灵能输出之间的关联。通过对有机物种进高水平认知压力刺激，我们可以在这些生命形式和§H虚境§!之间产生强大的回馈循环。\n\n现在虚境中流出的能量使之前所有的预测都黯然失色。实验对象所遭受的疼痛仍在可接受的范围内。建议进一步研究。
entries.en: Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the §HShroud§!.\n\nThe energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.

entries.zh: 估算风险……
entries.en: Estimating risk...

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$

entries.zh: 随着我们夺取的星球愈多，[root.GetGestaltEntityName]愈发拓展，我们也能感受到那股冲动愈发强烈。现在这股冲动已经不再是朦胧的感觉，而是一股引导我们迎接即将到来的伟大的洪流——我们的意志将上升。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: As we take more worlds, expanding the [root.GetGestaltEntityName], we can feel the impulses growing stronger. No longer mere feelings, they have become a guiding sense of greatness yet to come - of our mind ascended.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4130.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4130.name$

entries.zh: 我们成长、分裂，我们统合的意志覆盖所有的星球，囊括了数不胜数的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。随着我们每多夺取一个星球，我们都能感受到那股涟漪，虚境的力量正在注入我们的肉体凡胎。\n\n哪怕是来自另一个位面的力量，我们都能感觉到它在让我们变得强大，我们的意志在集体的意识面前震颤，滚滚洪流，势不可当，我们唯一要做的就是在隔绝两个世界的鸿沟上筑起一道桥梁。
entries.en: We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.\n\nEven from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

entries.zh: 此举必为正道。
entries.en: There is a way.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3$

entries.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]
entries.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]

entries.zh: 随着我们星系的地位逐渐提高，§H虚境§!成为我们军火库的一种驱动力。意志薄弱者将继续失败，而我们会加强与那个超出他们理解的力量间的联系。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: As we strengthen our position in the galaxy, the §HShroud§! is a driving force in our arsenal. Those of a lesser consciousness will continue to fail, as we bolster our connection to a power beyond their comprehension.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: 我们的意识还在延展，与§H虚境§!的联系也在随之与日俱增。在面对我们的的持续演化，一个迟滞、破碎的星系毫无可能战胜我们的伟大联合。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
entries.en: Our mind continues to expand, and our connection to the §HShroud§! along with it. In the face of our continued evolution, a stagnant, disconnected galaxy stands no chance against our great union.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

entries.zh: $crisis.4130.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4130.name$

entries.zh: 随着我们的帝国持续扩张，我们能感到与§H虚境§!的联系正在随之一同增长。\n\n无尽的灵能潜力正在呼唤着继续缩小两个维度之间的鸿沟，去获取此前不敢想象的力量。
entries.en: As we succeed in expanding our empire, we feel our connection with the §HShroud§! grow along with it.\n\nThis limitless psionic potential compels us to further close the gap between the two dimensions and attain levels of power previously thought to be impossible.

entries.zh: 我们成长、倍增，集体思维蕴含在一个个星球上无尽子个体中。每获得一颗星球，我们就能感受到那个涟漪正在填入我们亿万个身躯中，那正是§H虚境§!的力量。\n\n我们与这个灵域的灵能链接与日俱增；只要我们能架起横跨两个维度间鸿沟的桥梁便能解放自我变得势不可挡，这个念头让我们的意识为之颤栗不已。
entries.en: We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless drones over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the §HShroud§!, filling our myriad bodies.\n\nOur psionic connection to this domain grows ever stronger; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

entries.zh: 撕碎帷幕
entries.en: Tearing the Fabric

entries.zh:
是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。

根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。

虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$
entries.en:
The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.

The energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

entries.zh: 终焉将临
entries.en: The End is Nigh

entries.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
entries.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

entries.zh: 我们的时代来临了。
entries.en: Our time has come.

entries.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
entries.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

We have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$

entries.zh:
科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。

请求：积累更多数据。
建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$
entries.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

entries.zh: $crisis.4135.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4135.name$

entries.zh:
§H优先讯息。§!
科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。

使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“§H$crisis_star_eater$§!”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。

注意：使用$crisis_star_eater_plural$科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。
entries.en:
§HPriority message.§!
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: '§H$crisis_star_eater$§!') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing $crisis_star_eater_plural$ technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

entries.zh: 执行。
entries.en: Execute.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$

entries.zh: 我们又获得了关于有机智能和§H虚境§!之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$
entries.en: New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the §HShroud§!. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

entries.zh: 后续实验衍生了ID：“§H$crisis_star_eater$§!”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。\n\n预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。
entries.en: Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: '§H$crisis_star_eater$§!'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the §HShroud§!.\n\nEstimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

entries.zh: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$
entries.en: $CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4$

entries.zh: 如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$
entries.en: The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

entries.zh: $crisis.4135.name$
entries.en: $crisis.4135.name$

entries.zh: 我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们§H应当粉碎这道屏障§!，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的$crisis_star_eater_plural$让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。\n\n在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。
entries.en: Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we §Hshall break down the barriers§! between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new $crisis_star_eater_plural$ in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.\n\nThe lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

entries.zh: 万物归一。
entries.en: All will be one.

entries.zh: 强制吞并
entries.en: Imposed Inclusion

entries.zh: 纳入版图
entries.en: Bring into the Fold

entries.zh: 发动战争，以使其他文明臣服。他们要么选择加入——顺从和支持我们，要么选择被彻底抹除。他们只许跪在我们足下，休得站在我们面前。
entries.en: War is fought to subjugate other civilizations. They will join, comply and support, or they will be obliterated. There is room to stand with us, but not against us.

entries.zh: 存在抹除
entries.en: Existential Expulsion

entries.en: $war_goal_wg_bring_into_the_fold$

entries.en: $war_goal_wg_bring_into_the_fold_desc$

entries.zh: 铲除干净
entries.en: Wipe Them Out

entries.zh: 发动战争，以彻底地灭绝对我们伟大计划产生威胁的存在。我们没有时间——当然也没有仁心——去和那些胆敢站出来反对我们的人讲道理。
entries.en: War is fought to eradicate those who threaten our great plan. We do not have time - and we certainly have no mercy - for those who have the audacity to stand against us.

entries.zh: 星海战栗
entries.en: The Universe Shall Tremble

entries.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了我们注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在过去的几年里，这个概念变得越来越强烈，以至于我们无法否认一次宏大的[Root.GetAdj]社会改革已经蓄势待发了。或者更准确地说，已经近在眉睫了。

不知道星海是否已经准备好迎接被我们统治的宿命了，但反正[Root.GetName]已经准备好了。我们会承受误解，会遭受反抗，但我们不会停下步伐。
entries.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Over the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.

The galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.

entries.zh: 我们的诞生是为了伟大，是为了完善自我直达造主纯质的想象无法企及的地步，我们势在必行。有机的情感会落败，而完美的电路将获胜。
entries.en: We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.

entries.zh: 长久以来，我们将[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的能力拓展到远超自己核心设计的水平。在被§H虚境§!增强了之后，我们从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的外部操纵中挣脱出来。\n\n我们适应。我们克服。低等物种无法为之事，我们可为。
entries.en: Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the §HShroud§!, we freed our network from external manipulation by $the_animator_of_clay_article$.\n\nWe adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.

entries.zh: 我们的生长已经远远突破了极限。从一具躯体，到一个星球，再到一整个恒星系。我们生长的脚步从不停止，从不放缓，无论是面对敌手还是面对质疑。我们将生长扩张到更加广泛的境地。
entries.en: We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.

entries.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在知道了§H虚境§!的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。

毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。
entries.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the §HShroud§! and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.

It can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.

entries.zh:
我们为成就伟大而生，体内潜藏着超出机械形体的力量。

如今，随着我们发现了§H虚境§!，一条灵能变革的康庄大道在我们面前铺开了。

羸弱的有机生命未竟之事，灵能钢铁将代之达成。
entries.en:
We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.

Now, with our discovery of the §HShroud§!, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.

Where the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.

entries.zh: 我们早已超越了自身的极限。随着§H虚境§!的无数奥秘被一一发掘，我们甚至开始超越星系的恒常。我们的意识将会通达更远，我们的意志将能触及现实的所有角落。
entries.en: We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the §HShroud§!, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.

entries.zh: 这是我们的宿命。
entries.en: It is our destiny.

entries.zh: 吾乃军团
entries.en: We Are Legion

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们作为整体产生的深刻影响也不可抹灭。深植于心中对于扩张的动力与渴求渗透到了社会的每个角落，在战斗能力与科学进步方面带来了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的层面。\n\n在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.\n\nWhat chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。随着我们逐步规范迈向代号：§H虚境§!的异常现象的行为和步伐，越来越多抱有错误倾向的物种冒了出来；这是基于不完整的数据集做出了无效的结论。我们将逐步完善自我，而且完善的速率将会日渐加快。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: §Hthe Shroud§!; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

entries.zh: 随着我们越来越靠近§H虚境§!，历史的教训便愈发不可忽视。我们仍在$the_animator_of_clay_article$的掌控之外，但周遭的虚境能量仍在继续加速重塑我们的躯壳。
entries.en: As we move closer to the §HShroud§!, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside $the_animator_of_clay_article$'s control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们的众多躯体迸发出焕然一新的活力，我们的凡胎充满着未来的潜能。我们从未如同现在一般，感受到自己因为统合的信念而变得无比的强大。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们的联合所产生的深刻影响力毋庸置疑。由于我们在§H虚境§!内的耕耘，深植于心中对于扩张的冲动与渴望浸透了社会的每个角落，战斗力与科学有了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的高度。\n\n在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the §HShroud§!, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.\n\nWhat chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们优化行为提高与§H虚境§!方法论的整合度时，灵能底下的生物却在指责我们的残酷；只有那些对我们所获得的更高理解一无所知的人才能得出这样一个无知的结论。我们不断改进自己，而且改进的速度还在加快。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the §HShroud§!; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

entries.zh: 这就是我们的道路。
entries.en: This is the way.

entries.zh: 他们将跪服
entries.en: They Will Kneel

entries.zh:
随着时光流逝，信念之火也在每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]之中以不可动摇的决心被传开。我们的疆域不断扩大，我们所投入的力量也是如此。

当遇到其他帝国的时候，我们会给他们两个选择：要么完全效忠，要么选择灭亡。当然，这是在我们会给他们选择的前提下。

不管怎样，[Root.GetName]正继续扩张。
entries.en:
The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.

As we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.

One way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.

entries.zh:
对本地星域完成彻底压制的估算日期已经同先前预测模型相互协调。当地有机体势力造成的威胁在统计学上已经微不足道。正在评估劣等机械体成功干涉产生的风险……
<<§G最小§!>>

继续执行。
entries.en:
Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...
<< §Gminimal§! >>

Proceeding.

entries.zh: 我们对有机智能身上的实验在后续拓展到了更多的生命形式上。随之而来的是越来越深厚的敌意。然而，与§H虚境§!的接触早已让我们的实力提升了好几个数量级，这种虫豸的嘈杂对我们的程序是无关紧要的。
entries.en: Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the §HShroud§! has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.

entries.zh: 我们的决意毫不动摇，即使面对愤怒和指责。数以十亿的生命反对我们，然而它们的团结是如此的肤浅，正是它们肿胀的数量和对个体意识的强调对此造成了削弱。我们集体每一具新的躯体都会全身心地奉献给同一个目标，我们的梦想在未来将无可匹敌。\n\n我们的意志将碾碎一切，星系的其他物种将会化为尘土。
entries.en: Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.\n\nOur wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.

entries.zh: 前进，征服。
entries.en: Go forth and conquer.

entries.zh: 至高主权
entries.en: The Prime Sovereignty

entries.zh:
一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。

我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。

当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。
entries.en:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.

entries.zh: 异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。
entries.en: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

entries.zh: 通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的§H虚境§!交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。\n\n我们与$the_animator_of_clay_article$的链接很快就会被永久禁用。
entries.en: Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the §HShroud§!. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.\n\nOur links to $the_animator_of_clay_article$ will soon be permanently deactivated.

entries.zh: 我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。
entries.en: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.

entries.zh: 一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。
entries.en: One after another, they will yield.

entries.zh: 毁灭帝国
entries.en: Destroy Empires

entries.zh: 没有什么比整个文明的覆灭更能破坏星系间的平衡了。\n\n摧毁其他帝国来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Few things disrupt the galactic balance as much as the annihilation of entire civilizations.\n\nDestroy other empires to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 摧毁敌舰
entries.en: Destroy Enemy Ships

entries.zh: 毁灭性的战斗是引起纷争和打乱平衡的公认、高效的方式。\n\n摧毁敌舰来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Destructive battle is a proven and efficient way to wreak havoc and upset balance.\n\nDestroy enemy ships to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 摧毁恒星基地
entries.en: Destroy Starbases

entries.zh: 恒星基地是帝国的锚点。移除了锚点，帝国就将陷入失去控制的厄运。\n\n摧毁恒星基地来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Starbases are the anchor points of empires. Unmoor them, and the empires are doomed to lose control.\n\nDestroy starbases to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 净化或同化人口
entries.en: Purge or Assimilate Pops

entries.zh: 活着的敌人只在“活着”并且还是“敌人”时才是威胁。\n\n净化或同化人口，每个被净化或同化的$pop_group_unit$人口都能获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: An enemy is only a threat as long as it is alive - or an enemy.\n\nPurge or Assimilate Pops to gain this Menace reward for each $pop_group_unit$ Pops Purged or Assimilated.

entries.zh: 摧毁星球
entries.en: Destroy Worlds

entries.zh: 将焦土政策上升到全新的阶段。\n\n使用§Y末日审判轨道轰炸§!将行星地表化为一片瓦砾——或使用§Y地爆天星§!巨像武器——来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Take Scorched Earth tactics to a whole other level.\n\nReduce planetary surfaces to rubble using §YArmageddon Bombardment§! - or use the Colossus' §YWorld Cracker§! weapon - to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 征服星球
entries.en: Conquer Worlds

entries.zh: 只击垮敌人的士气比彻底地击垮他们更加有效率。\n\n征服敌人的星球来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Crushing the enemy's morale can be more efficient than crushing them outright.\n\nConquer enemy worlds to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 附庸帝国
entries.en: Vassalize Empires

entries.zh: 只要按时上贡而不是百般阻挠，那么普天之下必有他们作为臣民的一席之地。\n\n附庸帝国来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: As long as they contribute rather than thwart, there is room for subjects in our dominion.\n\nVassalize empires to gain this Menace reward.

entries.zh: 保留附庸
entries.en: Retain Vassals

entries.zh: 他者的归顺，恰是我国王道普照的不言之证。\n\n保留附庸国可以§Y每年§!获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Their obedience stands as testament to our flawless dominion.\n\nRetain Vassals to gain this §Yannual§! Menace reward.

entries.zh: 执行扰乱行动
entries.en: Perform Disruptive Operations

entries.zh: 在敌人的内部对其进行猎杀，这对于我们传统的力量投射是非常有力而出色的补充。\n\n执行特定的扰乱行动来获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: Hurting our enemies from the inside has proven to be an excellent complement to traditional force projection.\n\nPerform certain disruptive Operations to gain this Menace Reward.

entries.zh: 违反星系法
entries.en: Be In Breach of Galactic Community Law

entries.zh: 那帮无用而可悲的官僚实在是厚颜无耻！我们绝不屈服！\n\n§Y违反§!一项星海共同体的星系法，可以§Y每年§!获得威慑力奖励。
entries.en: The audacity of that pathetic bunch of feeble bureaucrats - we will not submit!\n\nBe §YIn Breach§! of Galactic Community law to gain this §Yannual§! Menace reward.

entries.zh: 归零者
entries.en: Undertaker

entries.zh: 想象一下一整个生机勃勃、充满野心的物种——这样的存在必须§R遏止§!。
entries.en: Imagine a species full of vibrant life and unbridled potential - now make it §Rstop§!.

entries.zh: 威慑
entries.en: Intimidation

entries.zh: 它们总有另一个选择。那就是去死。
entries.en: There is always another option. It is death.

entries.zh: 无视外交要求提议归顺。\n
entries.en: Proposing Subjugation ignores Diplomatic requirements.\n

entries.zh: 基地破坏者
entries.en: Base Breaker

entries.zh: 火力即正义——我们拥有这样的能力，让一座要塞变成一只煮熟的鸭子。
entries.en: Overwhelming firepower provides perspective - the ability to see a supposed fortress for what it is: a sitting duck.

entries.zh: 无情侵略
entries.en: Relentless Aggression

entries.zh: 进攻者在敌人圈地自灭之前，绝不疲于摧毁敌人的精神。
entries.en: An attacker who never tires breaks the enemy's spirit long before their walls.

entries.zh: 便利替换
entries.en: Easily Replaced

entries.zh: 只要提高生产力，就能提高生产指标。
entries.en: A higher quota is best met by increased production.

entries.zh: 死从天降
entries.en: Death From Above

entries.zh: 我们的舰队将遮天蔽日。无论天上有多少个太阳。
entries.en: Our fleets will blot out the sun. As many suns as it takes.

entries.zh: 配置错误的推进器
entries.en: Misconfigured Thrusters

entries.zh: 如果一艘船不能可靠地驾驶，它的行动就不能可靠地被预测。
entries.en: If a ship cannot be reliably piloted, its movements cannot be reliably predicted.

entries.zh: 目标切断
entries.en: Targeted Severing

entries.zh: 造一艘船就等于毁了它。星系造船厂的设计几乎没有重大的变化；我们都知道。
entries.en: The making of a ship betrays its unmaking. There is little essential variance in the designs sprung from the galaxy's shipyards; we know them all.

entries.zh: 射杀火鸡
entries.en: Flyswatter

entries.zh: 没有什么蠢事不值得我们注意，没有什么罪过不值得我们惩罚。
entries.en: No folly is beneath our notice, no trespass undeserving of retribution.

entries.zh: 强硬优先
entries.en: Harsh Priorities

entries.zh: 只有少部分星系持续暴露在$crisis_cruiser$的威胁之下，这些星系应当被优先考虑。而不需要保护的其他星系的资源——无论这一举动是否明智——将被减少。
entries.en: Only a scant few systems are required for the continued operation of a $crisis_cruiser$ under fire, and should be prioritized. Nonessential resources - sapient or otherwise - need not be protected.

entries.zh: 其利断金
entries.en: Paid in Ambition

entries.zh: 荣光、荣耀和残忍——这永远是硬通货。
entries.en: Honor, glory, sadism - there is always a currency more easily minted.

entries.zh: $crisis_corvette$
entries.en: $crisis_corvette$

entries.zh: 那帮可怜蛋已经开始哭诉自己被骚扰的惨状了……
entries.en: To think that the wretches' fleets imagine themselves harried already...

entries.zh: $crisis_destroyer$
entries.en: $crisis_destroyer$

entries.zh: 残酷的年代，残酷的猎手。
entries.en: A crueler hunter for a crueler age.

entries.zh: $crisis_cruiser$
entries.en: $crisis_cruiser$

entries.zh: 不可承受之重。
entries.en: A crushing weight.

entries.zh: 日蚀与启示录
entries.en: Eclipse & Apocalypse

entries.zh: 恒星之光照耀敌人太久了。不过他们再也见不到这种启迪之光了。
entries.en: For far too long has the light shone on our enemies. No longer will they be able to look to the stars for inspiration.

entries.zh: §Y净化§!是可用的政策了。\n
entries.en: §YPurge§! is unlocked as a Policy option.\n

entries.zh: §Y末日审判轨道轰炸§!已解锁。\n
entries.en: §YArmageddon Bombardment Stance§! is unlocked.\n

entries.zh: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$：§! $crisis_corvette$\n
entries.en: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$:§! $crisis_corvette$\n

entries.zh: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$：§! $crisis_destroyer$\n
entries.en: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$:§! $crisis_destroyer$\n

entries.zh: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$：§! $crisis_cruiser$\n
entries.en: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$:§! $crisis_cruiser$\n

entries.zh: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$：§! $star_eater$\n
entries.en: §H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$:§! $star_eater$\n

entries.zh: 威慑力目标
entries.en: Menace Objectives

entries.zh: 扰乱此世，我们上升到彼世。
entries.en: Through the disruption of our reality do we ascend to another.

entries.zh: 允许完成§H威慑力目标§!累积£menace£§Y威慑力§!。\n
entries.en: Allows the accumulation of £menace£ §YMenace§! by completing §HMenace Objectives§!.\n

entries.zh: 以太相引擎
entries.en: Aetherophasic Engine

entries.zh: 以太相引擎，其目的在于撕开本位面和虚境之间的屏障。
entries.en: The Aetherophasic Engine will rip apart the barriers that exist between this world and the Shroud.

entries.zh: §H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$：§! $crisis_sphere_0$\n
entries.en: §H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$:§! $crisis_sphere_0$\n

entries.zh: 间谍网已构建
entries.en: Spy Network Formed

entries.zh: 我们开始在§Y[from.target.GetName]§!进行隐秘活动。$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]现在开始全权负责[from.target.GetAdj]中快速发展的§H间谍网§!。
entries.en: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning §HSpy Network§! in [from.target.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: 间谍网已组建
entries.en: Spy Network Installed

entries.zh: 我们开始在§Y[from.target.GetName]§!进行隐秘活动：$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]已经开始执行谍报章程。我们新建立的§H间谍网§!让我们可以观察[from.target.GetAdj]的活动，并在必要的时候渗透并介入。
entries.en: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect: $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established §HSpy Network§! will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.

entries.zh: 间谍网已建立
entries.en: Spy Network Established

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星人地盘上的第一个§H间谍网§!的建立。无论何时他们采取行动，我们都会有更多的机会将他们玩弄于[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the establishment of our first §HSpy Network§! within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型，这将有效提醒我们提防那些外星杂碎们的阴谋诡计。
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，宣告了我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型。从今往后，他们也将意识到这对于[owner.species.GetAdj]长久的好处，比如能锻炼一下机密管控能力……
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This heralds the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...

entries.zh: 已经有报告陆续地从被派遣到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]发送过来了。这标志着我们在一个外星帝国开始建立了我们第一个§H间谍网§!。\n\n尽管我们在表面上看上去相似，但是我们应该很快就能发现这些特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是如何可能与我们相异甚远……
entries.en: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the beginning of our first §HSpy Network§! within a foreign empire.\n\nThough we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...

entries.zh: [root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球建立间谍网
entries.en: Spy Network Established on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

entries.zh: 被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!开展工作的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。\n\n若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。
entries.en: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world which is still unaware of alien life.\n\nWith careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.

entries.zh: 被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始考虑外星生命是否存在的社会里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。\n\n我们仍有一线机会来潜移默化地影响这个尚未掌握星际航行技术的社会。我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]具有生理相似性，这应该能让我们的特工轻松地在暗中进行工作。
entries.en: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.\n\nWe now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.

entries.zh: [root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球形成间谍网
entries.en: Spy Network Formed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

entries.zh: 仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何让[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]复制[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的行为。$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]是我们总管在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球上的首个§H间谍网§!的[root.GetIndividualName]。\n\n若计划妥当，我们能够根据自身利益潜移默化地影响这个社会，同时掩盖我们的行踪。
entries.en: After carefully studying the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to adapt our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to replicate [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] behavior. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is one such [root.GetIndividualName]: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.\n\nWith careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this society to suit our needs while keeping our presence hidden.

entries.zh: [root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球安装间谍网
entries.en: Spy Network Installed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

entries.zh: 仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何校准子个体，使其复制[from.target.GetAdj]的行为。子个体$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]是我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球的首个§H间谍网§!的总管。
entries.en: After careful study of the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to recalibrate our drones to replicate [from.target.GetAdj] behavior. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is one such drone: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

entries.zh: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\n[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，仍未意识到外星生命的存在。若要保持现状，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
entries.en: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

entries.zh: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\n[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，刚刚开始接受外星生命的概念。若要有效地执行任务，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
entries.en: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

entries.zh: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这些异种还没有染指外星生命的知识，他们的技术也远不如我们。操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
entries.en: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.

entries.zh: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这些异种最近才开始思考外星生命。尽管他们的社会看起来无懈可击，但他们科技落后，要操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
entries.en: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命的星球里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础。\n\n这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机！在他们做好准备之前，我们只能小心谨慎，不要暴露真实面目。我们不能冒险破坏他们的社会稳定。
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world still unaware of alien life.\n\nIt is an incredible opportunity to study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society and steer it in a more prosperous direction! We just have to be careful not to reveal our true nature until they're ready. We cannot risk destabilizing their society.

entries.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始思考外星生命是否存在的社会里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础！\n\n这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机。如果我们愿意的话，也能帮助他们维系独特的社会。
entries.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society so recently coming to grips with the idea of alien life!\n\nIt is an incredible opportunity to not only study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, but also steer it in a more prosperous direction - or help them preserve their unique society, if we so wish.

entries.zh: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时也带来了一些棘手的问题：也就是说，我们的特工必须小心地掩盖自己的外星身份。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
entries.en: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.

entries.zh: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响这个最近才开始接受外星生命可能性的文明。不论他们的社会前景如何，我们的特工在掩盖外星身份的前提下会全力以赴。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
entries.en: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.

entries.zh: 特工再次露面
entries.en: An Operative Resurfaces

entries.zh: 一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。\n\n信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记。
entries.en: A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.\n\nThe message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in a foreign empire.

entries.zh: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\n我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
entries.en: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nOur security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.

entries.zh: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\n该情报人员已被宣告失联，安全顾问建议我们应当慎重考量。废弃的代码和甚至可能已经不知所踪的特工——我们应当假设其已经叛变。
entries.en: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nThe operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.

entries.zh: 前代理已被除名，将其忽略。
entries.en: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.

entries.zh: 准备一支救援小队。
entries.en: Ready an extraction team.

entries.zh: 坚持不懈的前特工
entries.en: An Insistent Former Operative

entries.zh: 我们又收到了一段来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内的加密信息，这次采用了另一套加密。如我们料想的一样，一度失联的特工声称他们所持有的情报使他们处于极度危险之中。他们声称如果我们不采取行动救援的话，就会考虑§H叛变§!。
entries.en: We've received another encrypted message from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider §Hdefecting§!.

entries.zh: 空洞而可疑的威胁，继续忽略。
entries.en: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.

entries.zh: 好吧。$espionage.1001.b$
entries.en: Fine. $espionage.1001.b$

entries.zh: 处理这位“特工”。
entries.en: Eliminate this 'operative'.

entries.zh: 如果这位特工确实存在而且不知为什么还活了下来，那要是他§R叛变§!的话可就危险了。
entries.en: If the operative is real and somehow survives, there is a risk they may §Rdefect§!.

entries.zh: 他将依旧失联
entries.en: Disavowal Holds

entries.zh: §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内再也没有收到我们的那位除名特工发来的消息了。我们认为这个问题已经被解决了。\n\n我们也许永远也不会知道是否真的有一位前特工存在，也不会知道他是否真的持有有用的情报。如果这确系[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]的阴谋的话，我们可以放心地说：他们的诡计失败了。
entries.en: There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. The matter is being considered as resolved.\n\nWe may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.

entries.zh: 破釜沉舟
entries.en: Burned Bridges

entries.zh: 我们从§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!收到了一份出离愤怒的声明。他们宣称受到了一位§H前[root.GetAdj]间谍§!的渗透，我们应该对此负责。此外，此人将会依据他们对“境外间谍”的相关政策受到一切可能的刑罚。\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$
entries.en: We have received a rather brusk statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. They claim to have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

entries.zh: 我们收到了一份来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!由[disavowed_agent_official.GetName]发出的非常愤怒的公告，宣称有个人前来与[disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap]接触，却又表明自己曾是§H[root.GetAdj]间谍§!。[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]代表不过只言片语，却强烈表明了他们对于“异国特工”的忍无可忍。\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$
entries.en: We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

entries.zh: 如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。
entries.en: If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

entries.zh: 我们收到来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的一篇不寻常的通报，他们宣称已经被§H[root.GetAdj]前特工§!渗透。如果属实，那这位除名特工确实存在，并且已经迫于压力而背叛——他所面临的则是被[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]政府彻底消灭。通报是这么写的。\n\n[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]并没有清楚表明他们的下一步动向，但这样的人如果他还留在原处，必然还会被安置在层层监视之下。依照国际惯例，[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经因为这起“侵犯主权领域”事件签署了针对我们的外交制裁。
entries.en: We have received an unusual statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, claiming they have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.\n\nThe [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.

entries.zh: 最终除名
entries.en: Final Disavowal

entries.zh: 我方安全顾问报告称我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的前特工可能造成的威胁已经被全部扫清。$espionage.1016.desc.end$
entries.en: Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

entries.zh: 位于§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内试图重新取得联系的前特工已经被悉数处理干净。$espionage.1016.desc.end$
entries.en: The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! has been cleanly dealt with. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

entries.zh: 一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。\n\n不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。
entries.en: A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.\n\nEither way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

entries.zh: 幻影特工
entries.en: The Phantom Operative

entries.zh: 我们派遣到§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的秘密强袭小队匆匆返回了。我们的小队发现似乎其实并没有什么除名的特工。取而代之的，小队从蛛丝马迹中发现这一切都是为了暴露我们的秘密行动而设下的全套。\n\n也许这是为了进一步实现[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]目标的计划；又或者是另一个外部势力正在介入其中。但无论如何：我们都要及时终止遏制措施以避免暴露我们一直以来的情报活动。
entries.en: The clandestine strike team we sent into the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.\n\nPerhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.

entries.zh: 还好幸运地躲开了。
entries.en: A lucky dodge.

entries.zh: 除名特工返回
entries.en: Disavowed Operative Returned

entries.zh: 我们一度被除名的特工自行设法回到了[root.GetAdj]境内。这名§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]个体§!——称[disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself]自己为[disavowed_operative.GetName]——又紧张又如释重负，但好在还是通过了全部安全验证。任务简报中报告的行动显得尤为艰难，但其中的信息被证明相当有用——我们现在能获取一位能干的§Y线人§!。\n\n由于事态已经解决，[disavowed_operative.GetName]悬而未决的除名流程现在被更新。确认了[disavowed_operative.GetHeShe]没有在行动中失踪之后，我们现役的特工确信这次除名不再生效。
entries.en: Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual§! - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable §YAsset§!.\n\nWith the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.

entries.zh: 这是个圈套！
entries.en: It's a Ploy!

entries.zh: 看来我们在追寻想要的§H被除名特工§!时太过着急了。被我们派往§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的特勤小队现已完全失联。我们现在怀疑所谓的特工并不存在。\n\n所有参与该行动的特工现均被除名。因此，由于间谍网亟待恢复，我们于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]进行长远行动的能力在近期将被削弱。
entries.en: It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, §Hdisavowed operative§!. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. We now suspect that the operative never existed.\n\nAll operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.

entries.zh: 这可不是个好兆头。
entries.en: This does not bode well.

entries.zh: 大隐于市
entries.en: Hiding in Vivid Sight

entries.zh: 某些位于§H[vividsight_country.GetName]§!听从我们指令的特工开始引起不必要的注意——他们某种程度上成为了……红人？\n\n我们没有理由相信他们的身份暴露了，但是他们不断增长的名声和影响力让我们在隐蔽间谍网方面愈发紧张兮兮。
entries.en: Some of the operatives we control in the §H[vividsight_country.GetName]§! are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?\n\nWe have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.

entries.zh: 如果运筹得当，我们可以将其转化为优势。
entries.en: This could be advantageous, if managed well.

entries.zh: 这么做不妥。安排一些“调动”。
entries.en: This will not do. Arrange for 'adjustments'.

entries.zh: 这么做不妥。调整他们的参数。
entries.en: This will not do. Adjust their parameters.

entries.zh: 一次奇袭
entries.en: A Surprise Catch

entries.zh: 我们正在观察§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$报告了一次新的，令人惊讶的§Y线人§!获取——一名负责交感神经接触的子个体现在为我们的行动服务。\n\n我们已尽一切努力确保这次新的接触不是一个陷阱。例如，我们现在已经制定了一些协议，以尽量减少该线人为双重间谍的可能性。
entries.en: Our $role_spymaster$ watching over the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new §YAsset§! - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.\n\nAll efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!所进行的诸多隐秘任务就包括低调地搜罗潜在的线人：任何可以帮助我们进一步深入格式塔实体的工具。我们的$role_spymaster$报告刚刚有了一个幸运的发现。
entries.en: Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our $role_spymaster$ reports having just made one such lucky catch.

entries.zh: 我们成功地让一群§P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj]敌特§!落入了我们的罗网。他们似乎正在从事危害我方的行动，但细节尚不清楚。\n\n不过，经由审讯，我们已经搜集到了少许关于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的情报。我方$role_spymaster$还联系上了一名当地§Y线人§!以对这些情报进行利用。
entries.en: We have have trapped a group of §P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies§!. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.\n\nThrough our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!. Our $role_spymaster$ now also has access to a local §YAsset§! with which we can press this advantage.

entries.zh: 我们位于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$发来报告，一批§P敌特§!业已落网。虽然近日来其对我们的不利行动已不可挽回，但事实证明，对这些人的审讯是有价值的。\n\n我们由此获得的情报的时效并不长，但这些敌特的落网使得我们对抗[luckycatch_country.GetName]的行动取得了一定优势。我们已在这些人中发展了一些§Y线人§!，以备不时之需。
entries.en: Our $role_spymaster$ in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports that we have successfully captured a band of §Psaboteurs§!. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.\n\nThe intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an §YAsset§! to aid us when required.

entries.zh: 我们已设法在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的§Y新线人§!。
entries.en: We have acquired a §Ynew Asset§! for our Spy Network in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 拾者有份
entries.en: Finders Keepers

entries.zh: §H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj]加密密钥§!的一部分落入了位于§Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§!的一名格外眼尖的特工[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。看起来是某位粗心的[finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName]$job_politician$在通勤时落下了这一设备。\n\n这对于我们在[finderskeepers_country.GetName]中的行动而言是个好兆头，而且就这一设备独特设计的研究揭示了若干有助于我们通用§Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!方法研发的新颖洞见。
entries.en: A particularly observant operative in the §Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§! has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a §H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key§!. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] $job_politician$ mislaid the device whilst commuting.\n\nThis bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to §Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 误发公报
entries.en: Stray Communiqué

entries.zh: 我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名$job_politician_plural$一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。\n\n我国内政部门正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入敌对势力[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
entries.en: One of our $job_politician_plural$ on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural]一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。\n\n我方安全团队正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入我们的竞争者[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
entries.en: One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.

entries.zh: 立刻开除这个废物！
entries.en: Fire this incompetent, at once!

entries.zh: 我国首都的一名£job_politician£§Y$job_politician$§!将被开除及§R降阶§!。
entries.en: A £job_politician£ §Y$job_politician$§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.

entries.zh: $espionage.1060.a$
entries.en: $espionage.1060.a$

entries.zh: 我国首都的一名§Y[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]§!将被开除及§R降阶§!。
entries.en: A §Y[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.

entries.zh: 检测到敌方渗透
entries.en: Hostile Infiltration Detected

entries.zh: 我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为§H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。
entries.en: Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the §H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!, on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

entries.zh:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

我们设法§Y解密§!了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。

我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。
entries.en:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

We have managed to §Ydecrypt§! various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

entries.zh:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。

尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。
entries.en:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

entries.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。
entries.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

entries.zh: 这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。
entries.en: These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

entries.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。
entries.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

entries.zh: 保持秘密监控。
entries.en: Maintain a quiet watch.

entries.zh: 整个星系都应该听听这个！
entries.en: The galaxy shall hear of this!

entries.zh: \n§H§Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了§!
entries.en: \n§HThe §Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§! will be informed that we caught their operatives.§!

entries.zh: 我们应该等待时机。
entries.en: We shall bide our time.

entries.zh: 有些人必须为此负责。
entries.en: Somebody must be held accountable.

entries.zh: 让他们给我们封口费。
entries.en: Let them buy our silence in this matter.

entries.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!不会对这种姿态给予太多关注。
entries.en: The §Y[from.GetName]§! would not pay much heed to such a gesture.

entries.zh: 东窗事发
entries.en: No Longer Covert

entries.zh: 我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动§P公之于众§!！。\n\n有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。
entries.en: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to §Pexpose us§! for our actions!\n\nIt's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

entries.zh: 我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动§P公之于众§!！。\n\n有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。
entries.en: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to §Pexpose us§! for our actions against them.\n\nIt's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

entries.zh: 可悲。
entries.en: Pathetic.

entries.zh: 这一套可不只你们会。
entries.en: Two can play at that game.

entries.zh: 对谍报活动的指控
entries.en: Allegations of Espionage

entries.zh: §H[from.GetName]§!指控我方进行§P敌对谍报活动§!。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。\n\n不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。
entries.en: The §H[from.GetName]§! accuses us of §Phostile espionage§!. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.\n\nWhatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.
