entries.zh: 这与我们无关。
entries.en: It is of no concern to us.

entries.zh: 对谍报活动的勒索
entries.en: Extorted for Espionage

entries.zh: 我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，将我方情报人员当场抓获且§H要求外交支持§!。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。\n\n有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。
entries.en: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have caught us in the act and §Hdemanded political favors§!. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.\n\nIt's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

entries.zh: 阴谋被揭露
entries.en: Insidious Plot Uncovered

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工揭露了一些谣言——§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!正在密谋欺骗我们。我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们以及我们的生活方式本身的破坏。\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered rumors that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
entries.en: Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工获悉了一些可靠的传闻，当地有针对我们的阴谋。似乎他们§H[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]§!特工对于自身特工行为的保密性不太重视。\n\n我们尚未掌握该暴露阴谋的具体细节，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their §H[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]§! counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.\n\nWe have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

entries.zh: 那群恶魔！
entries.en: Those fiends!

entries.zh: 阴谋被揭露
entries.en: Suspect Plot Uncovered

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，其表明§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!意图在近期欺骗我们。\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered suspect evidence that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! mean to deceive us in the near future.\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，证据表明他们意图在近期对我们发起一次误导性的反制行动。\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered suspect evidence that they mean to launch a deceptive counter-operation against us in the near future.\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$

entries.zh: 尽管该计划的细节尚不得而知，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。$role_spymaster$[insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName]建议对这一情况保持谨慎，因为这些信息的获得过于容易，显得§P相当可疑§!。
entries.en: We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. $role_spymaster$ [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is §Pfairly suspect§!.

entries.zh: 这种潜在的恶行不可容忍。
entries.en: This potential outrage cannot be tolerated.

entries.zh: 这很可能是个陷阱，别管它。
entries.en: This is likely a ploy. Ignore it.

entries.zh: 卷入阴谋
entries.en: Implicated in a Plot

entries.zh: 我们被牵连进了一个针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。\n\n我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
entries.en: We have been implicated in a plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.\n\nOur own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

entries.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。\n\n似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
entries.en: Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.\n\nIt would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

entries.zh: 动员特工
entries.en: Mobilizing Operatives

entries.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
entries.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

entries.zh: 我们的“观察员”正开始和那些被我们标记为有潜在用处的目标套近乎。
entries.en: Our 'spotters' have begun ingratiating themselves with targets we've marked as potentially useful.

entries.zh: 收缩势力范围
entries.en: Narrowing the Field

entries.zh: 一份目标的候选名单已经拟定。那些不再承担监视任务的特工将为其他人提供掩护。
entries.en: A shortlist of targets has been drawn up. Those operatives who are no longer tasked with surveillance will provide cover for the others.

entries.zh: 建立线人联系
entries.en: Asset Identified

entries.zh: 随着行动接近尾声，$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经转而保护我们在[target.GetName]内的新线人。其余特工随时准备着为[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]提供任何可能需要的掩护措施。
entries.en: As the operation nears its conclusion, $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has moved to secure our new Asset within the [target.GetName]. Our remaining operatives are poised to facilitate any cover [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] may need.

entries.zh: 线人已获取
entries.en: Asset Acquired

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回报告：到目前为止此项计划进展顺利。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports from the [from.target.GetName]: a successful execution so far.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在已能接触到§H一位在[from.target.GetAdj]文化界有影响力的人物§!，我们可以将他们想维持公众形象的需求和我们所拥有的雄心壮志相结合，以此来暗中对其心智与思维施加影响。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network now has access to §Han influential figure within [from.target.GetAdj] culture§!, whose desire to maintain their public profile pairs splendidly with ambitions we may wish to wield, to manipulate hearts and minds.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经确保了同§H一位[from.target.GetAdj]政府高层官员§!联络的通路。这位线人已经被保护起来，同时蓄势待发，做好了在未来行动中协助我们的准备，尤其是当我们遇到外交或是政府层面的问题时。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have secured access to §Han official within the [from.target.GetAdj] civic hierarchy§!. This Asset will be kept secure but poised, ready to assist us with future operations - particularly when we might brush up against diplomatic or governmental issues.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在能支持我们接触到§H一位有影响力的[from.target.GetAdj]专家§!，其已准备好协助我们的行动，该线人的人脉网络及其声誉将有利于行动的开展。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to §Han influential [from.target.GetAdj] professional§!, ready to assist us with operations which may benefit from the Asset's own network contacts, or the weight of their reputation.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经取得了§H一位[from.target.GetAdj]反政府者§!的忠诚，其破坏性的欲望很容易被利用来达成我们的目标。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have won the loyalty of §Ha [from.target.GetAdj] rebel§!, whose desire for disruptive change may easily be molded to suit our goals as well.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们引诱到了§H[from.target.GetAdj]公民中一位不受赏识的成员§!，他的壮志及其在社会低层中的人脉将通过多种渠道协助我们行动的开展。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have lured §Han underappreciated member of the [from.target.GetAdj] citizenry§!, whose attitude and contacts amongst the lower rungs of society are sure to aid our Operations in various ways.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们间谍网现已获取到了§H一位已改造的[from.target.GetAdj]无人机§!，我们能通过入侵其意识或是其他方法操控[from.target.GetName]实体，这样的好处是显而易见的。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network has secured access to §Ha modified [from.target.GetAdj] drone§!, the benefits of which will be obvious whenever we might wish to infiltrate or otherwise manipulate the [from.target.GetName] entity.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经控制了§H[from.target.GetName]实体的一部分§!，这位反常子个体使我们得以接入主蜂巢思维，负责掩护我们针对主脑的行动以及达成更多目的。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have laid claim to §Hpart of the [from.target.GetName] entity§! - an Asset which will allow us to interfere with the hive, obscure our movements against it, and much more.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经控制了§H[from.target.GetName]实体的一部分§!，这一异常无人机使我们得以接入其中央主控智能并发动直接而毁灭性的打击。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have laid claim to §Hpart of the [from.target.GetName] entity§! - an Asset which will allow us to interfere with the machine intelligence with direct and devastating consequences.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在能支持我们连接§H部分[from.target.GetName]用于运算的网络§!。如果我们要掩盖自己对于机器实体的行动，传送错误的信息或是开展其他干扰的话，我们可以将其自身的协议武器化来对付它自己。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to §Hpart of the network on which the [from.target.GetName] operates§!. Should we wish to obscure our movements against the machine entity, send it false information or otherwise interfere with it: its own protocols may now be weaponized against it.

entries.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们刚刚招募了一名有价值的线人，此人会协助我们在[from.target.GetAdj]国内的情报搜集工作和间谍活动。
entries.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have secured a valuable Asset which will bolster our intelligence-gathering and espionage activities inside [from.target.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: 立即将该线人投入行动。
entries.en: Put this Asset to work immediately.

entries.zh: 搜集领袖
entries.en: Gathering Leads

entries.zh: 我们潜伏的特工们已经完全渗透了[root.target.GetAdj]国内举办的一次尖端云集的会议上。他们已经开始寻找那些潜在目标。
entries.en: Our undercover operatives are dispersed throughout a promising-looking conference being held in [root.target.GetAdj] space. They have begun scouting potential targets.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
entries.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

entries.zh: 我们已经安排了一些特工在[root.target.GetName]上举办的讲座中充当观众。他们将会在这些知识精英中寻找潜在的领袖。
entries.en: We have placed operatives in the audience at a number of lectures being held in the [root.target.GetName]. We will watch for potential leads amongst their intellectual elite.

entries.zh: 我们的特工分散在[root.target.GetName]为造福他们自己的公民而运行的各种科学宣传计划中。我们的行动目的就是想对这些计划有所了解。
entries.en: Our operatives have dispersed amongst the various scientific outreach schemes being run by the [root.target.GetName] for the benefit of their own citizenry. Our target for this endeavor may very well just make themselves known to us.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经开始监视[root.target.GetAdj]上的一座研究设施。我们会利用一切存在的切入点。
entries.en: Our operatives have begun surveilling a [root.target.GetAdj] research facility. Wherever an entry point exists, we shall exploit it.

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告称，我们特工的行动遇到了不可逾越的障碍：[target.GetAdj]的工程技术突飞猛进，远远甩开了我们。\n\n任何可能从他们那里窃取的技术都已变得§H浑不可解§!——且与我们现有的技术体系不兼容。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our operatives have met an insurmountable obstacle: [target.GetAdj] engineering appears to have advanced and deviated far from our own.\n\nAny technology we might hope to steal from them would be §Hinscrutable§! to us - as well as incompatible with what we currently possess.

entries.zh: 寻找领袖
entries.en: Chasing a Lead

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了一个符合我们预期标准的目标：能够获得足够前沿的研究成果，同时对于我们的特工持友好态度。我们将会继续跟进这名领袖。
entries.en: We have found a target who meets our ideal criteria: access to sufficiently novel research, and a receptive attitude towards our operative. We will continue to pursue this lead.

entries.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
entries.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经找到了缺口——这对于我们渗透连接到[root.target.GetAdj]相关研究的计划来说是一个理想的基石。
entries.en: Our operatives have found an opening - an ideal foundation upon which to build our plans to infiltrate [root.target.GetAdj] research.

entries.zh: 获取条目
entries.en: Entry Secured

entries.zh: 我们已经制定了多种具有明显优势的计划：我们的特工终于被邀请到一个从事尖端研究的高级别安全分支机构。$role_spymaster$[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]向我们保证，[root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的预测显示计划前景良好。
entries.en: We have drawn up various plans which press a clear advantage: our operative has at last been invited to a high-security branch facility engaged in cutting-edge research. $role_spymaster$ [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] assures us that [root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] simulations paint a favorable forecast.

entries.zh: 我们的特工现在已经执行了大量的测试行动，其结果与来自$role_spymaster$[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]的有利预测高度一致。我们对于觊觎已久的[root.target.GetAdj]上的研究已经完全做好了准备。
entries.en: Our operatives have now performed numerous test runs, the results of which concur with favorable forecasts from $role_spymaster$ [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]. We stand ready to make our attempt on coveted [root.target.GetAdj] research.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.target.GetAdj]研究已获取
entries.en: [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] Research Secured

entries.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.target.GetName]的渗透行为迄今还没有露出任何马脚。
entries.en: Our infiltration attempt in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] has proceeded flawlessly so far.

entries.zh: $operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$\n\n一个特工已经通过§H公用通道§!获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，他正慢慢地迂回前进，直到接触[fromfrom.target.GetName]限制访问的中央资料库的终端。$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
entries.en: $operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$\n\nA single operative has gained access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hutility ducts§!, having slowly wound their way to a restricted-access terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. $operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

entries.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

我们的一位特工藏在了一处远程研究设施的§H货物入口§!，等待运输人员将其带过几道明显很不充分的[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]安全关卡。一个脑子不好使的[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj]将我们的特工放在了一个能够很轻松够到终端的地方，可以从这里入侵[fromfrom.target.GetName]的中央资料库。

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
entries.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

A single operative hid within the §Hgoods entrance§! of a remote research facility, waiting to be couriered past a number of clearly-inadequate [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security measures. An unwitting [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj] has placed our operative within easy reach of a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository.

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

entries.zh: $operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$尽管[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]执行了必要的安全措施，我们的特工隐蔽工作做得更为彻底：我们§H制造的信任感§!给了我们充足的机会窗口。\n\n$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
entries.en: $operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$ Our operative's cover held throughout, and although the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] exercised reasonable security: the §Htrust we manufactured§! was just sufficient to grant us our window of opportunity.\n\n$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

entries.zh: 一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
entries.en: A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

entries.zh: §H我们必须至少要等待§Y6年§!，才能再次图谋他们的科研设施。§!
entries.en: §HWe must wait at least §Y6 years§! before attempting another breach on their research facilities.§!

entries.zh: 按计划行事。任务完成。
entries.en: That will do. Mission accomplished.

entries.zh: 把我们带不走的全炸了。
entries.en: Sabotage whatever we leave behind.

entries.zh:
§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!：
受到§Y$research_stolen_sabotaged$§!损害，持续1年。
entries.en:
§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!:
Afflicted by §Y$research_stolen_sabotaged$§! for 1 year.

entries.zh: 留一个后门，方便我们随时检索他们未来的研究。
entries.en: Give us backdoor-access to their future research.

entries.zh: 好机会，我们应该再多抢一点！
entries.en: This is an ideal opportunity to seize more!

entries.zh: 我们有一项额外科技可以进行研究，并且我们已经得到该条目。
entries.en: An additional technology is made available for research, as well as the item we have attained.

entries.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。
entries.en: Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk.

entries.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

一个特工已经通过§H公用通道§!获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，正试图前往核心区域的一处访问受限制的终端。然而，当他获取[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的权限时，§H警报§!触发了。

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
entries.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

They sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hutility ducts§!, intending to reach a restricted-access terminal at its core. When they accessed the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository, however, §Han alarm§! was tripped.

 $operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

entries.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

我们的一位特工试图通过§H货运通道§!访问某个远程研究设施的内部，货运人员直接将此人输运到了一处可以接入[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的终端。然而不幸的是，刚打算行动的时候§H警报§!就触发了。

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
entries.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

A single operative sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hgoods yard§!, having themselves delivered straight to a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. Unfortunately §Han alarm§! appears to have been tripped the moment they made their move.

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

entries.zh: $operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$我们的首席特工设法利用一个假身份完成了获取，但是他的§H身份§!现在已经被识破了，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]已经通知了他们的安全部门。\n\n$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
entries.en: $operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$ Our lead operative's cover held long enough to complete their extraction, but their §Hcredentials§! have now been exposed as false. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security has been alerted to their presence.\n\n$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

entries.zh: 我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的§H逃脱计划§!被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
entries.en: The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's §Hescape plans§! have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

entries.zh: 找回我们的特工，能找回来多少就找回来多少！
entries.en: Retrieve as many of our operatives as possible.

entries.zh: 他们损失了。能破坏多少就破坏多少。
entries.en: They're lost. Sabotage whatever we can.

entries.zh: 我们每次只能执行一个后门操作。
entries.en: We may only operate one such backdoor at a time.

entries.zh: 谜一样的科技
entries.en: Inscrutable Technology

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]提交了一份报告，事关§H[from.target.GetName]§!境内的[from.GetName]行动。似乎看上去[from.target.GetAdj]的科学和工程学已经先进到了可以欺瞒我方最专业的特工的地步了。他们宣称其内部技术和我们自己的科技截然不同，即使我们设法偷到了一两项科技，仿制出来的硬件也无法和我们自己的兼容\n\n$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]建议我们去其他的地方再窃取类似的秘密。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has submitted a report on Operation [from.GetName], inside the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. It seems that [from.target.GetAdj] science and engineering have advanced to the point of bamboozling our expert operatives. They claim that the underlying technology has deviated greatly from our own, meaning that even if we could somehow steal their research, the resulting hardware would be incompatible with ours.\n\n$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that we appropriate such secrets elsewhere.

entries.zh: 研究被破坏！
entries.en: Research Sabotaged!

entries.zh: 我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。\n\n我们的团队已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢他们的进度。我们预计需要几个月的时间，我们才能利用已保存的纸面材料，重新整合研究开发进度。
entries.en: Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown infiltrator has upended many of our data libraries, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant delays to our §Hongoing studies§!.\n\nOur teams were able to switch to backup systems quite rapidly, but this will slow their progress. It's estimated that months may pass before we're able to re-integrate our research & development processes with the existing corpus.

entries.zh: 我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。\n\n我们已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢进度。我们需要几个月的时间才能利用已恢复的研究数据集来重新整合研究开发进度。
entries.en: Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown entity has infiltrated our data media, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant disruption to our §Hongoing studies§!.\n\nWe were able to engage backup systems quite rapidly, but our progress from here will be slowed down. Months may pass before we're able to smoothly re-integrate research & development with our existing research libraries.

entries.zh: 接近[target.solar_system.GetName]的目标
entries.en: Approaching Target in [target.solar_system.GetName]

entries.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。
entries.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§! under tight aliases.

entries.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
entries.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$ Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try their luck in shadier parts of the installation.

entries.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$他们中间有一个假扮工匠家庭，希望能够寻得新的生意机遇。他们会尝试在§H[target.GetName]§!摆零售地摊以出售自己的手工制品。
entries.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$ Amongst them is a supposed family of artisans, seeking new business opportunities. They will try to establish a retail presence on §H[target.GetName]§! in order to sell their wares.

entries.zh: 一批专业的特工已经到达§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。他们使用一艘不起眼的货运飞船作为掩护。
entries.en: A batch of operatives has left for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel.

entries.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$它的货架上装满了对[target.owner.GetAdj]的扫描器会显示为$rare_crystals$和其他珍贵矿物的物件。我们相信，最简单直白的策略能够达到最好的障眼法效果。
entries.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ Its hold is packed with what will appear to [target.owner.GetAdj] scanners as $rare_crystals$ and other precious minerals. We trust that the bare-faced simplicity of this strategy will serve as its own bluff.

entries.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$这艘舰船在接近[target.owner.GetAdj]国境的时候被安排了一场非致命性的爆炸，使得其尽可能接近§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系。辐射将会倾泻出来充满了整个船舱内部，这样我们的特工就能秘密隐藏在它不可见的受保护核心中。
entries.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ The ship is rigged for a non-lethal explosion as it approaches the [target.owner.GetAdj] border - as close as it can get to the §H[target.solar_system.GetName] system§!. Radiation will appear to flood the interior of the vessel as our operatives secrete themselves within its invisibly-shielded core.

entries.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
entries.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

entries.zh: 特工就位
entries.en: Operatives in Place

entries.zh: 我方的数名特工已经被允许登陆§H[target.GetName]§!设施。其他未获得授权的特工则继续分散在邻近星系。在这里他们可以转换成备用的掩护身份以进一步支援整个行动。
entries.en: A number of our operatives have been accepted aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!. Those who haven't been granted work there have dispersed to neighboring systems. There they will switch to backup cover identities and lend support to the overall operation.

entries.zh: 对方已经上钩了，我们的特工已经“遁入黑暗”，进而在敌对设施内部展开工作。$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]将会等待进一步的讯息信号。
entries.en: The bait has been taken, and our operatives have 'gone dark' as they work to establish themselves within the hostile facility. $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will await further signals from them.

entries.zh: 就绪信号
entries.en: Ready Signal

entries.zh: 一段加密的信号自§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。
entries.en: A coded signal has arrived from within the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!, indicating that our operatives now stand ready.

entries.zh: $operation.2002.desc.intro$\n\n他们的身份伪装已经深入到了一定程度，我们的特工事实上已经和那里的人员打成一片。通过友情聚餐、共享娱乐，以及日常社交活动，他们在§H[target.GetName]设施§!获得了不少能用于进入核心系统的线索。
entries.en: $operation.2002.desc.intro$\n\nThey have worked their cover roles to such a degree, our operatives have actually developed a rapport with local personnel. A number of useful points of entry have been noted during friendly meals, shared entertainments and day-to-day socializing aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!.

entries.zh: $operation.2002.desc.intro$$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经着手准备在可能的情况下撤出他们，然而机会十分渺茫。
entries.en: $operation.2002.desc.intro$ $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has made preparations to extract them where possible, however their chances are slim.

entries.zh: [root.GetSabotagedStarbaseTitle]
entries.en: [root.GetSabotagedStarbaseTitle]

entries.zh: 我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系内的§H民用设施§!进行了一次成功的爆破。随后而来的混乱证明了我们目标的成功实现。\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$
entries.en: We have struck a a successful blow to §Hcivic infrastructure§! in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. The ensuing chaos should serve our goals well.\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

entries.zh:
我们成功地破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施上面的§H军用支援结构§!。我们的特工报道了在他们的设备激活后，周边工作的人出现了少量的伤亡。

我们发动的这次打击扰乱了§Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§!的作战后勤，对方不会对其视而不见的。

$operation.2005.desc.outro$
entries.en:
We have successfully sabotaged a §Hmilitary support structure§! aboard the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. Our operatives report minor casualties amongst those working nearby at the time their device activated.

This blow we've dealt to combat logistics within the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§! will not go unnoticed by them.

$operation.2005.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系及其周边的§H商业利益§!发动了一次打击。由于当地星系的交通控制者手忙脚乱地制定新的物流模式，贸易舰船已经堵塞了所有的运输航线。\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$
entries.en: We have struck a blow to §Hcommercial interests§! in and around the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Trading vessels are already clogging up the shipping lanes as local space traffic controllers scramble to draw up new holding patterns.\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
entries.en: We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

entries.zh: 尽可能干净地解散。
entries.en: Disband as cleanly as possible.

entries.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个恒星基地。
entries.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this starbase.

entries.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个星环基地。
entries.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this orbital ring.

entries.zh: 我们的特工会看准机会§H摧毁额外的目标结构§!。
entries.en: Our operatives will seize an opportunity to §Hdestroy additional structures§! on the target.

entries.zh: 也对$military_station_small_plural$发动打击。
entries.en: Strike at the $military_station_small_plural$ as well.

entries.zh: 摧毁一座目标上的$military_station_small$。
entries.en: Destroys a $military_station_small$ on the target.

entries.zh: 破坏行动终止
entries.en: Sabotage Aborted

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告道，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的特工小队必须放弃目前打算破坏§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!位于§H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]星系目标§!的计划。[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]内部发生了急剧的变化，我们之前的准备工作成为了赘余。我们应该明智地挑选一个不同的目标。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage §H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]§! in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system§!. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.

entries.zh: [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系的[root.GetSabotagedStarbaseTitle]！
entries.en: [root.GetSabotagedStarbaseTitle] in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] System!

entries.zh: 入侵者们已经越过了我们在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，并破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]§!设施的一部分。这些破坏分子显然是在为某个外国势力卖命；我们的反间谍部队必须提高警戒并尝试抓住这些特工。
entries.en: Intruders have violated our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on high alert to try and capture these operatives.

entries.zh: 未知的破坏分子在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系发动了袭击，破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的部分功能。\n\n我们的反间谍部门推断这是外国势力从中作梗而不是本国的威胁。我们已经提高了受影响宇域的安全等级，希望能够擒拿这些特工。
entries.en: Unknown saboteurs have struck at the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!.\n\nOur counter-espionage service suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.

entries.zh: 一个外国实体突破了我们位于§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，放肆地扰乱了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的平稳运行。我们暂时无法确信这些破坏分子是如何如此有效地进入我国国界，但是我们提高了内部的安全级别以直接应对这次威胁。
entries.en: A foreign entity has breached our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system and has wantonly disrupted the smooth running of §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.

entries.zh: 识别目标
entries.en: Identifying Targets

entries.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对§Y[root.target.GetName]§!友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
entries.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the §Y[root.target.GetName]§!. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一个前途无量的目标——§H[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]§!——他们同§Y[root.target.GetName]§!的关系利于[root.target.GetAdj]的利益而于我们有害。
entries.en: We have found a promising target - the §H[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]§! - whose relationship with the §Y[root.target.GetName]§! benefits [root.target.GetAdj] interests to our own detriment.

entries.zh: 我们没能发现这个方面合适的目标。看来如果§Y[root.target.GetName]§!真的在其他地方有盟友，我们也还并没有同他们建立联系。
entries.en: We are unable to find a suitable target for this endeavor. It seems that if the §Y[root.target.GetName]§! do have friends elsewhere, we have yet to establish lines of communication with them.

entries.zh: [smear_option_1.GetName]。
entries.en: The [smear_option_1.GetName].

entries.zh: [smear_option_2.GetName]。
entries.en: The [smear_option_2.GetName].

entries.zh: [smear_option_3.GetName]。
entries.en: The [smear_option_3.GetName].

entries.zh: 就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 黑历史
entries.en: Dirty Dossier

entries.zh: 由$role_spymaster$[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。
entries.en: The team under $role_spymaster$ [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$我们会放出可信度很高的谣言，[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的宗教仪式习俗在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内部已经成为了公开的笑料。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ We will spread credible rumors that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] ritual practices are the subject of open ridicule in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$如果他们被抓到兜售廉价、渎神的圣像，而[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]恰好将视其为神明，那么……
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ If they were seen to be peddling cheap and blasphemous idols from whatever the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] hold most sacred, for example...

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$我们会伪造一场[root.target.GetAdj]运动，目标直指那些[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]内非祭司阶层的人。要想扰乱宗教教团的政治，就得攻击那些负责运作的人。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ We will fabricate a [root.target.GetAdj] campaign targeting those outside of the priest caste in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. An attempt to disrupt the politics of their religious order is bound to offend those who run it.

entries.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。
entries.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们可以暗示[root.target.GetAdj]之所以对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]感兴趣是为了研究其军事机密，并且一旦他们暴露出任何弱点，对方便可能会发动战争。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We can suggest that [root.target.GetAdj] interests in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] are solely motivated by studying their military secrets, and that they might go as far as instigating war to test any weaknesses they've exposed.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$[root.target.GetName]应当因为关押[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的战犯并意图教化他们而受到控告，例如……
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ Should the [root.target.GetName] be accused of withholding [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] prisoners of war with the intention of indoctrinating them, for example...

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们可以提供不容辩驳的证词，证明[root.target.GetName]明明知道武器有瑕疵，却依然睁一只眼闭一只眼将武器给他们的星系邻居，即[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We shall supply incontrovertible evidence that the [root.target.GetName] are selling cleverly-disguised, defective weaponry to their esteemed galactic neighbors, the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$放出有关[root.target.GetAdj]在技术上获得突破的谣言，这项技术能够强制平定像[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]这样的邻国，比如说……
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ Rumors of a breakthrough in [root.target.GetAdj] technology which would forcibly pacify neighbors like the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], for example...

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们刺激他们的自尊心，暗示[root.target.GetName]用对战[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的场景来训练他们最年轻的新兵，以此来帮新兵建立能打胜仗的信心。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We will appeal to their sense of pride, suggesting that the [root.target.GetName] train only their youngest cadets on combat scenarios against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], as a means of easily building their confidence.

entries.zh: 我们会夸大[root.target.GetName]的外族傲慢，挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外本性。
entries.en: We will exaggerate the alien arrogance of the [root.target.GetName], appealing to the xenophobic heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$比如说：如果[root.target.GetName]被抓到正在售卖基于[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]生物学的基因疗法，他们一定会暴跳如雷。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$ For example: were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught selling gene therapies based on [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] biology, they are bound to take umbrage.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$我们会播种这样一个想法，[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋绑架[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，并教化他们接受一个更加开放的宇宙。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$ We will seed ideas about a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to abduct [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens and indoctrinate them into accepting a more open galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。
entries.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$要是[root.target.GetName]被抓到没有遵守他们的移民条约，并且专门针对[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，让他们去干脏活累活，想必有人会觉得受到了冒犯。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ Were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught dishonoring their migration treaty, and singling out [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens for worse jobs, offense would have to be taken.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$我们应该拐弯抹角地暗示[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋破坏他们在星海共同体的政治立场。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ We shall lay hints of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to sabotage their political standing within the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$我们可以提供不容忽视的证据，指明[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋渗透[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的政治体系，并试图干涉大选。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ We can supply hard-to-ignore evidence of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to infiltrate the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] political system and meddle in their elections.

entries.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。
entries.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$我们可以放出高可信度的谣言，造谣有人密谋窃取他们的科技，这应该有利于我们的目标。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ Credible rumors of a plot to outright steal their technology should serve us well in this goal.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$我们应当捏造一个[root.target.GetName]国内的运动组织，去窃取[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的机器人，绕过他们自己有限的生产手段。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ We shall concoct a movement within the [root.target.GetName] to steal [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] droids, bypassing their own limited means of production.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$造谣[root.target.GetAdj]有能力产生威胁，在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的数据库内部引爆一个受控的、由人工智能主导的奇点，这样的消息应该能够吸引他们的注意和怒火。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ A [root.target.GetAdj] threat of sparking a controlled, AI-driven singularity within the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] datasphere ought to draw their attention and ire.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$[root.target.GetAdj]可能正在密谋破坏科学研究，这样的消息肯定能够引起他们一定的反感。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ That the [root.target.GetAdj] might be plotting to sabotage that scientific research would be sure to draw some sort of reaction from them.

entries.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。
entries.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$举个例子：[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权可能不会乐意听到[root.target.GetAdj]在他们国内贩卖枪火并以此获利。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ For example: the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] administration will not enjoy hearing that the [root.target.GetAdj] have profited off a gun-running operation through their space.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们知道有一个[root.target.GetAdj]运营的、旨在破坏[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]和其派系内部的卫星国之间关系的项目，这样的消息肯定能让人愤怒。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ News of a [root.target.GetAdj]-run program to arm breakaway factions inside client states of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is bound to cause outrage.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们会播种相当可信的恐惧，宣扬[root.target.GetName]正在研发一款武器，能够让[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName]的人口变得极具暴力、有破坏性。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ We will seed credible fears that the [root.target.GetName] is working on a weapon capable of making [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName] populations turn savagely violent.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们会给出证据，某些忠于[root.target.GetName]的深潜派系，正想法设法在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]国境的周边制造边境冲突。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ We will concoct evidence that sleeper factions, loyal to the [root.target.GetName], are poised to spark border skirmishes around [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: 我们已经获悉了[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外态度，我们可以充分利用这一点，让他们觉得[root.target.GetName]是在积极地利用他们的友好举止。
entries.en: We will lean into the xenophilic attitudes of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], making it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are actively exploiting their friendly demeanor.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的贸易协定有价格修正方面的谣言应该可以引起他们的注意，动摇他们同[root.target.GetName]建立关系的信心。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ Rumors of price-fixing on trade deals with [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] ought to get their attention, shaking confidence in their relationship with the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$伪造消息称[root.target.GetName]专门出售[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的奴隶，这应该可以激起愤慨。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ Fabricated news that [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] slaves are being specifically sought out by the [root.target.GetName] is bound to cause offense.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$我们会散播有关[root.target.GetName]的黑暗谣言，指出他们利益背后的最终动机是希望把[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]变为盘中餐……
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ We will cast dark rumors upon the [root.target.GetName], hinting that ulterior motives lie behind their interest in the accommodating [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]...

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$我们会潜移默化地暗示，[root.target.GetName]一直在散步虚假的谣言，要是说到他们第一次加入星系的大家庭的话，他们还暗中破坏了同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的第一次接触。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ We will plant suggestions that the [root.target.GetName] have been spreading false rumors and otherwise sabotaging attempts by the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] to engage in first contact, back to when since they first joined the galactic stage.

entries.zh: 我们会不经意地透露[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的威权本质，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权带去混沌的代言人。
entries.en: We will lean into the authoritarian nature of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as agents of chaos for the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] regime.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$有关[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的领袖[smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName]在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内被当成了一个彻底的嘲弄对象的证据，能够激起他们的愤慨。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ Evidence that the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] leader [smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName] is a subject of outright mockery in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles is likely to raise their ire.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们会伪造一个遍布[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会的慢性渗透行动的证据，称这一行动可以激发和扭转社会大众朝着邪恶的目标前进。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We will fabricate evidence of a plot to seed operatives throughout [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society, to agitate and steer them towards other, nefarious goals.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们会暗示[root.target.GetName]正在运营一个隐蔽的社会学实验，他们拿[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会作为实验场景，测试治国术和控制民众的相关理论。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We will suggest that the [root.target.GetName] is running subtle, sociological experiments behind the scenes of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society as a testbed for theories of statecraft and control.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们可以明示，他们的特使遭到了[root.target.GetName]的勒索以换取表态，这让对方可以从国境之外对他们施加影响力。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We can strongly suggest that their envoys are being extorted by the [root.target.GetName] for favors, applying undue influence from outside their own borders.

entries.zh: 由$role_spymaster$[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队计划挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的商贸原则，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成为不值得信任的对手。
entries.en: The team under $role_spymaster$ [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will appeal to the commercial principles of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as untrustworthy rivals.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$一个像他们这样的商业帝国一定打着在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]全境散布犯罪企业的小算盘，这将侵蚀他们赢得的信任感。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ That an empire like theirs would seek to spread criminal enterprise throughout the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] would surely erode any trust they may have earned.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$我们会让事情看起来像是，[root.target.GetName]正在滥用他们的商贸协定，将[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的商品以更高的价格又卖了回去。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are abusing their commercial pact by re-selling [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] goods at a steep mark-up.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$我们应该散布十分可信的谣言，暗示[root.target.GetName]在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的心脏区域植入了子例程，能够操纵其商贸系统为自己所用。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ We shall concoct credible rumors that the [root.target.GetName] has implanted subroutines within the heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], manipulating its financial systems to its own ends.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$有关[root.target.GetName]囤积了大量便宜的[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]仿制商品的证据肯定能够引起激烈的反向。这样的行为对于他们核心的商品产业将是一次重大的攻击。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ Evidence that the [root.target.GetName] have stocked warehouses full of cheap imitations of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] wares is sure to provoke a response. It would appear to be a credible attack on their core, mercantile industry.

entries.zh: 我们会让事情看起来像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]实体，这将损害他们目前赢得的信任。
entries.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to undermine the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] entity, eroding any trust they may have earned so far.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$比如，打捞费洛蒙和其他生物资产，意在使用其对付[target.GetGestaltEntityName]……
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ For example: scavenging pheromones and other biological assets for use in schemes against the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]...

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$我们会揭露[root.target.GetName]正谋划着以某种方式转化[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]，彻底地抹除蜂群的人格主权。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ We will expose an idea that the [root.target.GetName] plot to somehow consume the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], eradicating its personal sovereignty.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$有关在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的首都走私有毒物质的密谋细节好像可以激发恐惧与猜忌。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ Details of a plot to smuggle toxins onto the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] capital are likely to provoke fear and suspicion.

entries.zh: 我们会让事情看上去像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于颠覆[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]智能体。
entries.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to subvert the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] intelligence.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$我们应当伪造证据，称[root.target.GetName]国内有一整个部门致力于捕获和操纵[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We shall fabricate evidence of an entire department within the [root.target.GetName], dedicated to the capture and manipulation of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$我们会暗示[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机正在被捕获用于训练练习，作为[root.target.GetAdj]计划未来某一天对机械智能发动直接攻击的一部分。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We will suggest that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones are being captured for training exercises, as part of a [root.target.GetAdj] scheme to one day launch a direct attack on the machine intelligence.

entries.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ 我们应当播下猜忌的种子，让人们认为[root.target.GetName]正在通过[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的后门盗取研究数据。
entries.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We shall sow seeds of suspicion that the [root.target.GetName] are actively stealing research via backdoors into the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation_smear_campaign$：行动就绪
entries.en: $operation_smear_campaign$: Ready to Proceed

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经准备好要把有关[root.target.GetName]的坏消息传递给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。我们已经做了一切努力，以确保这些错误信息的可信度，并防止从它追踪到我们。
entries.en: Our operatives are ready to deliver damning news about the [root.target.GetName] to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We have done all we can to ensure the fidelity of this misinformation - and to keep it from being traced back to us.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.GetAdj]的诋毁运动
entries.en: [fromfrom.GetAdj] Smear Campaign

entries.zh: 话已经放出去了；我们关于§H[from.target.GetName]§!夸大的事实现在沿着§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]§!的外交通道扩散出去。
entries.en: The word is out; our exaggerated truth about the §H[from.target.GetName]§! is now working its way through §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]§! diplomatic channels.

entries.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的侮辱显然让双方的关系紧张了起来，他们对[from.target.GetName]抱有的任何不信任感也进一步恶化。
entries.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ This insult to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is sure to strain their relationship, and worsen any distrust they may already hold for the [from.target.GetName].

entries.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$我们负责这方面的特工将会动用手段确保，位于[from.target.GetName]的人如果想要重新赢得任何方面的信任，一定会遇到重重困难。
entries.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ Our operatives have worked to ensure those in the [from.target.GetName] will have a hard time regaining any trust they might have earned.

entries.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$\n\n我方特工捏造了一份证据，指明[from.target.GetName]负有针对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]谍报活动的责任。我们应当拭目以待，看他们对于这样一个政治上造成伤害的宣言有何表示。
entries.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$\n\nOur operatives have fabricated evidence that the [from.target.GetName] are guilty of espionage against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We shall see how they respond to such a politically damaging allegation.

entries.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$任何宣称要操纵他们的格式塔意识的企图都会引起反感。我们的特工会动用手段，确保这样的膈应能持续更久一些。
entries.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ Any such allegation of attempting to manipulate their gestalt consciousness is bound to cause upset. Our operatives have worked to ensure the sting will be felt for some time yet.

entries.zh: 诋毁运动被发现
entries.en: Smear Campaign Detected

entries.zh: §Y[smear_campaign_target.GetName]§!在§H[from.GetName]§!树敌多多。
entries.en: The §Y[smear_campaign_target.GetName]§! appear to have enemies in the §H[from.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $operation.3010.desc.intro$我们的加密协议最近发现了一个与我们[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居有关的，“匿名”通讯。这一奇特的通讯使我们认为他们在密谋针对我们的侵略和秘密行动。\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$
entries.en: $operation.3010.desc.intro$ Our Encryption protocols have flagged a recent, 'anonymous' communication about our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors, designed to have us believe they were plotting aggressive and covert actions against us.\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们现在面临着一个选择：把我们所知道的关于这一骗术的零星信息通告给[smear_campaign_target.GetName]；或者保持沉默，相信我们对付敌对间谍的能力。即使我们掩盖了我们能力的真实水平，我们还是可以把这个可疑的敌人引出来——但前提是我们根据他们提供的信息采取行动，就好像它们是真的一样。
entries.en: We now face a choice: expose what little we know about this deception to the [smear_campaign_target.GetName], or else keep quiet about our ability to cope with hostile espionage. Even if we do mask the true extent of our abilities, we may still draw this shady enemy out - but only if we act upon the information they've supplied as though it were genuine.

entries.zh: 独自行动。我们将会保留这出戏给自己。
entries.en: Play along. We'll keep this deception to ourselves.

entries.zh: 提醒[smear_campaign_target.GetName]。
entries.en: Inform the [smear_campaign_target.GetName].

entries.zh: [smear_campaign_target.GetName]或许会选择以政治上的§Y支持§!来回报我们。
entries.en: The [smear_campaign_target.GetName] may choose to reward us with political §YFavors§!.

entries.zh: $operation.3010.name$
entries.en: $operation.3010.name$

entries.zh: $operation.3010.desc.intro$我们在加密工作中已经标记了一系列奇怪且难以溯源的信息。这中间包含了一堆诽谤我们的黑材料，据说是我们的[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居写的——但经过核对确认之后，我们发现这实际上是第三方精心伪造的。\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$
entries.en: $operation.3010.desc.intro$ Our Encryption protocols have flagged a series of strange and almost-anonymous messages. They comprise a dossier of slander against us, supposedly authored by our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors - but the assertions are, in fact, elaborate fakes.\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

entries.zh: $operation.3010.name$
entries.en: $operation.3010.name$

entries.zh: $operation.3010.desc.intro$我们仔细审查了近来一条源头“不明”的信息，该信息意图揭露一项[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]针对我们的阴谋的细节——该阴谋事实上是完全凭空捏造的。我们的加密协议已经被证明是十分有效的，并揭露了一个[from.GetAdj]的阴谋。\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$
entries.en: $operation.3010.desc.intro$ We scrutinized a recent communication from an 'anonymous' source, whose intent was to expose an elaborate [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] scheme against us - only it is, in fact, a complete fabrication. Our Encryption protocols have proven resilient, and reveal a [from.GetAdj] plot beneath.\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 诋毁运动被曝光
entries.en: Smear Campaign Exposed

entries.zh: §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!希望在我们之间散布不信任。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$
entries.en: The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§! wish to sow distrust between us.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

entries.zh: §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份措辞巧妙的档案，提及§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!，声称其意图对我们不利。若这份[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]文件可信，则说明[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]意图以我们的名义散布谣言以破坏我们与[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的关系。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$
entries.en: The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have approached us with a delicately-worded dossier on the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!, who seem to wish us ill. If the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] files are to be believed, the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] intended to damage any relationship between us and the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] by seeding slanderous lies in our name.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

entries.zh: §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份档案，揭露了一个精心策划的阴谋，有人企图在我们两个帝国之间制造裂痕。§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!很有可能就是罪魁祸首。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$
entries.en: The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! has delivered a dossier to us, exposing an elaborate plot which was intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. The §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§! are named as its would-be perpetrators.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
entries.en: Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

entries.zh: 或者他们声称……
entries.en: Or so they claim...

entries.zh: 我们欠[from.GetName]一笔。
entries.en: We owe the [from.GetName] a debt.

entries.zh: 小队待命
entries.en: Team on Standby

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向§H[target.GetName]§!重大灾难。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the §H[target.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组，他们将设法把§P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§!引诱至§H[target.GetAdj]§!领土上。预计将全队覆灭。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives who will seek to lure the §P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§! directly into §H[target.GetAdj]§! territory. The team is not expected to return.

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]这次报告道，§Y没有危机级别威胁§!被这样一次行动引诱到。[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]所召集到的特工将保持待命，直到我们对这个肆虐整个星系的毁灭灾厄有了更进一步的了解。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that at this time, §Yno crisis-level threats§! are likely to be lured in by such an operation. The operatives [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] assembled will remain on standby until we know more about the catastrophic threats lurking in this galaxy.

entries.zh: 引诱§P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Draw in the §P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 骗走§P[crisis_beacon_option_2.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Lure the §P[crisis_beacon_option_2.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 触怒§P[crisis_beacon_option_3.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Bait the §P[crisis_beacon_option_3.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 前进暗号
entries.en: Sign of Progress

entries.zh: 我们的研究员与特工们已准备好应对各种任务突发变数，特遣队也已前往§Y[target.GetAdj]§!与§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!之间的未知区域。
entries.en: Our researchers and operatives have prepared for a wide variety of mission variables, and the task team has departed for an uncharted region of space between §Y[target.GetAdj] territory§! and the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 大鱼上钩
entries.en: Baited Lure

entries.zh: 我们在§H[target.GetName]§!附近的特工们发出了一条单方面通讯：他们已经准备好继续执行任务，一但我们发出指令，他们就将去触怒§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Our operatives near the §H[target.GetName]§! have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§! upon our signal.

entries.zh: [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]已上钩
entries.en: The [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName], Hooked

entries.zh: 我们的研究者只能假设我方特工迅速而见机行事的思路奏了效，因为他们成功地引诱了一艘来自$CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$威胁的舰队。无论是通过精妙的骇入协议，亦或是通过伪造某种形式的漏洞超载，我们的遥测扫描已经确认§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间传来了敌对的信号传输。\n\n无论§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!在这个纷乱的时间点是否还有其他的顾虑：我们的行动保证他们至少又多了一件事可以操碎他们的心。
entries.en: Our researchers can only speculate upon the quick and adaptive thinking employed by our operatives when they successfully lured a fleet from the ongoing $CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$ threat. Whether by an elaborate protocol hacking or by fabricating some sort of loophole override, our remote scans now confirm a hostile presence in transit between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.\n\nWhether or not the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! have other ongoing concerns during these turbulent times: our actions have ensured they shall have at least one more pressing matter to attend to.

entries.zh:
吸引这个所谓的§P灰蛊风暴§!这样零散的实体的注意力，并不是什么难事。我们的特工成功地通过一个单发的、调制的载波成功地把灰蛊风暴指向了§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!。

构建这个波充满挑战，因为§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都之间距离很长，使得§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!需要前所未有的能量维持。我们的团队采用了在一个远程发射器的电源组中触发一个不可控的连锁反应。该装置保持在一起的时间刚好足以将我们的诱饵传送到超空间。

长距离遥测显示纳米虫群正向着§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!前进。我们的研究人员还注意到在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]附近发生了灾难性爆炸，这应该是我们的那位特工的功劳。
entries.en:
Drawing the focused attention of entities as piecemeal as this so-called §PGray Tempest§! was no mean feat. Our operatives succeeded by way of a one-shot, modulating carrier wave pointed squarely in the direction of the §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!.

Constructing this wave was a fraught effort, as the distance between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! requires an unprecedented amount of energy. Our team resorted to triggering an uncontrollable chain reaction in the power banks of a long-range transmitter. The device held together just long enough to beam our lure across hyperspace.

Long-distance telemetry suggests that a Nanite Swarm is now making its way towards the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!. Our researchers also note readings of a catastrophic explosion in the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] - believed to be the site of our operatives' fatal endeavor.

entries.zh: 尽管他们最近表现得很团结，§P[raider_khanate.GetName]§!最后还是证明了自己只是头脑简单的猎捕者，轻易就被愤怒钓上了钩。我们的小队想方设法激怒了某位指挥官，后者正甚嚣尘上地以超光速杀向[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!。\n\n我们的特工很确信任何倒霉到竖立在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]之间的恒星基地都会作为东道主给这支掠夺者小分队表演一下什么叫做热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们希望这次牺牲没有白费。
entries.en: Despite their recent attempts at unity, §Pthe [raider_khanate.GetName]§! have proven an uncomplicated prey to bait in anger. Our team worked hard to antagonize one Commander in particular, whose boiling rage is now being directed at faster-than-light speeds toward the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.\n\nOur operatives are resolute that any starbase unfortunate enough to lie between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will play chaotic host to this small band of marauders. Let us hope this sacrifice is not in vain.

entries.zh:
我们对§P$CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$§!的生物引擎研究的时间虽然不长，但是被证明十分有效。我们发明了一种合成化合物——生产起来很昂贵，运输起来也很困难——但是能够成功诱使一支舰队偏离虫群。

这种化合物的附着性是如此之强，我方特工的命运现在就和竖在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间的恒星基地一样惨烈。一旦我方特工释放这种诱骗性的化合物，他们的命就没了。

相比于四散而逃并搅乱虫群的路线，我们的小队决定花费剩余的时间确保没有留下任何行动的痕迹。§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!很快就会尝到我们的牺牲带来的后果。
entries.en:
Our research into the biological drives of the §P$CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$§! was conducted swiftly, but has proven effective. We devised a synthetic compound - expensive to produce, and dangerous to transport - which has succeeded in luring a fleet away from the Swarm.

So adhesive is this compound that the fate of our operatives is now as bleak as that of any starbase which lies between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!. The moment our operatives released the beguiling chemical, their fate was sealed.

Rather than flee and risk confusing the swarm's route, our team will instead spend what remaining time they have ensuring that the trail remains intact. The §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! will soon experience the results of our sacrifice.

entries.zh: 我们对抗§P$CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$§!的努力终于有了成果，尽管代价十分的惨重。我们的特工成功地诱使一支异次元舰队认为他们在[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]领土腹地的一个次元锚正处于威胁。舰队现在正从§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!向§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!开拔。\n\n$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]会继续监视这一形势，但是看样子我们是没法见到我们的特工活着返回了。我们必须密切关注，并相信我们的诱敌方案有利于我们的计划。
entries.en: Our efforts against the §P$CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$§! have paid off, though the cost was certainly steep. Our operatives have successfully duped an extra-dimensional fleet into thinking one of their dimensional anchors is under threat, deep inside [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] territory. Ships are now en route to §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! from the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§!.\n\n$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will continue to monitor the situation, but it is unlikely we will see our operatives returned to us. We must now watch, and trust that our lure serves our plan.

entries.zh: §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]§!现在正位于前往§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§!的路线上。
entries.en: The §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]§! is now en route to the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital§!.

entries.zh: [crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]朝[root.capital_scope.GetName]行动
entries.en: [crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName] on Course for [root.capital_scope.GetName]

entries.zh: 我们探测到了来自§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!的敌对信号，正朝着我们的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!笔直地杀过来！奇怪的能量波动从§H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!的附近爆发，我们猜测这是他们的源头。\n\n当这个区域的能量信号突然发生变化时，我们才刚刚开始分析这一现象。所有的信号都显示这是舰队移动突然发生了改变。此外，中间至少有一个能量信号看上去不属于[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。无论他们是谁，看上去正是他们导致了这样的行为。我们怀疑这是我们的某个星系对手搞得§H祸水东引§!动作。
entries.en: We detect a hostile presence from the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!, heading straight for our capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of §H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!, their assumed origin.\n\nWe had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be §Hprovocative action§! by one of our galactic rivals.

entries.zh: 失去联络
entries.en: Contact Lost

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于§H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。\n\n按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the §H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.\n\nIn accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

entries.zh: 找到我们的特工。
entries.en: Find our operatives.

entries.zh: 暂停§Y[from.GetName]行动§!，时间为一个月。\n我们的成功几率取决于目标的§H加密§!等级。
entries.en: Pauses §YOperation [from.GetName]§! for about a month.\nOur chances of success depend on the target's §HEncryption§! level.

entries.zh: 暗地里§R取消§!这一行动，所有未花费的§H线人§!将不会被消耗。
entries.en: Silently §Rcancel§! this operation. Any unspent §HAssets§! will not be consumed.

entries.zh: 请求我们本地的援助。
entries.en: Call in our local Asset.

entries.zh: 联络重建
entries.en: Contact Re-Established

entries.zh: 我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!经营而布置好的监视流程。
entries.en: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 联络人确认失踪
entries.en: Contact Confirmed Lost

entries.zh: 尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的特工的通讯。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的§H加密§!手段比我们估计的还要高明。\n\n于此同时，§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated §HEncryption§! than we had thought.\n\nMeanwhile, §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.

entries.zh: 特工受惊
entries.en: Operative Spooked

entries.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在§H[from.GetName]§!行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
entries.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for §HOperation [from.GetName]§! - as such, $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

entries.zh: 这种风险是很平常的。放着吧。
entries.en: Such risks are normal. Denied.

entries.zh: 我们会给你们资助的。
entries.en: You shall have your extra resources.

entries.zh: 送点礼说不定更有用呢？
entries.en: Perhaps bribery would be more effective?

entries.zh: 让我们的线人处理这个问题。
entries.en: Have our Asset handle this problem.

entries.zh: 被[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]拘押
entries.en: Apprehended by [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]

entries.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!刚刚注意到了我方存在，并引起了警觉。看上去我们对当地的情报了解不足，我们的特工已经引起了当地[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]的注意。\n\n这次§H[from.GetName]行动§!还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。
entries.en: The §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! is not truly jeopardized yet, but $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requires speedy assistance.

entries.zh: 我们必须相信纵横之术。
entries.en: We must trust in diplomacy.

entries.zh: 部署我们的线人。
entries.en: Deploy our Asset.

entries.zh: 外交解决方案
entries.en: A Diplomatic Solution

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]和[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的同事们消除了因我们特工入侵§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!产生的尴尬。\n\n有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.\n\nIt's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.

entries.zh: 我们已经通过外交斡旋解决了我们侵入§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!所引起的一些外交误会。\n\n有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
entries.en: We have successfully negotiated our way out of the diplomatically awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.\n\nIt's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] does not lend any credibility to our excuses at all, but from an outside perspective: we are considered to be 'in the clear' for now.

entries.zh: 多相力场
entries.en: Multi-Phasic Force Fields

entries.zh: 当特工在稳步进入§H[from.target.GetName]§!更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
entries.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.

entries.zh: 我们应当尝试并去适应。
entries.en: We shall have to try and adapt.

entries.zh: 我方行动可能成功，也可能遭受挫折，成功率取决于我们的相对§Y科技等级§!。
entries.en: We may succeed or suffer operational setbacks, depending somewhat on our relative §Ytechnology level§!.

entries.zh: 让他们自己的硬件转而对付他们。
entries.en: Turn their own hardware against them.

entries.zh: $operation.5015.name$
entries.en: $operation.5015.name$

entries.zh: 我们失去了指派给对于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!中所有人员的联系。无论是被我们的目标算计，还是单纯遇到了不幸的巧合，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的屏蔽科技都是一个相当棘手的对手。\n\n[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]在这场事件中存在获得收益的可能性。尽管我们的特工[GetOperativesLowerPlural]能够做到半自主，但是没有了我们的出面引导，这些子个体可能会更加容易落到敌人手中。
entries.en: We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.\n\nIt is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our [GetOperativesLowerPlural] may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.

entries.zh: 误作美食
entries.en: Mistaken for Food

entries.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
entries.en: A primal aspect of the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.

entries.zh: 我们得把它骗走开。
entries.en: We should lure it away.

entries.zh: 继续行动！我们会适应这个，然后生存下去。
entries.en: Keep moving! We adapt and survive.

entries.zh: 将猎手反杀。部署§Y$asset_warrior_drone$§!。
entries.en: Hunt the hunter. Deploy the §Y$asset_warrior_drone$§!.

entries.zh: 有毒的现场作业
entries.en: Toxic Field Work

entries.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到§H[from.GetName]行动§!中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。$operation.5025.close$
entries.en: Something about the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§!. $operation.5025.close$

entries.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的生存环境发生了微妙的改变，这再次对我们产生了轻微的毒性。$operation.5025.close$
entries.en: There has been a subtle change within the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! living environment, which has once again become mildly toxic to us. $operation.5025.close$

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
entries.en: Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile [from.target.GetGestaltEntityName].

entries.zh: 我们得想个法子。
entries.en: We should research a solution.

entries.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。
entries.en: We must continue with haste.

entries.zh: 存在一定风险，使在§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得§R更加困难§!，直到我们成功开发了抗体。
entries.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! may become §Rmore difficult§! for a time, until we can develop antibodies.

entries.zh: 缓解的现场工作
entries.en: Remedy for Field Work

entries.zh: 我们研究人员的努力有了成果，治疗特效药被分发给了我们的子个体特工。§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!居住地发现的那种低浓度毒素应该不会再给我们的§H[event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]行动§!造成困扰了。
entries.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and remedies are being distributed to our drone operatives. The low-level toxins found in §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! habitats should no longer present any issues, and §HOperation [event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]§! may continue.

entries.zh: 有毒的现场作业继续
entries.en: Toxic Field Work Persists

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!的机会之窗已经关闭了！我们的子个体已经难以承受环境的影响。§H[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动§!会继续，但我们必须小心行事以避免我们的特工被怀疑。
entries.en: Our window of opportunity inside the §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! has closed, leaving our operative drones visibly affected by their environment. §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! may continue, but we must work carefully lest our allergies arouse suspicion.

entries.zh: 多余的噪声
entries.en: Excess Noise

entries.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。$operation.5030.close$
entries.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. $operation.5030.close$

entries.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境再一次充满了静电噪声，我们对这样的频率尚且不能适应。$operation.5030.close$
entries.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has once again become riddled with electrostatic noise, in frequencies we are not yet accustomed to. $operation.5030.close$

entries.zh: 我们向§H[from.GetName]行动§!派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
entries.en: The disguised drones we have assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§! are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.

entries.zh: $operation.5025.a$
entries.en: $operation.5025.a$

entries.zh: $operation.5025.b$
entries.en: $operation.5025.b$

entries.zh: 存在一定风险，使在§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得§R更加困难§!，直到我们的硬件产生了适应性。
entries.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§! may become §Rmore difficult§! for a time, until we can adapt our hardware.

entries.zh: 多余噪声消除
entries.en: Excess Noise Cancellation

entries.zh: 我们的研究努力取得了回报，新的电磁屏蔽护盾参数已经分发到了我们位于§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!的间谍网中。我们§H[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动§!的工作将不会在遇到阻碍。
entries.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and specifications for new shielding against electromagnetic interference are being distributed throughout our operative network in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!. Our efforts on §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! should no longer be hindered by excess static.

entries.zh: 过度杂音仍在
entries.en: Excess Noise Persists

entries.zh: 在§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!上的电磁杂波已经导致了我们的一些特工的不可逆转的数据损失。§H[event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]行动§!或许可以继续，但我们的工作将被拖延——需要相当的工作量来保证我们的数据可信。
entries.en: Electrostatic noise in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§! has now caused irreparable data loss amongst some of our drones. §HOperation [event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]§! may continue, but our efforts are being hindered - such is the scale of backlogged demands upon our data validation processes.

entries.zh: 扼杀
entries.en: Snuffed Out

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于§Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的$role_spymaster$坚信这支小队是失踪了。\n\n如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，§H[from.GetName]行动§!可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的§H$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!的优势。
