entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the §Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our $role_spymaster$ is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our §H$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§! against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

entries.zh:
暂停§Y[from.GetName]行动§!，持续时间一个月。

我们的行动有§H低到中§!的几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!。

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_THEMED_ASSET$
entries.en:
Pauses §YOperation [from.GetName]§! for about a month.

There is a §Hmedium-to-low§! chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on our target's §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_THEMED_ASSET$

entries.zh:
§R取消§!§Y[from.GetName]行动§!。

我们的行动有§G高§!几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!。

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_CATEGORY_ASSET$
entries.en:
§RCancels§! §YOperation [from.GetName]§!.

There is a §Ghigh§! chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_CATEGORY_ASSET$

entries.zh: $operation.5000.c$
entries.en: $operation.5000.c$

entries.zh: 暂停§Y[from.GetName]行动§!，持续时间一个月。\n\n我们的行动有§Y中到高§!的几率不会被注意到。我们成功的几率随着目标的§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!的提高而下降。
entries.en: Pauses §YOperation [from.GetName]§! for about a month.\n\nThere is a §Yhigh-to-medium§! chance our actions will go unnoticed. Our odds of success decrease the higher our target's §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§! is.

entries.zh: 潜伏成功
entries.en: Successful Cover-Up

entries.zh: 尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的$role_spymaster$亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。\n\n与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。
entries.en: Though it has greatly taxed the resources of $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!, operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our $role_spymaster$'s watchful gaze.\n\nThe [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

entries.zh: 行动暴露
entries.en: Operation Exposed

entries.zh: 我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!失去的特工曝光了我们大部分§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!的细节。\n\n我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。
entries.en: Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has exposed large parts of §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§!.\n\nAll our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

entries.zh: 我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。\n\n我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。
entries.en: The recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.\n\nOur Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

entries.zh: 资源耗尽
entries.en: Drain on Resources

entries.zh:
最近$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。因此，他们的追求与忠诚背道而驰。

在$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]重整部门风气前，有关§H行动[from.GetName]§!的一切项目均被暂时搁置。
entries.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.

Progress on §HOperation [from.GetName]§! has been put on hold for the moment, until $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

entries.zh: 是可忍孰不可忍，给予其强烈斥责。
entries.en: This cannot be tolerated. Issue reprimands.

entries.zh: 处理这些特工。
entries.en: Dispose of these operatives.

entries.zh: 我们可以化腐朽为神奇。
entries.en: This could give us an interesting edge.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们同一时间内只能开办一家这样的秘密企业。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe can only run one such secret enterprise at a time.§!

entries.zh: §R只有在与[from.target.GetName]签订§Y商业协定§!后我们才能利用这个机会。§!
entries.en: §RSuch an opportunity can only be exploited if we have a §YCommercial Pact§! with the [from.target.GetName].§!

entries.zh: 特工尽了本分
entries.en: Operatives Toe the Line

entries.zh: 我们位于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的特工不再使用我们间谍网的资源。对效忠对象的坚定提醒，重新激发了特工们的奉献精神；他们将把他们的聪明才智完全用于我们的事业。
entries.en: Our operatives in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! are no longer skimming resources from our Spy Network allocation. Firm reminders of just where their loyalties lie have reinvigorated the operatives' sense of dedication; they will turn their resourceful talents wholly to our cause.

entries.zh: 特工断绝关系
entries.en: Operatives Cut Ties

entries.zh: $role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]遗憾的报告：我们失去了§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的间谍网。\n\n当我们特工中的一群小偷被要求解释原因时，他们的反应是逃跑——分散到[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的宇域里，那些甚至连我们都难以监控的地方。[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]不再能够追踪他们——至少没法在不引发注意的情况下找到。
entries.en: $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! Spy Network.\n\nWhen a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.

entries.zh: 特工叛逃
entries.en: Operative Defects

entries.zh: 我们位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择§R叛逃§!。
entries.en: Our $role_spymaster$ in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to §Rdefect§!.

entries.zh: $operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\n看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。
entries.en: $operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\nIt seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

entries.zh: $operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\n尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。
entries.en: $operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\nDespite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.

entries.zh: 就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们会得到针对他们阴谋的警告。$tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$
entries.en: If the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. $tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$

entries.zh: 把你的屋子整好了，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]！
entries.en: Get your house in order, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]!

entries.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们有50%几率得到针对他们阴谋的警告。$tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$
entries.en: 50% chance that if the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. $tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$

entries.zh: 我们能够确保[from.target.GetName]不会收到存在针对他们阴谋的可靠证据。
entries.en: We can ensure the [from.target.GetName] will not receive credible evidence of a plot against them.

entries.zh: 令人讨厌的反制措施
entries.en: Grisly Countermeasures

entries.zh: 一位位于§Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§!的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。
entries.en: An operative in the §Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§! has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

entries.zh: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。
entries.en: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nTheir injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

entries.zh: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n无人机遭受严重的损害，但依旧完成了任务并保持隐蔽状态。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们的特工在对方的监察下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
entries.en: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nThe drone has sustained serious damage, but has completed its task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains under their supervision, the greater the risk of exposure.

entries.zh: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n他现在没法跑太远，除非我们在行动接下来的时间中给予除基本支援外的更多援助，这样他才能确保找到一个足够安全的藏身处。然而不久之后这片区域肯定会进行清理式扫荡。我们的特工呆在[from.target.owner.GetAdj]疆域下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
entries.en: $operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nThey are currently unable to move far or else lend more than basic support to the rest of the operation, so they have secured a reasonably safe hideout. There is, however, bound to be a maintenance sweep of the area before long. The longer our operative remains in [from.target.owner.GetAdj] care, the greater the risk of exposure.

entries.zh: 着手安排撤出行动。
entries.en: Arrange for an extraction.

entries.zh: 我们必须抛下他继续前进。
entries.en: We must proceed without them.

entries.zh:
§R取消§!§Y[from.GetName]行动§!

我们的行动有§G高§!几率不会被注意到，这取决于目标的§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!。

如果我们为该行动分配一位§Y破坏型线人§!就能确保成功。
entries.en:
§RCancels§! §YOperation [from.GetName]§!.

There is a §Ghigh§! chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

Success is guaranteed if we have a §YSabotage Asset§! assigned to this Operation.

entries.zh: 信任危机
entries.en: Confidence Wavers

entries.zh: 同调紊乱
entries.en: Synchronicity Wavers

entries.zh:
一队位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于§H[from.GetName]行动§!甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[operation.leader.GetHeSheCap]同样也承认可能只是他们的洞察力过分敏锐罢了。

$operation.5055.desc.outro$
entries.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.

$operation.5055.desc.outro$

entries.zh:
一组位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工在执行分配给它们的任务时进度开始滞后，并做出一些能被解析为怀疑的行动。我们通常直接命令$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]来解决此事，但这些特工表现得它们似乎能察觉到§H行动[from.GetName]§!中所埋藏的阴谋，也许还有整个间谍网也在它们的知情范围内。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们更为活跃的代理个体保持隔离，我们怀疑有外部势力在向它们灌输信息。然而，如果可能的话，它们与自主代理个体的趋同或许能够赋予它们自己一种我们今后有机会将其利用到的洞察力。

$operation.5055.desc.outro$
entries.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun lagging in their assigned tasks, displaying behavior which could be interpreted as doubt. We would typically handle such matters directly through $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName], but this group acts as though it can perceive the wider machinations of §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active agents, we suspect they are being fed information from an outside source. It is, however, also possible that their proximity to independent agents may simply have endowed these operatives with the kind of insight we may one day find useful.

$operation.5055.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。
entries.en: Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.

entries.zh: 风险过高；切断联系。
entries.en: The risks are too great; cut them loose.

entries.zh: 那就让我们看看这些“洞察力”会带来什么吧。
entries.en: Let us see where these 'insights' may lead.

entries.zh: 以下其一将会发生：\n-暂时以§Y[target_country.GetName]§!为目标§G降低行动难度§!  或是\n-暂时§R降低$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!。
entries.en: Will result in either:\n- temporarily §Gdecreased Operation Difficulty§! in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! or\n- a temporary §Rreduction in $MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 打破砂锅问到底
entries.en: Unwavering Insight

entries.zh: 我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工们在发现自己从前难以形容的怀疑并不是无中生有后，便以加倍的热情投入进工作中。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仍然对他们维持了严格的信息屏蔽，但报告称[operation.leader.GetHisHer]的运作变得前所未有的流畅。
entries.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have applied themselves with unusual fervor upon learning that their once-intangible suspicions were founded in a real cause after all. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] maintains a strict information quarantine, but reports that [operation.leader.GetHisHer] supply lines have never been smoother.

entries.zh: 惊慌失措的特工
entries.en: Panicked Operatives

entries.zh: 在得知此前难以形容的怀疑并非无中生有后，我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工表现得惊惧起来。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仅仅只是向他们透露了些许关于全局的信息，就足以打乱行动的运作。现在我们破坏[target_country.GetAdj]$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$的能力将在接下来的一段时间内下降。
entries.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have reacted with horror upon learning the truth of their once-intangible suspicions. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$ is reduced for a time.

entries.zh: 狂欢的反对派
entries.en: Carnival Protestors

entries.zh: 第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。\n\n尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。
entries.en: Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, and demand adaptations to accommodate a future reshaped by this revelation.\n\nThough non-violent, the sheer scale of these movements has placed a strain on civic services and disrupted daily life. However, many citizens do not see these protests as mere disorder. They see them as a reckoning, a sign that our very identity is being rewritten before our eyes.

entries.zh: 不采取行动。
entries.en: Take no action.

entries.zh: 鼓励参与。
entries.en: Encourage participation.

entries.zh: 授权暴力。
entries.en: Authorize brute force.

entries.zh: 镇压这些意见分子。
entries.en: Pacify the dissenters.

entries.zh: 动员基层响应。
entries.en: Mobilize a grassroots response.

entries.zh: 让团结的集会走上街头。
entries.en: Flood the streets with unity rallies.

entries.zh: 组织反向抗议。
entries.en: Organize a counter protest.

entries.zh: 将其说成是一种注意力分散。
entries.en: Frame it as a distraction.

entries.zh: 将会铲除宣泄派
entries.en: This will eradicate the Manifesti

entries.zh: 宣泄派
entries.en: The Manifesti

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的示威来得快去得也快。现在许多人把矛头指向了§H宣泄派§!，这个以挑战社会规范的挑衅性作品而闻名的神秘团体。虽然他们的参与尚未得到证实，但他们最新的作品都集中在所谓的第一次接触的后果上，这加剧了争议和动荡。\n\n虽然示威已经结束，但是§H宣泄派§!依然存在。他们的信息广为流传、影响持久。现在是决定我们如何应对的时候了。
entries.en: The protests on [Root.GetName] have ceased almost as suddenly as they began. Many now point to §HThe Manifesti§!, a shadowy collective known for provocative works that challenge societal norms. While their involvement remains unconfirmed, their latest projects have fixated on the alleged consequences of first contact, fueling both controversy and unrest.\n\nThough the demonstrations have ended, §HThe Manifesti§! remain. Their message spreads, their influence lingers. The time has come to decide how we respond.

entries.zh: 让他们玩去吧。
entries.en: Let them have their fun.

entries.zh: 宣布戒严。
entries.en: Declare Martial Law.

entries.zh: 把他们的作品熔成资源。
entries.en: Melt down the projects for resources.

entries.zh: 宣布他们是虚空的使者。
entries.en: Declare them messengers of the void.

entries.zh: 干扰行星范围通讯。
entries.en: Disrupt planet wide communications.

entries.zh: 找到他们的家人然后拘留起来。
entries.en: Locate and detain their families.

entries.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动
entries.en: the arrests killing off the movement

entries.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动，但激起了不满和破坏
entries.en: the arrests killing off the movement but also triggering civil unrest and devastation

entries.zh: 防患于未然
entries.en: Nipped in the Bud

entries.zh: §H宣泄派§!不会再给我们添麻烦了。快速而强硬的镇压粉碎了这场运动，使组织四分五裂，信息噤声。他们所谓的“艺术”也被取缔了，领袖消失不见。\n\n秩序恢复了，人们下次见到这种鲁莽的意识形态时会三思而后行。
entries.en: §HThe Manifesti§! will trouble us no longer. A swift and decisive crackdown has dismantled their movement, scattering their members and silencing their message. Their so-called 'art' has been seized, their leaders disappeared.\n\nOrder is restored, and the people will think twice before embracing such reckless ideology again.

entries.zh: 感情没有价值，但资源有价值。宣泄派的所谓“项目”已经被没收、拆除，并被重新用于更有意义的地方。随着他们的集会点消失，这场运动失去了动力。
entries.en: Sentiment holds no value, but resources do. The so-called 'projects' of the Manifesti has been confiscated, dismantled, and repurposed for more practical use. With their rallying points gone, the movement has lost momentum.

entries.zh: §H宣泄派§!的反抗不仅仅是叛逆，而是一种标志，是一条来自虚空本身的信息。我们应该倾听，而不是让他们噤声。他们的一位成员已经被选中加入我们的政府，将享受最舒适的生活，因为是他们引导我们才对宇宙有了更深的理解。
entries.en: §HThe Manifesti's§! defiance is no mere rebellion but a sign, a message from the void itself. Rather than silence them, we shall listen. One among them has been chosen to join our governance, where they will enjoy the finest comforts as they guide us toward a deeper understanding of the cosmos.

entries.zh: 只要失去了言语载体，反对意见便无法传播。关闭了行星范围通讯后，我们切断了这些反对者的协调能力。没有了外部势力的引导，他们的运动很快就会崩溃。\n\n不幸的是，通讯关闭也影响了执法部门完成任务的能力。
entries.en: Dissent cannot spread if there is no voice to carry it. By shutting down planetary communications, we have severed the protesters' ability to coordinate. Without guidance from foreign elements, their movement is sure to collapse.\n\nUnfortunately, the communications shutdown has also impacted the ability of law enforcement to perform its duties.

entries.zh: 持不同意见也是家事。我们通过拘留主要煽动者的亲属来迫使§H宣泄派§!屈服。他们的意志被打破后，领头人也被拘留了，这场运动已经崩溃。\n\n秩序恢复了，我们的权威不容置疑。
entries.en: Dissent is a family matter. By detaining the relatives of key agitators, we have forced §HThe Manifesti§! into submission. With their will broken and their leaders in custody, the movement has collapsed.\n\nOrder is restored, and our authority stands unquestioned.

entries.zh: 展览被悄悄拆除，创作者受到谴责，更具煽动性的作品被没收。我们通过官方渠道向其他国家保证，这种破坏性的言论并不反映我们的国家政策。\n\n虽然一些人谴责此举是文字狱，但大多数人现在明白了一个简单的事实。如果威胁到了帝国的稳定，言论自由就要受到限制。
entries.en: The exhibition was quietly dismantled, its creators reprimanded, and its more inflammatory pieces confiscated. Official channels assured our alien counterparts that such disruptive rhetoric does not reflect state policy.\n\nWhile some decry the move as censorship, most now understand a simple truth. There are limits to free expression when the stability of the empire is at stake.

entries.zh: §H宣泄派§!的家人们被拘留了，而运动的领头人也因此很快被镇压。然而，公众的反应却不是顺从，而是愤怒。抗议活动愈演愈烈，不再局限于单纯的示威，而是演变为暴力骚乱。
entries.en: The families of §HThe Manifesti§! have been detained, and with them, the movement's leadership has been effectively neutralized. Yet, instead of compliance, the public's response has been one of outrage. Protests have grown fiercer, no longer confined to mere demonstrations but erupting into violent unrest.

entries.zh: 希望这样一场闹剧就此结束。
entries.en: Let us hope that's the end of such nonsense.

entries.zh: 意料之中的风险。
entries.en: A calculated risk.

entries.zh: 千言万语，离经叛道
entries.en: A Thousand Words, None Official

entries.zh: 一种人为制造的语言开始在艺术中心和学术机构传播，这是对官方语言的刻意拒绝。这种由§H宣泄派§!创造的语言的使用者拒绝承认我们语言的合法性，认为它是不过一种在第一次接触之后就无法自诩正统的社会符号。\n\n行政官们警告称，越来越多的人拒绝以既定的方式进行沟通，这可能会加深分歧，破坏公共话语的稳定。
entries.en: A fabricated language has begun spreading through art centers and academic institutions, a deliberate rejection of the official tongue. Created by §HThe Manifesti§!, its speakers refuse to acknowledge the legitimacy of our language, seeing it as a symbol of a society that can no longer define itself in the wake of first contact.\n\nOfficials warn that this growing refusal to communicate in established terms risks deepening divisions and destabilizing public discourse.

entries.zh: 花钱让他们闭嘴。
entries.en: Buy their silence.

entries.zh: 不守规矩就扣工资。
entries.en: Withhold pay from nonconformists.

entries.zh: 跟上这个潮流。
entries.en: Partake in the trend.

entries.zh: 鼓励语言多元化。
entries.en: Celebrate linguistic diversity.

entries.zh: 促进对话，避免分裂。
entries.en: Foster dialogue, not division.

entries.zh: 明镜鉴人
entries.en: Mirrors, Brightly

entries.zh:
§H宣泄派§!已经公布了他们最为公开的展览的日期。这是一次位于[this.GetName]的全新且极其受欢迎的互动体验，邀请参观者操控他们自己的反射镜像，以及创造由扭曲的政治人物形象组成的拼贴画——其中一些甚至来自于§H其他的星际帝国§!。

批评家们认为这些画作是我们对自己自我感的一次必要和严厉的审视。这次展览还激发了许多其他形式的讽刺艺术，其主题涵盖诸多国内议题和泛物种关系。

我们的社会研究者掀起了激烈的讨论；一些保守的声音要求我们谨慎处理。
entries.en:
§HThe Manifesti§! have unveiled their most public exhibition to date. A new and extremely popular interactive experience on [this.GetName] invites visitors to manipulate reflections and images of themselves, and to create distorted collages of political figures - some from §Hother galactic empires§!.

Critics herald these pieces as casting a necessarily and harsh light upon our sense of self. The exhibition has also inspired a number of other satirical works both on domestic issues, and on pan-species relations.

Debate amongst our social researchers is lively; more conservative voices urge caution.

entries.zh: 一次大胆的表达。
entries.en: A bold statement.

entries.zh: 这简直就是一次外交灾难的前夕。赶紧全部封杀。
entries.en: A diplomatic disaster waiting to happen. Shut them down.

entries.zh: 宣泄主义的兴起
entries.en: Rise of the Manifestists

entries.zh: 关于所谓的“宣泄主义”启发了一个全新派系形成的留言四起。随着我们在第一次接触后对宇宙和自身在其中地位的理解的陷入质疑，它的支持者们开始挑战既定的规范。他们提倡激进的自我表达和对社会结构的根本重新评估。现有的派系抱怨称自己的集会受到了宣泄派煽动者的干扰，这些人对政府的无情挑战正在[Root.GetName]播下不和的种子。
entries.en: Rumors spread that a new faction is emerging, driven by the ideals of 'Manifestism.' In the aftermath of first contact, as our understanding of the universe and our place within it comes into question, its proponents challenge established norms. They advocate for radical self-expression and a fundamental reevaluation of societal structures. Existing factions complain that their gatherings are being disrupted by Manifestist agitators, whose relentless challenges to governance are sowing discord across [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 这是不可避免的
entries.en: It was inevitable.

entries.zh: 允许§H宣泄派§!§Y派系§!
entries.en: Enables §HThe Manifesti§! §YFaction§!

entries.zh: 接纳宣泄主义。
entries.en: Embrace Manifestism.

entries.zh: 宣布该团体非法。
entries.en: Outlaw the group.

entries.zh: 噤声消散
entries.en: A Hush Descends

entries.zh: §Y宣泄派§!发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。\n\n尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。
entries.en: The buzz surrounding §YThe Manifesti§! faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.\n\nAttendance at galleries and museums has never been higher, but the public gaze has already moved on to newer, controversial groups of artists. We will continue to sift through the data gathered during this strange moment in [root.GetAdj] cultural history.

entries.zh: 生活还是要继续的，没办法。
entries.en: Life goes on, apparently.

entries.zh: 一瞬而逝的异想天开。
entries.en: Fleeting whimsy.

entries.zh: 他们的成员在各种无政府议题上表达了五彩缤纷的抗议，要求建立一个更富表达和平等的社会。\n\n
entries.en: Their members have sparked colorful protests on various anarchic issues, demanding a more expressive and egalitarian society.\n\n

entries.zh: 作为让这个派系入驻政府的结果，他们成为了非主流的§H平等主义§!者。\n\n
entries.en: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become eccentrically §HEgalitarian§!.\n\n

entries.zh: 宣泄派的崛起
entries.en: Rise of the Manifesti

entries.zh: 离经叛道、扰乱人心的公开展览点饰着[owner.GetName]的日常。他们的出发点看上去是好的，艺术上极具表现力——但是这种艺术对于我们社会更广泛的层面会造成什么样的影响呢？
entries.en: Day-to-day life in the [owner.GetName] is colored by eccentric and disruptive public displays. Their purpose appears benign, and artistically expressive - but what influence might this art have on our wider society?

entries.zh: 宣泄主义氛围
entries.en: Manifesti Vibes

entries.zh: 再次露面的特工
entries.en: Operative Resurfaces

entries.zh: 一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新传送到了我方，这涉及到我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!已经开展的行动。\n\n某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报，此人宣称携带了关于一个位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记——但是，这些早已作废的代码能够信任吗？
entries.en: A long-expired set of covert codes has been re-transmitted to us, linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!.\n\nA once-disavowed operative is apparently trying to report back in, claiming to possess intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] - but can these expired codes be trusted?

entries.zh: 变革之风
entries.en: Winds of Change

entries.zh: 公开示威成了寻常景观，抗议与庆祝交织在一起，扰乱了日常生活。
entries.en: Public demonstrations have become a common sight, blending protest with celebration and disrupting daily routines.

entries.zh: 语言异议
entries.en: Lingual Dissent

entries.zh: 一种虚构的语言成为抗议的形式，他们拒绝官方话语，加深社会分歧。与当局的沟通越来越紧张。
entries.en: A fabricated language has taken hold as a form of protest, rejecting official discourse and deepening societal divides. Communication with authorities is growing strained.

entries.zh: 文化镇压
entries.en: Cultural Suppression

entries.zh: 反对意见被噤声，破坏性的作品被移除。政府的强硬手段巩固了社会稳定，但是损害了艺术表达和公信力。
entries.en: Dissenting voices have been silenced, and disruptive art has been removed. The state's firm response has reinforced stability, but at the cost of creative expression and public trust.

entries.zh: 反射内心
entries.en: Deep Reflections

entries.zh: 一处受人欢迎的宣泄派艺术机构邀请参观者们体验他们对自我的概念，以及他们是怎么看待其他人的，在社会科学方面更新了许多有趣点。
entries.en: A popular Manifesti art installation invites visitors to play with their concepts of selfhood and how they perceive others, renewing interest in the social sciences.

entries.zh: 梦境显昭
entries.en: Dreams Become Manifesti

entries.zh: 前卫的宣泄派艺术团体被解散了，剩下的只有社会学案例研究的记录和不入流的无政府平民。
entries.en: The avant-garde Manifesti group has disbanded, leaving behind a legacy in sociological case studies and low-level civilian anarchy.

entries.zh: 忠诚破碎
entries.en: Fractured Loyalties

entries.zh: 抗议活动引发了广泛的讨论，引发了对示威者及其诉求的同情。
entries.en: The protests ignite widespread debate, fostering sympathy for the demonstrators and their demands.

entries.zh: 授权发声
entries.en: Empowered Voices

entries.zh: 我们对抗议者的公平对待加强了公众对平等主义理想的支持。
entries.en: Our fair treatment of the protesters has strengthened public support for egalitarian ideal.

entries.zh: 维护和谐
entries.en: Harmony Preserved

entries.zh: 我们对抗议活动的和平反应增强了民众的和平主义理想。
entries.en: Our peaceful response to the protests has reinforced pacifist ideals among the populace.

entries.zh: 文化包容
entries.en: Cultural Embrace

entries.zh: 我们对抗议活动的宽容态度促进了开放和理解，加强了民众中的亲外主义理想。
entries.en: Our tolerant approach to the protests has fostered openness and understanding, strengthening xenophile ideals among the populace.

entries.zh: 切断纽带
entries.en: Severed Ties

entries.zh: 由于行星通讯被切断，外部影响已被根除，颠覆分子难以组织起来。现在这些不受外界干涉的民众变得更加封闭，对外部思想更加警惕。
entries.en: With planetary communications severed, foreign influence has been eradicated, and subversive elements struggle to organize. The populace, now shielded from outside interference, grows more insular and wary of external ideas.

entries.zh: 一位前§Y宣泄派§!领袖变成了先知，声称在虚空中瞥见了隐藏的真相。
entries.en: A former §YManifesti§! ringleader turned prophet, they claim to have glimpsed a hidden truth in the void.

entries.zh: 解雇一名前§Y宣泄派§!头目将毁谤导致该运动解散的协议。
entries.en: Dismissing a former §YManifesti§! ringleader would dishonor the agreement that led to the movement's dissolution.

entries.zh: 教授服从
entries.en: Lesson in Obedience

entries.zh: 大规模的逮捕行动传递了清晰的信息，我们会不惜一切代价维持秩序。恐惧和服从扎根，民众越来越接受强硬手段为代价创造的稳定。
entries.en: The mass arrests have sent a clear message that order will be upheld at any cost. Fear and obedience take root, and the populace grows more accepting of firm governance as the price of stability.

entries.zh: 支持宣泄派
entries.en: Manifesti Endorsed

entries.zh: 我们通过接纳宣泄派将其资本表达和社会变迁的观念合法化。公共话语正在转变，对平等主义价值观的支持正在上升。
entries.en: By embracing the Manifesti, we have legitimized their ideals of free expression and societal change. Public discourse is shifting, and support for egalitarian values is on the rise.

entries.zh: 镇压宣泄派
entries.en: Manifesti Suppressed

entries.zh: 宣泄派运动已被强行解散，这发出了一个明确的信息，即异见不会被容忍。在威权主义理念获得支持的同时，水面之下，公众的不安情绪暗流涌动。
entries.en: The Manifesti movement has been forcibly dismantled, sending a clear message that dissent will not be tolerated. While authoritarian ideals gain traction, public unrest festers beneath the surface.

entries.zh: 宣泄派
entries.en: Manifesti Faction

entries.zh: 宣泄派的目标不同寻常，又极其多样，渴求自由的表达以及无差别对待的改革社会结构。\n\n§L平等主义思潮§!
entries.en: Manifesti Factions hold to unusual and diverse goals, desiring freedom of expression and non-discrimination within reformed social structures.\n\n§LEgalitarian Ethos§!

entries.zh: 自由之水主义
entries.en: Alluvio-Liberalism

entries.zh: $MANIFESTI_RIVERS_MOVEMENT$
entries.en: $MANIFESTI_RIVERS_MOVEMENT$

entries.zh: [root.GetName]会乐于见到水在任何形式下都能无限制的移动，无论是冰川、沼泽还是海洋。
entries.en: It will please the [root.GetName] to see unrestricted movement of water in all its forms as glaciers, swamps and oceans.

entries.zh: 军用品个人自决权
entries.en: Personal Autonomy for Munitions

entries.zh: $MANIFESTI_MUNITIONS_AUTO$
entries.en: $MANIFESTI_MUNITIONS_AUTO$

entries.zh: [root.GetName]激进地认为军事舰船应该被赋予自主智能，这样才能让舰船在部署时获得自由的选择权。
entries.en: The [root.GetName] are keen for military vessels to be granted sapience, and thus liberty of choice in the manner of their deployment.

entries.zh: 云里雾里的头脑
entries.en: Heads in the Clouds

entries.zh: $MANIFESTI_CAREFREE_SCIENCE$
entries.en: $MANIFESTI_CAREFREE_SCIENCE$

entries.zh: [root.GetName]断言§Y技术研究§!应当信任一个由无拘无束的漫游者组成的有远见的委员会。
entries.en: The [root.GetName] assert that §Ytechnology research§! should be entrusted only to a visionary council of carefree roamers.

entries.zh: 视网膜画廊
entries.en: Gallery of the Retina

entries.zh: $MANIFESTI_RETINAL_FOCUS$
entries.en: $MANIFESTI_RETINAL_FOCUS$

entries.zh: 保持£consumer_goods£$CONSUMER_GOODS$生产赤字能够取悦[root.GetName]，因为这能让我们的公民免受他们所谓的“衣来伸手，饭来张口的腐蚀”。
entries.en: It will please the [root.GetName] to keep £consumer_goods£ $CONSUMER_GOODS$ production in deficit, keeping our citizens free of what they call 'the Ready-Made Scourge'.

entries.zh: 沉默的伙伴
entries.en: Silent Partner

entries.zh: $MANIFESTI_SILENT_PARTNER$
entries.en: $MANIFESTI_SILENT_PARTNER$

entries.zh: 张扬政治或外交权力但拒绝行使，参与星际的争霸而不是派遣特使，这样能够取悦[root.GetName]。
entries.en: It will please the [root.GetName] to wield political or diplomatic power and refuse to deploy it, engaging in staring contests instead of sending envoys.

entries.zh: 隐秘羞辱
entries.en: Scandalous Insult

entries.zh: 我们无意中从§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!抓获了一个代表，其把他们帝国对我们的真实感受泄露给另一个匿名团体。这相较于通常的政治诽谤更为过分：已称得上是§P公然的侮辱§!，看来我们在[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]社会中已经是成了被大肆嘲笑的对象。\n\n不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场。
entries.en: We have caught a delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! in a rare blunder, letting slip their empire's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party. More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an §Poutright insult§!, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] society.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground.

entries.zh: 一名来自§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!的代表无意中透露了他们的格式塔国家在背地里对我们的真实感受。对于一个格式塔意识而言，盘算政治诽谤这种事显得尤为狭隘，因而这些对我们来说称得上是§P荒谬且有力§!的侮辱。\n\n不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场，并反对这种离奇的[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]行为。
entries.en: A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has let slip their gestalt's true feelings about us, apparently when in conference with other, anonymous parties. Given how petty it must be for a combined consciousness to even contemplate so-called 'political mud-slinging', these strike us as an §Pabsurd and potent insult§!.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground against this bizarre [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] behavior.

entries.zh: 一名来自§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!的代表在与某匿名团体的会议上，竟敢说出他们那可怜的帝国对我们的真实感受。\n\n这种§P荒谬的侮辱§!企图贬低我们，不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：我们的自尊都要求我们不能容忍它。
entries.en: A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has dared to let slip their pitiful empire's true feelings about us, apparently while in conference with other, anonymous parties.\n\nThis §Pabsurd insult§! seeks to belittle us, and whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: pride demands that we not stand for it.

entries.zh: 这简直骇人听闻！
entries.en: This is an outrage!

entries.zh: 我们没空管这些滑稽的把戏。忽略掉。
entries.en: We are above such antics. Ignore them.

entries.zh: 他们不值得受到我们的轻蔑。
entries.en: They are not worthy of our scorn.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.100.name$
entries.en: $envoy_events.100.name$

entries.zh: §H[from.GetName]§!说我们的一名官员的不轨行为让他们§P被冒犯§!。他们没有指出这位官员的名字，也没有描述侮辱的类型。相反，我们在收到了一阵怒骂后，通讯就突然中断了。\n\n这种罕见的外交破裂可能是因为一些其他势力的干预；也可能是纯粹的误解。
entries.en: The §H[from.GetName]§! say they have §Ptaken offense§! at a misdemeanor carried out by one of our officials. They have not named the official, nor even described the nature of the insult. Instead we have received little more than a burst of indignation, and an abrupt end to communications.\n\nIt's possible that this rare breach in diplomacy is the work of some other, meddling party; it could just as easily be an honest misunderstanding.

entries.zh: 不管怎样，外交都变得更加困难了。
entries.en: Either way, diplomacy just got trickier.

entries.zh: 魅力十足的特工
entries.en: Influential Operatives

entries.zh: 我们位于该间谍网中的特工开始炙手可热起来，他们的魅力将使得§G行动更容易进行§!，但同时暴露的风险有所上升，§R$MOD_SPY_NETWORK_DAILY_VALUE_ADD$也会减少§!。
entries.en: Our operatives within this Spy Network are unusually popular. Their charisma ensures that §GOperations are made easier§!, but the increased risk of exposure §Rreduces our $MOD_SPY_NETWORK_DAILY_VALUE_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 误作美食
entries.en: Mistaken for Food

entries.zh: 我们的特工正在被我们渗透的实体的某个主脑猎捕，它们不能在同一个地方停留太久时间。
entries.en: Our operatives are being hunted by primal aspects of the very entity we're spying on, and thus they cannot linger in one place for long.

entries.zh: 有毒的现场作业
entries.en: Toxic Field Work

entries.zh: [toxic_field_country.GetAdj][toxic_field_country.GetGestaltEntityName]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。直到我们开发出抗体之前，特工的功能都会有所损伤。
entries.en: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] [toxic_field_country.GetGestaltEntityName] is mildly toxic to our own operatives. There will be an impairment of function until we can develop adequate antibodies.

entries.zh: 多余的噪声
entries.en: Excess Noise

entries.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的星球环境充满了多余的静电噪声——远比我们能够习惯的要多。在我们能够重新对受影响的硬件进行重新排线之前，我们特工的功能都会有所损伤。
entries.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with excessive electro-static noise - far more than we are currently accustomed to. There will be an impairment of function until we can re-route key functions around our affected hardware.

entries.zh: “有创业精神”的特工断绝关系
entries.en: Enterprising Operatives Cut Ties

entries.zh: 我们的一批特工被抓到挪用我们的情报资金来进行期货和金融投资。当勒令他们中止的时候，他们选择和我们断绝关系。
entries.en: A group of our operatives was caught re-investing goods and currencies from our intelligence-gathering budget. When we called them out on it, they chose to cut ties with us.

entries.zh: 严格筛查特工
entries.en: Rigorous Screening of Operatives

entries.zh: 在最近一次叛逃事件后，我们的$role_spymaster$目前更加小心，加强了对于新特工的筛查力度。
entries.en: In the wake of a recent defection, our $role_spymaster$ is currently taking greater care over the screening of new operatives.

entries.zh: 令人讨厌的反制措施
entries.en: Grisly Countermeasures

entries.zh: 我们负责破坏的特工身上的伤痕引起了当地安保部门的怀疑。
entries.en: Injuries which were sustained by one of our operative saboteurs have since raised suspicions amongst local security.

entries.zh: 擅长发现的辅助性特工
entries.en: Insightful Auxiliary Operatives

entries.zh: 一队洞察力极度敏锐的辅助性特工正在帮助我们确保行动的顺利进行。
entries.en: A group of unusually insightful auxiliary operatives is helping to ensure the smooth running of our operations.

entries.zh: 失去辅助性特工
entries.en: Lost Auxiliary Operatives

entries.zh: 由于解雇了一批似乎知道得太多的辅助性特工，我们的资源开始变得紧张起来。
entries.en: Our resources are strained by the recent dismissal of a group of auxiliary operatives who appeared to know too much.

entries.zh: 他们知道得太多了
entries.en: Auxiliary Operatives Knew Too Much

entries.zh: 一批辅助性特工发觉到他们在体系中的作用并将其讲述出来，我们的部分间谍网因此暴露。
entries.en: Parts of our Spy Network have been exposed after a group of auxiliary operatives realized their part in it, and decided to speak out.

entries.zh: 失去联络
entries.en: Contact Lost

entries.zh: 和早前的特工失去联络使得我们这个行动的进度有所倒退。
entries.en: Losing contact with our earlier operatives has set back progress on this Operation.

entries.zh: 多相干扰
entries.en: Multi-Phasic Interference

entries.zh: 我们不断地失去和我们特工的联系，因为他们在接触我方目标的本地屏蔽科技时经常会遭受不寻常的副作用。
entries.en: We keep losing contact with our operatives as they suffer unusual side-effects when dealing with our target's local shielding technology.

entries.zh: 特工负伤
entries.en: Operative Injured

entries.zh: 我们的特工被这座恒星基地上隐藏的安保措施弄伤。我们的进度和维持隐蔽的能力都受到了损害。
entries.en: Our operative was injured by countermeasures hidden aboard this starbase. Our progress and ability to maintain cover are both being hampered.

entries.zh: 研究后门
entries.en: Research Backdoor

entries.zh: 我们已经抓住了一个将后门安装在一个外国研究数据库上的机会。那些科学家现在等于是为我们服务了。
entries.en: We have seized an opportunity to install backdoor access into a foreign power's research database. Their science shall service ours.

entries.zh: 找到加密钥
entries.en: Found Encryption Key

entries.zh: 我们的一名特工最近找到了一枚加密钥，似乎是被外国势力误放的。研究其内部构造能够帮助我们理解全新的解密技术。
entries.en: One of our operatives recently found an encryption key, mislaid by a foreign power. By studying its workings we have gained insight into novel decryption techniques.

entries.zh: 丢失的加密钥
entries.en: Lost Encryption Key

entries.zh: 我们的一名$job_politician_plural$最近将一堆机密物料错放，其中还有正在使用的加密钥。我们的国内安全现在受到了威胁。
entries.en: One of our $job_politician_plural$ recently misplaced a bundle of confidential materials, including a live encryption key. Our domestic security has been compromised for the time being.

entries.zh: 免职官员
entries.en: Dismissed Official

entries.zh: 对加密密钥丢失负有责任的官员已被立即免职。其继任者将接受更为彻底的审查。
entries.en: The official responsible for the loss of an encryption key has been promptly sacked. Their replacement will be more thoroughly vetted.

entries.zh: $espionage_straycomm_sacked_official$
entries.en: $espionage_straycomm_sacked_official$

entries.zh: $espionage_straycomm_sacked_official_desc$
entries.en: $espionage_straycomm_sacked_official_desc$

entries.zh: 蒸蒸日上的间谍网
entries.en: Enterprising Spy Network

entries.zh: 我们某个间谍网内的一帮特工被抓到利用本地商贸大发横财。我们的$role_spymaster$将他们的黑市运作所得划入进了直接受益。
entries.en: A gang of operatives within one of our Spy Networks were caught exploiting local commerce. Our $role_spymaster$ has leveraged their black market enterprise for our direct benefit.

entries.zh: 研究破坏
entries.en: Research Sabotaged

entries.zh: 敌方渗透者已经混淆了我们的数据库，拖延了我们正在进行的工作，减慢了我们取回已存在数据的进度。现在需要更多时间来重新整合我们的研究。
entries.en: Enemy infiltrators have upended our research databases, delaying our ongoing work and slowing down retrieval of existing data. It will take time to re-integrate our studies.

entries.zh: 除名被捕特工
entries.en: Disavowed Operative Caught

entries.zh: 隐秘羞辱
entries.en: Scandalous Insult

entries.zh: 滥用信任
entries.en: Abuses of Trust

entries.zh: 开展谍报工作
entries.en: Conducting Espionage

entries.zh: 暴露了我方隐蔽活动
entries.en: Exposed Our Covert Activities

entries.zh: 勒索支持
entries.en: Extorted Favors

entries.zh: 宣传诽谤运动时被逮正着
entries.en: Caught Propagating a Smear Campaign

entries.zh: 有毒的现场作业
entries.en: Toxic Field Work

entries.zh: [toxic_field_country.GetAdj]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。通过研究毒性的效果，我们可以开发出一个疗法缓解这个情况，同时还能规避我们的特工在视觉上暴露给目标[toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural]的风险。
entries.en: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] habitat is mildly toxic to our own operatives. By studying its effects, we can develop a remedy and so avoid the risks associated with having visibly-allergic [toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside their hive.

entries.zh: 多余的噪声
entries.en: Excess Noise

entries.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetName]为自己创造的环境产生了比我们预计还要多的静电噪声。我们的伪装无人机时不时经历数据丢失。通过研究这些非正常频域的频率，我们可以对我们的特工无人机进行重新调制，使得其能够维持高功能性并避免在力场中被检测到。
entries.en: The environment which the [excess_noise_country.GetName] creates for itself generates more electrostatic noise than we had anticipated. Our disguised drones are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. By studying these errant frequencies, we can re-tune our operative drones to maintain higher function and avoid detection 'in the field'.

entries.zh: 任期限制
entries.en: Term Limits

entries.zh: 提名监管人
entries.en: Nominate Custodian

entries.zh: 需要决定性举措时，可以将一位理事会的成员推举位星海监管人。监管人具有被赋予特殊的权力并可以提出新的强力议案。
entries.en: When decisive action is needed, a member of the Council can be elevated to the position of Galactic Custodian. The Custodian is granted special powers and can propose new and powerful resolutions.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£我们必须完全独立才能成为监管人。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ We must be fully independent to serve as Custodians.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£监管人职位审查将会暴露我们对星系的图谋……
entries.en: £trigger_no£ The scrutiny of a Custodianship would expose our plans for the galaxy...

entries.zh: £trigger_no£他们必须完全独立才能成为监管人。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ They must be fully independent to serve as Custodians.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£他们不愿意接受我们的提议。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ They are unwilling to accept our proposal.

entries.zh: 宣告星海帝国成立
entries.en: Proclaim the Galactic Imperium

entries.zh: 尽管监管人尽了极大的努力，星海共同体仍然因为内部各行其是而遭受严重削弱。设想一下，如果整个星系可以被一个强大的领袖团结起来，我们将无所不能。一个前所未有的和平而繁荣的时代近在咫尺。
entries.en: Despite the tremendous efforts of the Custodian, the Galactic Community is still undermined by internal division. Think of all that could be accomplished if the galaxy were united under strong leadership. An unprecedented era of peace and prosperity is within our reach.

entries.zh:
§Y星海共同体§!将变为§Y星海帝国§!。
§R所有成员离开所有既有联邦。§!

§R§Y[Root.GetName]§!将成为§Y帝国核心§!，思潮向§Y威权主义§!转移，并且采纳§Y帝制§!政体。所有不兼容的§Y国民理念§!将被移除。§!
entries.en:
The §YGalactic Community§! changes into the §YGalactic Imperium§!.
§RAll members leave any existing Federations.§!

§RThe §Y[Root.GetName]§! becomes the §YImperial Core§!, shifting towards §YAuthoritarianism§! and adopting an §YImperial§! government. All incompatible §YCivics§! are removed.§!

entries.zh: 宣告觉醒星海帝国
entries.en: Proclaim the Awakened Galactic Imperium

entries.zh: 星系中的这些年轻又天真的小国在蹒跚学步时需要有一双大手来牵着。
entries.en: The empires in this galaxy are too young and inexperienced. They require a guide in these trying times.

entries.zh:
§Y星海共同体§!变为了§Y星海帝国§!。
§R所有成员离开所有既有的联邦。§!

§Y[Root.GetName]§!成为了§Y觉醒帝国§!。
entries.en:
The §YGalactic Community§! changes into the §YGalactic Imperium§!.
§RAll members leave any existing Federations.§!

The §Y[Root.GetName]§! becomes the §YAwakened Emperor§!.

entries.zh: 统一战线
entries.en: A United Front

entries.zh: 我们的星系面临严重威胁，摆在我们面前的只有一个简单的选择：同生，或共死。我们应该搁置争议，共享敌人的情报，同仇敌忾。
entries.en: The threat our galaxy faces presents us with a simple choice: stand together, or die alone. We shall fight as one, sharing information about the enemy and putting old grudges aside.

entries.en: $resolution_custodian_united_front$

entries.en: $resolution_custodian_united_front_desc$

entries.zh: 星海动员令
entries.en: Galactic Mobilization

entries.zh: 我们星系的命运千钧一发。我们必须尽快动员巨量的舰队，即便征召民间的商业船员也在所不惜。
entries.en: The future of our galaxy is at stake. Massive fleets of war must be rapidly mobilized, even if it means the impressment of civilian merchant crews.

entries.zh: 引入星海标准语
entries.en: Introduce Galactic Standard

entries.zh: 星海标准语是一种针对所有具有不同生理特征的智慧生物设计的简单易用的的新语言。为星海共同体所有职能部门制定统一用语有望避免一切的翻译事故。
entries.en: Galactic Standard is a new language that has been specifically designed for ease of use by all sapients regardless of their physiology. By introducing a single language to all official Galactic Community functions, it is hoped that translation mishaps may be avoided.

entries.zh: 反海盗倡议
entries.en: Anti-Piracy Initiative

entries.zh: 猖獗的太空海盗行为威胁着全星系的经济健康。通过此倡议，所有共同体成员将受到有效的反海盗举措教育。同时我们还将举行联合军演开发战斗技巧，以在面对普遍缺乏纪律性的海盗和掠夺者的船员时获取优势。
entries.en: Rampant space piracy threatens to undermine the economic well-being of the entire galaxy. With this initiative, all Community members will be educated in effective anti-piracy measures. Joint efforts to develop combat tactics that take advantage of the general lack of discipline among pirate and marauder crews will also be undertaken.

entries.zh: 监管人连任
entries.en: Extend Custodianship

entries.zh: 创造一个更好的星系是一件需要持续投入时间的伟大事业。如果有任何持续效应的事务需要完成，那么当前的监管人就需要连任。
entries.en: Making the galaxy a better place is a monumental task that takes time. The current Custodianship needs to be extended by another term if anything with lasting effects is to be accomplished.

entries.zh: 当前的§Y监管人§!获得连任，任期将延长§Y30年§!。
entries.en: The term limit of the current §YCustodians§! is extended by another §Y30 years§!.

entries.zh: 取消监管人任期限制
entries.en: Remove Custodianship Term Limit

entries.zh: 当前的监管人毫无疑问是共同体不可替代的守护者。他们对星系的忠诚服务应当被允许无限延长。
entries.en: The current Custodians have proven themselves irreplaceable guardians of the Community. Their stalwart service to the galaxy must be allowed to continue indefinitely.

entries.zh: 当前的§Y监管人任期§!将会无限延续。
entries.en: The current §YCustodianship§! will continue in perpetuity.

entries.zh: 结束监管人任期
entries.en: End Custodianship

entries.zh: 星海共同体不再需要一位监管人了。为此，当前的任期需要在其自然结束之前提前终止。
entries.en: The Galactic Community no longer has a need for a Custodian. As such, the Custodianship should be terminated before the term limit is up.

entries.zh: §Y监管人任期§!提前终止。
entries.en: The §YCustodianship§! ends prematurely.

entries.zh: 泛星系防卫军
entries.en: Galactic Defense Force

entries.zh: 为了更好地保卫共同体成员，应当建立一支由星海监管人统一指挥的常驻多国联合部队。
entries.en: To better protect the members of the Community, a standing multinational force under the unified command of the Galactic Custodian must be established.

entries.zh: $resolution_custodian_gdf$
entries.en: $resolution_custodian_gdf$

entries.zh: 泛星系防卫军扩军
entries.en: GDF Expansion

entries.zh: 泛星系防卫军的规模应当大幅扩增以应对持续增长的任务规模。
entries.en: The size of the Galactic Defense Force must be greatly increased if it is to meet the ever-increasing scope of its mission.

entries.zh: 解散泛星系防卫军
entries.en: Disband the GDF

entries.zh: 泛星系防卫军已经完成了它们的历史使命，现在应当被遣散。
entries.en: The Galactic Defense Force has served its purpose and should now be demobilized.

entries.zh: 星际导航局
entries.en: Interstellar Navigation Agency

entries.zh: 星际导航局将会强制推行星际旅行的标准和推荐方案，并将维系一个庞大的数据库，记录全部已测绘的共同体恒星系中所有已知的太空威胁。
entries.en: The INA will enforce standards and recommended practices for space travel, and will maintain a massive database of every known space hazard in all charted Community systems.

entries.zh: 解散星际导航局
entries.en: Disband the Interstellar Navigation Agency

entries.zh: 星际导航局是一个无效且开支庞大的组织。它没有继续存在下去的必要。
entries.en: The INA is an inefficient and expensive organization. Its continued existence cannot be justified.

entries.zh: 星系贸易组织
entries.en: Galactic Trade Organization

entries.zh: 星系贸易组织将作为一个推行贸易准则和调解争端的星系规制实体。
entries.en: The GTO will serve as a galactic regulatory body that enforces trade standards and resolves disputes.

entries.zh: 解散星系贸易组织
entries.en: Disband the Galactic Trade Organization

entries.zh: 必须阻止星系贸易组织的横加干涉。贸易市场可以产生自范性规则。
entries.en: The meddling of the GTO must come to an end. Trade has a way of regulating itself.

entries.zh: 星系刑警组织
entries.en: GALPOL

entries.zh: 星系刑警组织的建立将能确保整个星海共同体的执法部门可以通力协作。
entries.en: The creation of a galactic criminal police organization will enable law enforcement agencies to cooperate across the entire Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 解散星系刑警组织
entries.en: Disband GALPOL

entries.zh: 决不允许星际刑警组织变成星海共同体统治精英的“秘密警察”。它必须被立刻解散。
entries.en: GALPOL must not be allowed to become the "secret police" of the Galactic Community's ruling elite. It should be disbanded at once.

entries.zh: 帝国机构
entries.en: Imperial Institutions

entries.zh: 帝国海军
entries.en: Imperial Armada

entries.zh: 从整个帝国当中征召兵源，帝国海军将会成为整个星系有史以来最强大的太空舰队。
entries.en: With recruits conscripted from the entire Imperium, the Imperial Armada shall be the mightiest space fleet the galaxy has ever seen.

entries.zh: 帝国海军扩编
entries.en: Imperial Armada Expansion

entries.zh: 为了帝国的荣耀，帝国海军的规模必须扩大！
entries.en: The size of the Imperial Armada must be increased, for the greater glory of the Imperium!

entries.zh: 建立帝国军团
entries.en: Imperial Legions

entries.zh: 成为帝国军团士兵效忠星系是无上的荣耀。从全帝国的军队中万里挑一，帝国军团将被训练成为极度忠诚的地面部队。
entries.en: There is no greater honor than to serve the galaxy as an Imperial Legionnaire. Drawn from the cream of all military recruits across the entire Imperium, the Legions are drilled and conditioned into a fanatically loyal ground force.

entries.zh: 帝国安全总局
entries.en: Imperial Security Directorate

entries.zh: 和平、稳定、秩序，这就是星海帝国成立所依托的要义。无论是犯罪、恐怖主义和分离主义，犯我帝国者，安全总局虽远必诛。
entries.en: Peace, stability, order - the very tenets on which the Galactic Imperium was founded. The ISD will hunt down criminals, terrorists, and seditionists wherever they may be hiding.

entries.zh: 帝国贸易公司
entries.en: Imperial Trade Company

entries.zh: 帝国贸易公司将会在帝国章程下运作，它的管理和董事会成员在星海帝皇的直接掌控之下。
entries.en: The ITC will operate under an Imperial Charter and its management and board of directors shall be under the direct control of the Galactic Emperor.

entries.zh: 帝国议会
entries.en: Imperial Council

entries.zh: 通过适格试炼
entries.en: By Trial of Advancement

entries.zh: 应当可以通过适格试炼来挑战帝国议会成员的席位，以免他们因将自身地位视作理所当然而懈怠。骄傲自满和软弱无力都必须从帝国的上层梯队中剔除。
entries.en: Lest they are taken for granted, it should be possible to challenge the members of the Imperial Council for their seats in a Trial of Advancement. The complacent and the meek must be weeded out from the upper echelons of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 获得针对帝国议会成员的§Y“适格试炼”§!宣战理由。
entries.en: Grants the §Y'Trial of Advancement'§! casus belli on members of the Imperial Council.

entries.zh: 通过钦点
entries.en: By Appointment

entries.zh: 帝国议会的成员必须以效忠于他们的帝皇陛下为荣幸，而陛下则可自由地从他的忠诚的臣民中挑选。
entries.en: The members of the Imperial Council must serve at the pleasure of Their Imperial Majesty, who should be free to pick from amongst all of the Imperium's loyal subjects.

entries.zh: 星海帝国的统治者拥有权力钦点任何人入席帝国议会。
entries.en: The ruler of the Imperium is free to appoint whomever they want to the Imperial Council.

entries.zh: 通过选举
entries.en: By Election

entries.zh: 如同过去的星系理事会，帝国议会的成员应当依照他们的获得投票数选出。
entries.en: As in the old Galactic Community, the members of the Imperial Council should be elected based on their voting power.

entries.zh: 帝国议会的席位将由基于§Y外交权重§!的常规选举产生。
entries.en: Membership in the Imperial Council is determined through regular elections based on §YDiplomatic Weight§!.

entries.zh: 帝国导航局
entries.en: Imperial Navigation Agency

entries.zh: 星际导航局将会强制推行星际旅行的标准和推荐方案，并将维系一个庞大的数据库，记录全部已测绘的星海帝国恒星系中所有已知的太空威胁。
entries.en: The INA will enforce standards and recommended practices for space travel, and will maintain a massive database of every known space hazard in all charted Imperium systems.

entries.zh: 解散帝国导航局
entries.en: Disband the Imperial Navigation Agency

entries.zh: 指派星海监管人
entries.en: Galactic Custodian Appointed

entries.zh: 终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。\n\n作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
entries.en: At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.\n\nAs the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

entries.zh: 星海参议院投票通过授予§H[custodian.GetName]§!紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。\n\n作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
entries.en: The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the §H[custodian.GetName]§!. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.\n\nAs the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

entries.zh: 现在我们可以大有作为了。
entries.en: Now we can get things done.

entries.zh: 让我们看看这样会如何。
entries.en: We shall see how this works out.

entries.zh: §Y[custodian.GetName]§!成为了§Y星海共同体监管人§!
entries.en: The §Y[custodian.GetName]§! are now §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

entries.zh: 监管人任期结束
entries.en: The End of the Custodianship

entries.zh: 我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
entries.en: Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

entries.zh: 随着他们的任期结束，§H[former_custodians.GetName]§!放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
entries.en: With their term at an end, the §H[former_custodians.GetName]§! has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

entries.zh: 这样就好。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!不再是§Y星海共同体监管人§!。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! are no longer §YCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.

entries.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
entries.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

entries.zh: §H[former_custodians.GetName]§!提前结束了他们在星海共同体中的监管人任期。似乎他们并不愿意承担监管人的责任。
entries.en: The §H[former_custodians.GetName]§! has prematurely ended their term as Custodians of the Galactic Community. It seems the responsibilities of the Custodianship weren't to their liking.

entries.zh: 我们已经尽我们所能了。
entries.en: We have done our part.

entries.zh: 一群虎头蛇尾的家伙。
entries.en: A bunch of quitters.

entries.zh: 监管人陨落
entries.en: Custodians No More

entries.zh: 随着§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
entries.en: With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.

entries.zh: 监管人被除名！
entries.en: Custodians Unseated!

entries.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
entries.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

entries.zh: 在通过突然且充满羞辱的方式剥夺了他们的监管权之后，星海参议院多数投票统一立即将§Y[From.GetName]§!从星海监管人职位移除。他们被剥夺了星海共同体赋予的特殊权力。
entries.en: In a sudden and humiliating end to their Custodianship, the Galactic Senate majority has voted to immediate remove the §Y[From.GetName]§! from the office of Galactic Custodian. They have been stripped of their special Community powers.

entries.zh: 这简直骇人听闻！
entries.en: This is an outrage!

entries.zh: 此事到此为止。
entries.en: That is the end of that.

entries.zh: 现任§Y星海监管人§!被迫卸任。
entries.en: The current §YGalactic Custodians§! are removed from office.

entries.zh: 让监管人下台
entries.en: Unseat Custodian

entries.zh: 是时候终结现任监管人的腐朽运作了。他们必须在危害星海共同体之前立刻离任！
entries.en: It is time to put an end to the corruption of the current Custodians. They must immediately be removed from office before they can do more harm to the Galactic Community!

entries.zh: 这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 在一个面向全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[Root.Capital.GetName]，[ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。
entries.en: In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [Root.GetRulerTitle] on [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 这一社会建构将服务于我们的机械智能，从今往后亦被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!。这将会是一个控制整个星系诸多政治子实体的更高层级。我们的帝国臣民们将会适时地学会服从于我们的指令和我们的任一个无人机。
entries.en: This social construct will afford our Machine Intelligence, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

entries.zh: 我们的蜂巢思维从今往后将被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!，这种社会结构使我们能够更大程度地控制星系中的诸多子政体。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会服从我们以及任一子个体的命令。
entries.en: This social construct will afford our Hive Mind, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

entries.zh: 以§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!作为掩护，这种社会结构将会给予我们对星系的诸多子政权更深层次的控制力。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会欣赏、默许荒野的智慧。
entries.en: This social construct will afford us - in the guise of §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§! - a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to appreciate the wisdom of acquiescing to the Wilderness.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
entries.en: Long live the [Root.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

entries.zh: 听着，听着！
entries.en: Hear, hear!

entries.zh: 这是远古秩序的黎明。\n\n星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。古老而破碎的意识选择在这一时代复兴，违抗天命者都被绳之以法。谁都不知道这位新的[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]对星系抱有何等雄心壮志。
entries.en: It is the dawn of an Old Order.\n\nThe Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. The old and fragmented  consciousness chose this era to re-emerge. Those who would oppose their ascension have been put in chains. Who can say what aspirations the new [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has for the galaxy.

entries.zh: 这是崭新秩序的黎明。陈腐的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布对这一新的泛星系政权的皇权之后，前监管人§H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!现在自称为§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming the throne of this new pan galactic state, the former §H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! Custodians now refer to themselves as the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 在一个全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。
entries.en: In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 它们的核心人工智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。
entries.en: Their central AI, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 它们的集体智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。
entries.en: Their linked consciousness, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 这是星系中一个和平稳定的新纪元的开始，还是开启一个充满了压迫和屈服的时代？
entries.en: Is this the beginning of a new era of peace and stability for the galaxy, or one of oppression and subjugation?

entries.zh: 拭目以待。
entries.en: We shall see.

entries.zh: 这与我们无关。
entries.en: This does not concern us.

entries.zh: §Y星海共同体§!已转变为§Y星海帝国§!。
entries.en: The §YGalactic Community§! is now known as the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

entries.zh: 宣告帝国成立
entries.en: Proclamation of Imperium

entries.zh:
全星系的子民们，庆贺吧！你们被从星海共同体那令人窒息的官僚体系和争执不休的外交纷争中解放了。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的公民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的国家之中。叛乱者受罚，而服从者有赏。要知道，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName][gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]会管照着你们。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
entries.en:
Citizens of the galaxy, rejoice! You have been set free from the tyranny of the Galactic Community's stifling bureaucracy and bickering diplomats.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful nation the galaxy has ever seen. Sedition will be punished and obedience rewarded. Know that [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] watches over you.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh:
注意此布告！星海帝国取代了你原知的陈腐的星海共同体机构。你们的恒星政体已经被重整并收归到一个统一帝国的管辖之下。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]作为帝国的中央处理器，你将学会如何以正确的方式执行它的命令。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系有史以来最伟大而且最强大的政治实体之中。它的长治久安要求你们的服从和协作。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
entries.en:
Attention! Heed this announcement. The Galactic Imperium has superseded the obsolete institution you knew of as the Galactic Community. Your individual stellar polities have been reorganized and are now grouped under a single overriding Imperial directory.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will serve as the Imperium's central processor, and you are instructed to execute its commands in a prompt manner. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful political entity the galaxy has ever known. Its continued success will require both obedience and cooperation.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh:
全星系的自主智慧生物们，这是伟大的一天。你们很快将会从全知智能的引领中获益，同时还被恩准保留你们许多人所固守的个人主义谬误。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的蜂巢之下。遵从[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的指示，永不背离它的规划——要知道这些规划是由全星系规模最大的意识的产物。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
entries.en:
Autonomous sapients of the galaxy, this is a great day. You will soon reap the benefits of being guided by vast all-seeing intelligence, while at the same time maintaining some of the fallacies of the individualism many of you cling to.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful Hive the galaxy has ever seen. Obey the directives of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and do not stray from its designs - know that they are the product of a mind greater in scope than any other in this galaxy.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 关闭显示器。
entries.en: Viewscreen off.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]的未来
entries.en: The Future of the [Root.GetAllianceName]

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]刚刚勒令星海帝国的所有组成国必须立即从任何他们可能所属的“废弃”的跨国联邦当中退出。帝国使团向我们保证，作为帝国的忠实成员，我们不再需要涉入这种“外交纠葛”当中。
entries.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that all constituent states of the Galactic Imperium are to immediately withdraw from any "obsolete" supranational federations they might be a part of. Imperial envoys have assured us that, as loyal members of the Imperium, we have no further use of such "diplomatic entanglements."

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵命。
entries.en: We have no choice but to obey.

entries.zh: 我们绝不屈从于这个帝国！
entries.en: We will never bow to the Imperium!

entries.zh: 反贼！
entries.en: Treason!

entries.zh: 歹毒的§H[From.GetName]§!拒不臣服于星海帝国！他们宣布从帝国中分裂出去，决定继续和可怜的联邦抱团取暖。
entries.en: The treacherous §H[From.GetName]§! has refused to submit to the Galactic Imperium! Instead, they have decided to cling to their pitiful federation by publicly announcing their secession from the Imperium.

entries.zh: 他们将为傲慢付出代价。
entries.en: They shall pay for their insolence.

entries.zh: 帝国的叛徒
entries.en: Traitors to the Imperium

entries.zh: 脱离帝国
entries.en: Secession from the Imperium

entries.zh: 由于我们是§H[overlord.GetName]§!的附庸，因此我们被禁止加入新成立的星海帝国。
entries.en: Given our status as subjects of the §H[overlord.GetName]§!, we are prohibited from joining the newly formed Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 极好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 帝国海军
entries.en: The Imperial Armada

entries.zh: 创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的§H帝国海军§!将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。\n\n这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new §HImperial Armada§! will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nThe Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 理应如此。
entries.en: As it should be.

entries.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualName]军官将会对他们保持监管。
entries.en: Our [root.GetIndividualName] officers will keep them in check.

entries.zh: 是改变的时候了。
entries.en: It is a time of change.

entries.zh:
古旧的星海共同体的一切相关被一扫而空，取而代之的是新的帝国。作为这一重构的一部分，泛星系防卫军被更名为§H帝国海军§!。

这一新的舰队将继承泛星系防卫军的多数军衔系统和构架，但将更换新设计的制服和军衔徽章，所有的现役人员将被要求向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。

尽管舰队的船员和后勤队伍仍然将从帝国的成员国中招募，但[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]军官的比例大幅提高了。
entries.en:
All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the §HImperial Armada§!.

This new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and organization from the GDF, but new uniforms and insignia have been introduced, and all serving members are required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While the Armada's ship crews and support personnel are still recruited from all members of the Imperium, the percentage of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName] officers has dramatically increased.

entries.zh: 军团建立
entries.en: The Founding of the Legions

entries.zh: 第一§H帝国军团§!现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。\n\n从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。
entries.en: The first §HImperial Legions§! are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.\n\nThose who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的铁拳！
entries.en: The Fist of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 我们的意志将被贯彻。
entries.en: Our will shall be enforced.

entries.zh: 又一种压迫手段？
entries.en: Another tool of oppression?

entries.zh: 帝国安全总局
entries.en: The Imperial Security Directorate

entries.zh: 隶属于§H帝国安全总局§!的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。\n\n帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。
entries.en: Agents from the §HImperial Security Directorate§! are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.\n\nAnother function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 无人能逃过帝国的正义的制裁。
entries.en: No one escapes Imperial justice.

entries.zh: 随着帝国的崛起，星系刑警组织被重新改组，其名称改变成了§H帝国安全总局§!。帝安局的特工们依旧能够将自己的权力扩张到帝国全境，但是他们现在只向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]报告。\n\n尽管帝安局的主要职能的一项依然是在帝国的星球上制裁犯罪，他们现在也负责猎杀那些会威胁到[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的分离主义者、叛乱分子。部分各界人士担忧这个前身为警察组织的部门现在变成了血腥镇压的工具……
entries.en: With the rise of the Imperium, GALPOL is being reorganized and has changed its name to the §HImperial Security Directorate§!. The jurisdiction of ISD agents still extends across the entire Imperium, but as of now they report only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nWhile one of the primary responsibilities of the ISD is still to investigate and prosecute crime on Imperial worlds, they are now also used to hunt down seditionists and rebels who would challenge the rule of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Some are voicing concern that the former police organization is turning into a tool of oppression...

entries.zh: 唯有出类拔萃的个体才能成为帝国军团成员，这意味着我们每次只能有限度地出动此类陆军。
entries.en: Only individuals with exceptional skills are allowed to become Imperial Legionnaires, which means that we can only field a limited number of these Armies at a time.

entries.zh: 帝国军团
entries.en: Imperial Legion

entries.zh: 从所有成员国中遴选而出的星海帝国的精英士兵。他们被训练成了无情的杀戮机器，并且对帝国有着近乎狂热的忠诚。
entries.en: The elite soldiers of the Galactic Imperium, recruited from all member nations. Drilled and conditioned into ruthless killing machines, they are fanatically loyal to the Imperium.

entries.zh: 帝国宫殿
entries.en: Imperial Palace

entries.zh: 一座配得上最伟大帝国的前所未有的宏伟宫殿建筑群。如果星系有所谓璀璨夺目的焦点，那一定就是它了。
entries.en: A massive palace complex fit for the greatest empire history has ever seen. If there is a bright center to the galaxy, this is it.

entries.zh: 帝国中枢
entries.en: Imperial Center

entries.zh: 这个硕大无朋的建筑群是星海帝国的行政中心。数以千计的人工智能夜以继日地在此对星系的现状进行运算和估值。
entries.en: This colossal complex is the administrative heart of the Galactic Imperium. Thousands of AIs are constantly processing and evaluating the current state of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 帝国主巢
entries.en: Imperial Complex

entries.zh: 在这座巨大的建筑中，蜂巢思维统治着星海帝国。这就是整个星系的命运被决定的地方。
entries.en: From this massive structure, the Hive Mind governs the Galactic Imperium. This is where the fate of the galaxy is decided.

entries.zh: 帝国领
entries.en: Imperial Domain

entries.zh: §L该政府管辖着星海帝国的核心地区，而这片地区处于帝国的直接控制之下。§!
entries.en: §LThis government rules the Galactic Imperium's central crown territory, which is under the direct control of the Imperial Sovereign.§!
