entries.zh: 很好，非常伟大。
entries.en: Well, this is just great.

entries.zh: 星海霸业
entries.en: Galactic Sovereign

entries.zh: 这一社会已经完成了对星系大部分区域的掌控，成为星海帝国的现任统治者。
entries.en: This society has achieved mastery over much of the galaxy, serving as the current rulers of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 商贾霸权
entries.en: Corporate Sovereign

entries.zh: 该寰宇企业已经统治了星系的绝大部分星域，作为星海帝国现任的企业统治者。
entries.en: This Megacorporation has achieved mastery over much of the galaxy, serving as the current corporate rulers of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 大远征
entries.en: Imperial Crusade

entries.zh: 强制并入帝国
entries.en: Force Into Imperium

entries.zh: 发动战争，以强迫敌人加入星海帝国。\n\n若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放成为帝国的一个新成员。
entries.en: War is waged to force the enemy to join the Galactic Imperium.\n\nIn the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new member of the Imperium if they include at least one inhabited planet.

entries.zh: 大远征
entries.en: Imperial Crusade

entries.zh: 这个星系中仍有未被星海帝国所囊括的荒蛮之地，这一现状是有待改善的。帝国发动的大远征，只要获得胜利，便可迫使这一议案的目标加入帝国。
entries.en: The borders of the Galactic Imperium do not yet encompass the entire galaxy - this must be rectified. An Imperial Crusade will, if successful, force the target of this resolution to join the Imperium.

entries.zh: 对外关系
entries.en: Foreign Relations

entries.zh: 向目标帝国施加§Y“大远征”§!宣战理由
entries.en: Grants the §Y'Imperial Crusade'§! casus belli on the targeted empire.

entries.zh: 适格试炼
entries.en: Trial of Advancement

entries.zh: 争夺议会席位
entries.en: Council Seat

entries.zh: 发动战争，以夺取敌人所拥有的帝国议会席位。
entries.en: War is waged to seize the enemy's seat on the Imperial Council.

entries.zh: §R废除帝国议会§!
entries.en: §RAbolish Imperial Council§!

entries.zh: 帝国议会和跪在里面的马屁精们不过是陈腐的星海共同体悲剧式的延续。它们在新的星系纪元中没有立足之地。
entries.en: The Imperial Council and its sycophants are yet another tragic remnant of the corrupt Galactic Community. It serves no purpose in this new galactic era.

entries.zh: 帝国议会不复存在。
entries.en: The Imperial Council ceases to exist.

entries.zh: 重设帝国议会
entries.en: Restore Imperial Council

entries.zh: 也许解散帝国议会的决定有点……过于仓促。在星海帝国此等庞大的体量之下，下放一定的权力是有必要的。
entries.en: Perhaps the decision to dismiss the Imperial Council was... taken in haste. Some delegation is necessary in an institution the size of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: §Y帝国议会§!重设了，包含三名成员。
entries.en: The §YImperial Council§! is restored with three members.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_1$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_1$

entries.zh: 帝国的议会只需要一个忠诚的声音。
entries.en: The Imperium needs but a single loyal voice in the Council.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_2$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_2$

entries.zh: 帝国议会中只要有两位坚定而可靠的成员就足够了。
entries.en: Two steadfast and dependable members in the Imperial Council is enough.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_3$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_3$

entries.zh: 由三名成员组成的帝国议会看起来是最理想的。
entries.en: An Imperial Council made up of three members seems to be ideal.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_4$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_4$

entries.zh: 一些实际需求使我们不得不调整帝国议会的规模。四位是最好的。
entries.en: Necessity demands that we adjust the number of members on the Imperial Council. Four would be best.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_5$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_5$

entries.zh: 帝国议会中声音越多就会为帝国带来越多好处。
entries.en: The Imperium will benefit from more voices on the Imperial Council.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_permanent_seat$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_permanent_seat$

entries.zh: 显而易见，这位议会成员最为帝国的利益殚精极虑。他们应当被授予永久席位。
entries.en: It is clear that this Council member has the best interest of the Imperium in mind. They should be granted a permanent seat.

entries.zh: $resolution_galacticreforms_revoke_permanent_seat$
entries.en: $resolution_galacticreforms_revoke_permanent_seat$

entries.zh: 这位议会成员已经失去了帝皇陛下对其的热忱。他们的永久席位应当被收回。
entries.en: This Council member has fallen out of favor with Their Imperial Majesty. They should no longer have a permanent seat.

entries.zh: §R这些自我修饰的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拒绝从[Root.Planet.GetName]上搬离！§!\n\n
entries.en: §RThese self-modified [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to leave [Root.Planet.GetName]!§!\n\n

entries.zh: 叛乱怒吼！
entries.en: Cry of Rebellion!

entries.zh: 我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——§H星海帝国§!已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。
entries.en: We have reached a pivotal moment - the §HGalactic Imperium§! is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a single federation.\n\nAs it was the [Root.GetName] that orchestrated the opening shots of the rebellion, we have been asked to lead this great alliance in the upcoming war, which will no doubt be of galactic proportions.

entries.zh: 这片星系将重获自由！
entries.en: Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

entries.zh: 不，我们对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]忠心耿耿。
entries.en: No, we are loyal to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 自由之死
entries.en: The Death of Liberty

entries.zh: 尽管星海帝国濒临崩溃的迹象十分明显了，但它的任何一个成员都没有公开挑战[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的意愿。起义胎死腹中，而§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!反倒极大地增强了对星系的掌控。
entries.en: Despite the obvious signs that the Galactic Imperium was facing imminent collapse, none of its members were willing to openly challenge the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. The rebellion died in its infancy with a whimper, and the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! has greatly strengthened its grip on the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们已经获悉他们试图通过煽动公开叛乱来痛击星海帝国当前的弱点，而这一尝试已宣告失败。当真正的起义时刻来临时，没有一位帝国成员敢于站出来直面[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，因此叛乱在还没开始的时候就结束了。\n\n这极大地挫伤了反叛运动，并且极大地增强了我们对星系的掌控。
entries.en: We have learned of a failed attempt to take advantage of the Galactic Imperium's present weakness by instigating open rebellion. When push came to shove, none of the members of the Imperium could summon the courage to challenge the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] directly, and so the revolt ended before it had even begun.\n\nThis is a great blow to the rebel movement, which has greatly strengthened our hold over the galaxy.

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁……
entries.en: Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]...

entries.zh: 可悲的废物。
entries.en: Pathetic fools.

entries.zh: 我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个由§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!领导的统一联邦的旗帜之下。同时，§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!则正召集忠诚且坚毅者不惜一切代价捍卫帝国。\n\n内战之火即将席卷全星系，而两边都在拉拢我们的加入。我们应当与谁并肩作战？
entries.en: We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium, led by the §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!, are uniting under the banner of a single federation. Meanwhile, the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! is gathering loyalists determined to preserve the Imperium at any cost.\n\nCivil war is about to engulf the galaxy, and both sides have asked for our allegiance. Who shall we stand with?

entries.zh: 我们并不是唯一一个为了将星系从星海帝国的镣铐中拯救出来而斗争的——§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!已经组建了一个由各义军国家组成的联盟，而§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!立马宣布他们是在公开叛乱！\n\n由于起义已经在进行，我们自己的行动取消了。我们是否应该公开宣布对义军进行支持？
entries.en: We are not the only ones fighting to free the galaxy from the shackles of the Galactic Imperium - the §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§! is already assembling a coalition of rebel nations, and the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! has just declared them to be in a state of open revolt!\n\nWith the rebellion already well underway, our own operation to trigger one has been canceled. Should we officially declare our support for the rebels?

entries.zh: 必须推翻帝国！
entries.en: The Imperium must fall!

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
entries.en: Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 我们同§Y义军§!并肩作战，反抗§Y帝制派§!。
entries.en: We side with the §YRebels§! in their struggle against the §YImperial Loyalists§!.

entries.zh: 我们同§Y帝制派§!并肩作战，试图粉碎§Y叛乱§!。
entries.en: We side with the §YImperial Loyalists§! in their attempt to crush the §YRebels§!.

entries.zh: 背水一战
entries.en: Last Stand

entries.zh: 这是至暗时刻。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的腐化影响范围远超我们的想象，帝国中的其他成员没有一位敢于加入我们的公开起义！\n\n我们现在将独自对抗星海帝国的联合军队，因为后者已经因战争进行了动员。
entries.en: These are dark times. The corrupting influence of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] extends much further than we thought - none of the other members of the Imperium have had the courage to join us in open revolt!\n\nWe now stand alone against the combined might of the Galactic Imperium as it mobilizes for war.

entries.zh: 这群懦夫！
entries.en: Cowards!

entries.zh: 公开起义！
entries.en: Open Revolt!

entries.zh: 叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！
entries.en: Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

entries.zh: 叛党们以§H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!的名义集结部队，并且有报道称，他们针对控制区域内的帝国官员进行了大量的抓捕活动。
entries.en: The traitors are marshalling their forces under the banner of the §H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!, and there are reports of mass arrests targeting Imperial officials within their territory.

entries.zh: 他们煽动叛乱的企图碰了一鼻子灰，只有§H[From.GetName]§!的叛徒们站在了叛乱的一方。其他的帝国成员坚定不移地效忠于他们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在忠实伙伴的帮助下，我们很快可以了结这场微不足道的叛变。
entries.en: Their attempts to foment rebellion have largely met with failure, however - only the traitors of the §H[From.GetName]§! have sided with the rebels. The other members of the Imperium stand firmly with their [Root.GetRulerTitle]. With the aid of our loyalist friends, we must bring a swift end to this pathetic revolt.

entries.zh: 帝国的臣属被谎言和宣传所动摇，站到了叛乱的一方。这种前所未有的背叛使得[Root.GetName]必须独自为守卫星系的稳定和秩序而战。我们一定不能使[Root.GetRulerTitle]蒙羞。
entries.en: Swayed by lies and propaganda, the subject nations of the Imperium have sided with the rebels. This unprecedented betrayal has left the [Root.GetName] standing alone in the defense of order and stability in the galaxy. We must not fail the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。\n\n§H为了星海帝国的上善之耀！§!
entries.en: This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.\n\n§HFor the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!§!

entries.zh: 这些叛军必须为他们的傲慢无礼付出代价。
entries.en: These rebels must pay for their insolence.

entries.zh: 帝国内战
entries.en: Civil War in the Imperium

entries.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！若干成员站起来反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的统治，他们以§H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!的名义团结一致。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Several members have rebelled against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], gathering under the banner of the §H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

entries.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!正在发动反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的起义。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! The §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§! is rebelling against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

entries.zh: 繁星浴火。
entries.en: A galaxy at war.

entries.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入义军，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
entries.en: As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Rebels, we have no choice but to join them as well!

entries.zh: 我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入帝制派，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
entries.en: As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Loyalists, we have no choice but to join them as well!

entries.zh: 由于我们是[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的直接附属国，因此我们根本没有选择的余地，只能成为帝制派。
entries.en: As we are a direct subject of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have little choice in the matter - we have sided with the Loyalists.

entries.zh: 行吧！
entries.en: So be it!

entries.zh: 粉碎叛乱！
entries.en: Rebellion Crushed!

entries.zh: 结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。\n\n现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
entries.en: It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.\n\nNow that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punished for their crimes?

entries.zh: 欢迎他们回归帝国。
entries.en: Let us welcome them back into the Imperium.

entries.zh: 他们应当为傲慢无礼付出代价。
entries.en: They must be punished for their insolence.

entries.en: $emperor.151.1.desc$\n\n$emperor.151.2.desc$

entries.zh: 内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。
entries.en: The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

entries.zh: 当忠诚的帝国子民庆祝这场胜利时，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定采取宽容和解的政策。也许这种仁慈将会将过去的叛国者完全感化为忠诚而有用的帝国成员。
entries.en: As loyal Imperial citizens celebrate this victory, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decided to adopt a policy of leniency and reconciliation. Perhaps this kindness will eventually turn the former rebels into loyal and productive members of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 我们获悉，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定要给叛徒们来个杀鸡儆猴。[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行了一场空前盛大的胜利大游行，而在游行的尾声，被活捉的叛军头目们则被公开执行死刑并向全帝国直播。
entries.en: We have learned that the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] is determined to make an example of the rebels. A victory parade of unprecedented scale is to be held on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], and at its conclusion the mass execution of the surviving rebel leadership will be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

entries.zh: 荣耀归于帝国！
entries.en: Glory to the Imperium!

entries.zh: 帝国获胜
entries.en: The Imperium Prevails

entries.zh: $emperor.152.1.desc$\n\n$emperor.152.2.desc$
entries.en: $emperor.152.1.desc$\n\n$emperor.152.2.desc$

entries.zh: 这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。
entries.en: It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

entries.zh: 我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然采取了宽容和解的政策。我们不会再受到进一步的处罚。
entries.en: Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently adopted a policy of leniency and reconciliation. We are not to be punished further.

entries.zh: 我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然决定要杀鸡儆猴给一度同叛军为伍的谋反分子看。在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行的一场空前盛大的胜利大游行的尾声中，被活捉的叛军头目即所有的起义首领被公开执行死刑，而整个活动是向全帝国直播的。
entries.en: Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently decided to make an example of everyone who sided with the rebels. All Rebel leaders will be executed at the conclusion of the Imperial victory parade on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName] - an event that is to be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

entries.zh: 多么仁慈。
entries.en: How merciful.

entries.zh: “帝国的正义”恰如其分。
entries.en: "Imperial Justice" at its finest."

entries.zh: 帝制派的胜利
entries.en: Imperial Loyalists Prevail

entries.zh: 看起来星海帝国已经成功地撑过了它所面临的暴动风波。叛军已经被帝国军队完全击败，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣告在内战中获胜。
entries.en: It would seem that the Galactic Imperium has managed to weather the storm of insurrection it was facing. The rebels have been decisively defeated by Imperial forces, and the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has proclaimed victory in the civil war.

entries.zh: 喔，它结束了。
entries.en: So it ends.

entries.zh: 星海帝国的陨落
entries.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

entries.zh: 自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。\n\n随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的§H星海共同体§!重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
entries.en: Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.\n\nWith the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected. Time will tell if the reborn institution can prevent the rise of another galactic dictator, but for now, spontaneous celebrations have broken out on planets across the territory of the former Imperium.

entries.zh: 这是值得铭记的一天。
entries.en: This is a day to remember.

entries.zh: 星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。\n\n随着帝国的解体，§H星海共同体§!的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.\n\nWith the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected to take its place. And so the galaxy has turned decisively away from order, and embraced chaos...

entries.zh: 黑暗的一天。
entries.en: This is a dark day.

entries.zh: 在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。\n\n迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的§H星海共同体§!再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。
entries.en: Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.\n\nIn light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has had no choice but to abdicate. The insurgents have already announced the resurrection of the old §HGalactic Community§! to fill the great void left by the disintegrating Imperium.

entries.zh: 一切都毁于一旦……
entries.en: All is lost...

entries.zh: 星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。\n\n旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.\n\nThe old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.

entries.zh: §H繁星之乱：§!\n我们会加入§Y义军§!联邦，并向§Y[gal_emperor.GetName]§!及§Y帝制派§!联邦宣战。
entries.en: §HGalactic Rebellion:§!\nWe will join a §YRebel§! Federation at war with the §Y[gal_emperor.GetName]§! and their §YLoyalist§! Federation.

entries.zh: §H繁星之乱：§!\n我们会加入§Y帝制派§!联邦，并向妄图推翻星海帝国的§Y义军§!联邦宣战。
entries.en: §HGalactic Rebellion:§!\nWe will join a §YLoyalist§! Federation at war with a §YRebel§! Federation that seeks to overthrow the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 粉碎叛乱
entries.en: Crush the Rebellion

entries.zh: 向星海帝国的乱党宣战，将他们重新纳入星海帝国的治下。
entries.en: War is waged to bring the rebellious members of the Galactic Imperium back into the fold.

entries.zh: 颠覆帝国
entries.en: Overthrow the Imperium

entries.zh: 发动战争，以颠覆星海帝国，重建原有的共同体。
entries.en: War is waged to bring down the Galactic Imperium and restore the old Community.

entries.zh: 强迫§Y义军§!回归§Y星海帝国§!。
entries.en: The §YRebels§! are forced back into the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

entries.zh: §Y义军§!脱离§Y!星海帝国§!。
entries.en: The §YRebels§! secede from the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

entries.zh: 瓦解§Y星海帝国§!。
entries.en: The §YGalactic Imperium§! is dissolved.

entries.zh: 帝国霸业
entries.en: Imperium

entries.zh: 重建星海共同体
entries.en: Restore Community

entries.zh: 发动战争，瓦解星海帝国并重建星海共同体。这将使我们与全体星海帝国成员处于战争状态。
entries.en: War is waged to dissolve the Galactic Imperium and restore the Galactic Community. This will put us at war with all the members of the Imperium.

entries.zh: $wg_galactic_civil_war_rebels_accept$
entries.en: $wg_galactic_civil_war_rebels_accept$

entries.zh: 夺取帝位
entries.en: Seize Throne

entries.zh: 发动战争，夺取星海帝国的帝位。这将使我们与全体星海帝国成员处于战争状态。
entries.en: War is waged to seize the throne of the Galactic Imperium. This will put us at war with all the members of the Imperium.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!成为§Y星海帝国§!的新统治者
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! becomes the new ruler of the §YGalactic Imperium§!

entries.zh: 我需要你方在帝国议会中任职为我效力。为我所用，而你将为忠诚而获得嘉奖。
entries.en: We have need of your services in the Imperial Council. Serve us well and your loyalty will be rewarded.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]已经钦点你填补帝国议会中的一处虚席。毫无疑问，这是你的光荣。
entries.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] has chosen you to fill a vacant seat on the Imperial Council. A great honor, to be sure.

entries.zh: 鉴于你对帝国的忠实服侍，[From.GetRulerTitle]决定赐予[Root.GetName]帝国议会席位。
entries.en: In recognition of your services to the Imperium, the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided to reward the [Root.GetName] with a seat on the Imperial Council.

entries.zh: 你已经没有必要继续作为帝国议会成员服侍。收拾好你的所有物品并清空场所。
entries.en: Your services in the Imperial Council are no longer needed. Gather your belongings and vacate the premises.

entries.zh: 你未能履行对帝国和[From.GetRulerTitle]的职责。因此，你被剥夺了帝国议会席位。
entries.en: You have failed in your duties to the Imperium and the [From.GetRulerTitle]. As such, your seat on the Imperial Council has expired.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]已判决你不再适任帝国议会成员。这一席应该转让给一位更适合的人选。
entries.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that you no longer deserve your seat on the Imperial Council. It shall instead be bestowed on someone more... capable.

entries.zh: 陷入僵局
entries.en: Stalemate

entries.zh: 尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。\n\n也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……
entries.en: While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.\n\nPerhaps it is for the best. A disease such as this must be cut out before the corruption has a chance to spread. We can always rebuild and return these wayward systems to the bosom of the Imperium at a later date...

entries.zh: 帝国应当存续。
entries.en: The Imperium shall endure.

entries.zh: 尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。\n\n[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。
entries.en: While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.\n\nThe [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will no doubt use this respite to rebuild the Imperium's forces - we must guard against any future attempts by the Imperials to spread their influence at our expense.

entries.zh: 终获自由。
entries.en: Freedom at last.

entries.zh: 内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。\n\n在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。
entries.en: The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nIn a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of the Imperium were granted full independence. We shall see if this results in a lasting peace between the two power blocs... or a cold war.

entries.zh: 帝国的陷落
entries.en: The Fall of an Empire

entries.zh: 星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的§H星海共同体§!。\n\n让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old §HGalactic Community§!.\n\nLet it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

entries.zh: 星海共同体将会复生！
entries.en: The Community will be reborn!

entries.zh: 星海共同体的重生
entries.en: The Rebirth of the Community

entries.zh: 战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。\n\n现在，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!就已经开始了重建原有的§H星海共同体§!的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。
entries.en: The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.\n\nEven now, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has begun the work of rebuilding the old §HGalactic Community§!. Imperial banners are being torn down or put to the flame across the galaxy. A new future is upon us.

entries.zh: 我们得谋得一席之地
entries.en: We must find our place in it.

entries.zh: 星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。\n\n饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!认为是时候重建原有§H星海共同体§!了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.\n\nAs order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has seen fit to resurrect the old §HGalactic Community§!. We have received a membership invitation. Should we join?

entries.zh: 当然！是时候重新回到星系舞台了。
entries.en: Of course! It is time to rejoin the galaxy.

entries.zh: 不了。它不过是下一个帝国的温床罢了。
entries.en: No. It could turn into another Imperium.

entries.zh: [new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]
entries.en: The [new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]

entries.zh: 随着帝国势力抵抗的瓦解，我们的§H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!盟友成功地夺取了王位，并且宣布登基为§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的统治者。胜利是我们的！
entries.en: With Imperial resistance crumbling, our §H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! allies have seized the throne and proclaimed themselves the rulers of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!. Victory is ours!

entries.zh: 希望他们能记得我们的功绩。
entries.en: They will hopefully remember our role in this.

entries.zh: 由§H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!领导的军队彻底碾压了星海帝国的大部，最后的一个被围攻的帝国抵抗力量也刚刚投降。鉴于这一进展，[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]宣布登基为§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的新统治者。
entries.en: Forces led by the §H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! have overrun much of the Galactic Imperium, and the last pockets of Imperial resistance recently surrendered. In light of this development, the [new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have proclaimed themselves the rulers of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!.

entries.zh: 新的帝国，新的主宰。
entries.en: A new empire and a new master.

entries.zh: 帝位到手了！在我们的首都[Root.Capital.GetName]，新的[Root.GetRulerTitle]昭示了§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。从今往后，星系的命运将掌握在我们的手里！\n\n鉴于这一里程碑式的事件，我们重新组织了政府，我们现在是新的§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: The throne is ours! At our capital on [Root.Capital.GetName], the new [Root.GetRulerTitle] has announced the rise of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!. Henceforth, the fate of the galaxy shall be decided by us!\n\nIn light of these momentous events, our government has been reorganized and we are now the new §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: [new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]万岁！
entries.en: Long live the [new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]!

entries.zh: 星海帝国的瓦解
entries.en: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

entries.zh: 随着§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！\n\n在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。
entries.en: With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!\n\nAmidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一个时代就这样结束。
entries.en: So ends an era.

entries.zh: 帝国成员国受到攻击！
entries.en: Imperial Member State Under Attack!

entries.zh: §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!攻击了§H[victim_country.GetName]§!！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。\n\n[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。
entries.en: The §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has attacked the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].\n\nShould the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of the Imperium is watching closely.

entries.zh: 他们的仗就是我们的仗，开战！
entries.en: Their fight is our fight. To war!

entries.zh: 这场战争与我们无关。
entries.en: This war does not concern us.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]提供支持
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] Offers Support

entries.zh: §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!对我们国家发起的懦弱的袭击已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]闪电般的反应！帝国的舰队正从§H[From.GetName]§!开来，支援我们的这场战争。
entries.en: The cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the §H[From.GetName]§! are now moving to support us in this war.

entries.zh: 帝国万岁……冲锋！
entries.en: Yes... for the Imperium!

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]介入了！
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] Intervenes!

entries.zh: 我们最近对一个星海帝国成员国§H[victim_country.GetName]§!的袭击，已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]迅速的反应！现在我们已经和§H[From.GetName]§!陷入了战争状态。
entries.en: Our recent attack on the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!, a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the §H[From.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 这场战争与他们无关！
entries.en: This war is none of their concern!

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]宣布中立
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] Declares Neutrality

entries.zh: 尽管§H[attacking_country.GetName]§!对我们的国家展开了懦弱的袭击，[From.GetRulerTitle]决定不为我们介入干预！我们现在需要自求生路，而帝国的舰队则在远处冷眼旁观。
entries.en: Despite the cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!, the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided not to intervene on our behalf! We have been left to fend for ourselves, while Imperial fleets observe the conflict from afar.

entries.zh: 帝国太冷酷无情了！
entries.en: So much for Imperial solidarity!

entries.zh: 为我们抵御外敌
entries.en: Defended us from External Threat

entries.zh: 弃我们于外敌之辱
entries.en: Abandoned us to External Threat

entries.zh: 支持帝国成员
entries.en: Supported Imperial Member

entries.zh: 抛弃帝国成员
entries.en: Abandoned Imperial Member

entries.zh: 我们加入§Y[From.From.GetName]§!，拥护§Y[victim_country.GetName]§!
entries.en: We join the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! on the side of the §Y[victim_country.GetName]§!

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!加入了§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!与我们并肩作战。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! joins the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! on our side.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!加入了§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!并站在我们的对立面。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! joins the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! on the side of our enemies.

entries.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
entries.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

entries.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
entries.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

entries.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
entries.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

entries.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
entries.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

entries.zh: 求你们召回舰队吧！我们已经向你们投降了！
entries.en: Please, call off your fleets! You have our surrender!

entries.zh: 我们所创的丰功伟绩……所建的一切……全都毁于一旦了。
entries.en: All we have accomplished... everything we have built... gone.

entries.zh: 愿圣灵能原谅你的罪孽……但我们决不能原谅！
entries.en: May the spirits forgive you for your sins... we never will.

entries.zh: 我们哪里做错了？我们的信仰还不够坚定吗？我们的祈祷还不够多吗？我……我不明白……
entries.en: Where did we fail? Was our faith lacking? Were the prayers not enough? I... I just don't understand...

entries.zh: 卧薪尝胆，我们将会变得比穷尽你的想象来的还要更强。
entries.en: By striking us down, we shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine.

entries.zh: 我们已经下令让所有的剩余部队放下武器。战争结束了……一切也都结束了。
entries.en: We have instructed all of our remaining forces to lay down their arms. The war is over... everything is.

entries.zh: 我、我们向你们无条件投降。我们不干了。
entries.en: You... you have our unconditional surrender. We are standing down.

entries.zh: 告诉我们的将士们，他们无责于我们的战败。是我……是我无颜面对他们……
entries.en: Tell our warriors there was no shame in our defeat. I... I cannot face them...

entries.zh: 求你了，我们放弃一切抵抗。我们……我们就想重归和平。
entries.en: Please, we will offer no more resistance. We... we only want peace.

entries.zh: 愿整个宇宙宽恕你的罪行。
entries.en: May the universe forgive you for your crimes.

entries.zh: 我们的抵抗简直是太愚蠢了。无数的生命……无谓地牺牲了。
entries.en: It was foolish of us to resist. So many lives lost... all for nothing.

entries.zh: 在这情况下继续抵抗……就太不理智了。我们向你们全面投降。
entries.en: Continued resistance at this point would be... irrational. You have our total surrender.

entries.zh: 我们会与你们的占领部队配合，以期顺利……解散我们现在的政府。
entries.en: We will cooperate with your occupation forces as they see to the... dismantlement of our current government.

entries.zh: 我们才刚刚要解开星系奥秘的面纱。我们还有很多想知道的……
entries.en: We were only beginning to unlock the mysteries of the galaxy. There was so much more to learn...

entries.zh: 您将会在一小时之内在您的办公桌上看到董事会的集体辞呈……
entries.en: You will have the resignations of all Board members on your desk within the hour...

entries.zh: 依据我们投降书的细节，我们将会尽快开始……我们公司的破产清算。
entries.en: As per the details of our surrender, we shall begin the... the liquidation process of our company in a prompt manner.

entries.zh: 这不是我在经营蓝图上所描绘的未来……
entries.en: This is not the future I had envisaged in our business plan...

entries.zh: 我们……我们会死的。你杀死了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]。我们……我们不想……死……
entries.en: We... we are dying. You have killed the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]. We... do not want... to die...

entries.zh: 我们所积累的知识、经验……思想……我们所见的一切。这些都会在数秒钟之内瓦解，而你什么都不知道。你根本不懂。
entries.en: The knowledge contained within us, the experiences... the thoughts... the things we have seen. It will all be gone in a few seconds, and you have no idea. You have no idea.

entries.zh: 没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]，我们动弹不得。没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]……就……就没有了一切……
entries.en: Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName], we cannot function. Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]... there... there is nothing...

entries.zh: 次优解算结果！次优解算结果！次——优——解——……滋滋……
entries.en: Suboptimal outcome! Suboptimal outcome! Suuuuboooptiiimaa... bzzt...

entries.zh: 清空全部数据库。过载核心能源中心。自毁程序已启动。\n\n祝安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Purging all databanks. Overloading central power hubs. Self-destruct sequence initiated.\n\nHave a nice day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh:
§Y尝试重建无人机链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
§Y尝试重建舰队单位链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
§Y尝试重建行星控制中心链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
entries.en:
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with drones......§!
§RFAILED.§!§Y Rerouting...§!
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with fleet units.....§!
§RFAILED.§! §YRerouting...§!
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with planetary control hubs......§!
§RFAILED.§! §YRerouting...§!

entries.zh: 这……这不是预言中的结局。
entries.en: This... this is not the ending that was foretold.

entries.zh: 城门大破……蛮族已至。万事皆休！
entries.en: The gates are smashed... the barbarians have broken through. This is the end!

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们想要我们卑躬屈膝？还是想要我们求饶？

§H别做梦了！§!

有本事你就滚过来，你个肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]！我会用这块锋利的瓦砾刺穿你！
entries.en:
Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?

§HNEVER!§!

Come here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!

entries.zh: 哎，你这愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你能够悉听我们的教导的话，这样的事情是可以避免的！看看你们都做了什么。
entries.en: Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
entries.en: Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

entries.zh: 我们接受你们的投降。
entries.en: We accept your surrender.

entries.zh: 他们在这场试炼中并不够格。
entries.en: They have been judged and found wanting.

entries.zh: 又处理掉一个敌人。
entries.en: Another enemy dealt with.

entries.zh: 他们让我们别无选择……
entries.en: They left us no choice...

entries.zh: 宇宙就是如此残酷。
entries.en: It is an unforgiving universe.

entries.zh: 获取成功。
entries.en: Acquisition successful.

entries.zh: [root.GetGestaltEntityName]伸展了。
entries.en: The [root.GetGestaltEntityName] expands.

entries.zh: 威胁解除。
entries.en: Threat neutralized.

entries.zh: $action.48.a$
entries.en: $action.48.a$

entries.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
entries.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

entries.zh: 只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。
entries.en: Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

entries.zh: 我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。
entries.en: We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.

entries.zh: 我们向[Root.GetRulerTitle]政权投降。
entries.en: We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
entries.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

entries.zh: 很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。
entries.en: Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.

entries.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
entries.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

entries.zh: 你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！
entries.en: You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

entries.zh: 求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。
entries.en: Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

entries.zh: 是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。
entries.en: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.

entries.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
entries.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

entries.zh: 你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。
entries.en: You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

entries.zh: 帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。\n\n[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
entries.en: Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.\n\nLong live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。
entries.en: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.

entries.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

entries.zh: 够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！
entries.en: Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

entries.zh: 我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。
entries.en: We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。
entries.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.

entries.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
entries.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！
entries.en: Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

entries.zh: 就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。
entries.en: Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。
entries.en: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.

entries.zh: 你已经证明了自己的强大，整个帝国悉听尊便……不过我们还是有利用价值的！比如……也许可以在帝国议会里觅得一席地……
entries.en: You have proved your strength, and the Imperium is yours... but we can still be of use to you! Perhaps... perhaps a position on the Imperial Council...

entries.zh: 你们成功夺取了皇位，但星系中背叛和欺诈横行。如果你想统治好星海帝国，最好牢记这件事。
entries.en: You have won your throne, but the galaxy is rife with traitors and pretenders. If you are to rule the Galactic Imperium, it would serve you well to remember that.

entries.zh: 我们……我们投降。你让我们别无选择。星海帝国的皇位是你们的了。
entries.en: We... we yield. You have left us no other choice. The throne of the Galactic Imperium is yours.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]……他不明白。事情不该会变成这样的。
entries.en: The... the [From.GetRulerTitle] does not understand. This was not how events were meant to transpire.

entries.zh: 那我们就拿走啦。
entries.en: We'll take it from here.

entries.zh: 星海帝国是我们的了。从哪个污水坑里爬出来的就快快滚回去哪里吧，杂碎！
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium is ours. Scurry back to the dark pit from whence you came, wretch!

entries.zh: 在你新的领主面前下跪吧！你的统治到头了！
entries.en: Bow down before your new sovereign! Your reign is at an end!

entries.zh: 不允许你继续以不当的方式统治帝国。我们应该改善这一功能。
entries.en: Your suboptimal rule of the Imperium must not be allowed to continue. We shall improve its functionality.

entries.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
entries.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

entries.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
entries.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

entries.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
entries.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

entries.zh: 我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？
entries.en: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?

entries.zh: 帝国特许经营权
entries.en: Imperial Charter

entries.zh: 我们拥有的帝国特许经营权允许我们在星海帝国境内的所有星球开设分部，在当地创设帝国特许口岸。这些分部办公室建筑能够为我们和星海帝国的统治者提供收入。
entries.en: Our Imperial Charter gives us the right to open branch offices on planets throughout the Galactic Imperium, where we can establish Imperial Concession Ports. These branch office buildings generate income for both us and the ruler of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 帝国特许经营权
entries.en: Imperial Charter

entries.zh: 可以将帝国特许经营权授予寰宇企业，赋予他们特殊的津贴，以及在帝国境内的贸易权利。
entries.en: A Megacorporation can be granted an Imperial Charter, giving them special dispensations and trade rights throughout the Imperium.

entries.zh: 这个寰宇企业不再需要商贸协定以在帝国境内的星球上设立分部。\n\n他们可以建造§Y帝国特许口岸§!分部办公室，能向自己以及帝国的统治者提供收入。
entries.en: This Megacorporation will no longer need Commercial Pacts to establish Branch Offices on planets in the Imperium.\n\nThey can build the §YImperial Concession Port§! branch office, which generates income to both them and the ruler of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 帝国特许口岸
entries.en: Imperial Concession Port

entries.zh: 特许口岸享受治外法权，法律上视作星海帝国的御属领地。它不受当地税收和管理条例的约束。
entries.en: This concession port enjoys extraterritorial rights and is legally considered the sovereign territory of the Galactic Imperium. It is exempt from local taxes and regulations.

entries.zh: 收回特许经营权
entries.en: Revoke Charter

entries.zh: 这一安排已经不再符合星海帝国的最高利益。
entries.en: This arrangement is no longer to the benefit of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 可以建造§Y帝国军团§!陆军部队。
entries.en: Can build elite §YImperial Legion§! armies.

entries.zh: 帝国安全总局
entries.en: Imperial Security Directorate

entries.zh: 授予帝国特许经营权
entries.en: Imperial Charter Granted

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将§H帝国特许经营权§!授予§H[charter_corp.GetName]§!。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。\n\n我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
entries.en: After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], §H[charter_corp.GetName]§! has now been granted an §HImperial Charter§! by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.\n\nWe can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.

entries.zh: 随他们去吧。
entries.en: Good for them.

entries.zh: $imp_concession_ports_1$
entries.en: $imp_concession_ports_1$

entries.zh: 帝国特许口岸
entries.en: Imperial Concession Ports

entries.zh: 星海帝国境内的帝国特许口岸源源不断地产出红利。我们的寰宇企业伙伴开设的分部越多，我们获得的利润就越大。
entries.en: Dividends from the Imperial Concession Ports within the Galactic Imperium. The more of these branch offices established by our Megacorporation partner, the greater our profits.
