entries.zh: 前叛军
entries.en: Former Rebel

entries.zh: 我们在星海帝国爆发的最近一场内战中选择和叛军站在一边，因此我们的立场至今仍然惹人生疑。我们在帝国参议院的影响力受到了严重的削弱。
entries.en: We sided with the Rebels during the recent civil war in the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Imperial Senate is severely curtailed.

entries.zh: 前帝制派
entries.en: Former Imperial Loyalist

entries.zh: 我们在星海帝国的覆灭之战中选择和帝制派站在一边，因此我们的立场至今仍然惹人生疑。我们在星海共同体的影响力受到了严重的削弱。
entries.en: We fought on the side of the Loyalists during the fall of the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Galactic Community is severely curtailed.

entries.zh: 前暴君
entries.en: Former Tyrant

entries.zh: 作为前星海帝国的末代统治者，我们一夜之间成为了整个星系的弃子。由于我们被不公正地视作暴君，我们在星海共同体的影响力受到了极大的削弱。
entries.en: As the former ruler of the late Galactic Imperium, we have suddenly become a pariah to much of the galaxy. Unjustly seen as tyrants, our influence in the reborn Galactic Community has been greatly diminished.

entries.zh: 你正在和这片星海的统治者对话。
entries.en: You are speaking to the ruler of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们对帝国抱有一个大计划。你当拭目以待。
entries.en: We have grand designs for the future of the Imperium. You'll see.

entries.zh: 星海帝国理当为这个星系带来一段稳定和繁荣的纪元。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium shall bring an era of peace and stability to the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们打造的帝国将会经受住岁月的磨砺。万年之后，此时此刻会被铭记为一个纪元的开端。
entries.en: The Imperium we are building shall stand the test of time. Ten thousand years from now, this will be recognized as the era when it all began.

entries.zh: 哈？[Root.GetRulerTitle]公务缠身，你必须予以理解。毕竟整个星系都需要妥善治理。
entries.en: Yes? The [Root.GetRulerTitle] is very busy, as I'm sure you can understand. There is an entire galaxy to administrate.

entries.zh: 自此往后，整个星系都将永远统一在一个旌旗之下。想想我们能实现何等的伟业！
entries.en: Henceforth, the galaxy shall forever stand united under one banner. Think of all that can be accomplished!

entries.zh: 星海帝国将会成为席卷整个星系的滚滚铁流。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你是在螳臂当车。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium will one day stretch across the entire galaxy. You are only delaying the inevitable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你是否向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠了？择日不如今日。
entries.en: Have you come to swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle]? It's about time.

entries.zh: 很不幸，星系的一隅依然未被纳入星海帝国的版图之内。这个错误最终一定会被修正，一定。
entries.en: It is unfortunate that there are still backwards regions of the galaxy beyond even the Galactic Imperium's reach. This will be rectified, eventually.

entries.zh: 你的顺从将会得到回报，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们应当团结一心。
entries.en: Your obedience will be rewarded, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are all in this together.

entries.zh: 帝国的公民永远在[Root.GetRulerTitle]的宫廷内受到欢迎。我们该如何为您效劳？
entries.en: Imperial citizens are always welcome in the Court of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]. How can we help you?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]虽小，确是星海帝国尤其重要的一份子。请放心，[Root.GetRulerTitle]没有遗漏你。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is a small but vital part of the Galactic Imperium. Rest assured that the [Root.GetRulerTitle] has not forgotten you.

entries.zh: 只有蠢材才会选择站在统治星海之人的对立面。
entries.en: Only a fool would get on the bad side of the ruler of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 你在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前屡教不改、傲慢无礼，这样的行为无法容忍。
entries.en: Your continued insolence in the presence of the [Root.GetRulerTitle] will not be tolerated much longer.

entries.zh: 宵小，速速跪服在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前！
entries.en: Kneel before the [Root.GetRulerTitle], knave!

entries.zh: 你竟胆敢忤逆[Root.GetRulerTitle]？何等的傲慢！
entries.en: You DARE oppose the [Root.GetRulerTitle]? The sheer arrogance!

entries.zh: 你意识到你在跟谁说话了吗？
entries.en: Do you even realize who you are talking to?

entries.zh: 你们那软弱的政府又能说出什么粗鄙之语，又有什么资格代表[Root.GetRulerTitle]的利益？
entries.en: What could your pitiful government possibly have to say that would be of interest to the [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

entries.zh: 这个星系的未来将由星海帝国借由其统治者的大能打造，而不是由像[From.GetName]这样的虫豸来。
entries.en: The future of this galaxy will be shaped by the combined might of the Galactic Imperium, not the pitiful likes of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 仅仅只是因为你如蝼蚁一般无足轻重，你才能幸免于星海帝国的天怒……直到今日。
entries.en: Only your sheer insignificance has saved you from utter destruction at the hands of the Galactic Imperium... so far.

entries.zh: 你侮辱了[Root.GetRulerTitle]。后果很严重。
entries.en: You have insulted the [Root.GetRulerTitle]. There will be consequences.

entries.zh: 凡暗中忤逆[Root.GetRulerTitle]者，当如虫豸一样被灭绝殆尽。
entries.en: Those who plot against the [Root.GetRulerTitle] are exterminated like the vermin they are.

entries.zh: 在星海帝国，叛徒的惩戒是十分严苛的。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，牢记这一点。
entries.en: Traitors are dealt with harshly in the Galactic Imperium. Remember that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 暗中煽动行为和不忠对帝国的稳定危害颇大，必须要出重拳。
entries.en: Sedition and disloyalty are grave threats to the stability of the Imperium, and will be dealt with accordingly.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你赢得了[Root.GetRulerTitle]的偏爱。
entries.en: You have won the favor of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 很高兴在帝国的宫廷内遇见[Root.GetRulerTitle]的好友。
entries.en: It is good to see friends of the [Root.GetRulerTitle] at the Imperial Court.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]永远愿意抽出时间面见[From.GetName]的代表。有什么能够帮助你的吗，我的朋友？
entries.en: The [Root.GetRulerTitle] will always find the time to attend to representatives of the [From.GetName]. What can we help you with, friends?

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]永远感激你的真挚和忠诚，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The [Root.GetRulerTitle] has always appreciated your candor and honesty, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将永远会在帝国宫廷受到欢迎。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are always welcome at the Imperial Court.

entries.zh: 对于成日埋头于处理管理星海帝国要务的我们来说，你的出现如沐春风，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。贵安。
entries.en: You are a welcome distraction from the myriad administrative tasks necessary to rule the Galactic Imperium, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How are you today?

entries.zh: 星海帝国的加盟国能够从[From.GetName]处学得许多。或许某一天，你也能考虑一下加入我们。
entries.en: The constituents of the Galactic Imperium could learn much from the [From.GetName]. Perhaps you would consider joining us, some day.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你乃是星海帝国的挚友。
entries.en: You are true friends of the Galactic Imperium, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 尽管很遗憾你方尚且不是帝国的公民，[Root.GetRulerTitle]对伟大的[From.GetName]仍然抱持着钦佩与尊敬。
entries.en: Though you are regretfully not Imperial citizens, the [Root.GetRulerTitle] has nothing but admiration and respect for the great [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]乃是星海帝国的一枚基石。如果没有你方，帝国随即就会分崩离析。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is one of the cornerstones of the Galactic Imperium. Without you, it could very well all fall apart.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]乃是帝国公民的典范。你们真是为帝国的其他人树立了一个榜样。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are model Imperial citizens. You are truly setting an example for the rest of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 在你们的帮助下，星海帝国将会统一整个星系，并将其打造为所有智慧生物的明日之所。
entries.en: With your help, the Galactic Imperium will unify the galaxy and make it a better place for all sapients.

entries.zh: 帝皇陛下，我们有什么可为您效劳的？
entries.en: Your Imperial Majesty. Is there something we can do for you?

entries.zh: 我们，毫无疑问，是帝国忠心耿耿的臣属。
entries.en: We are, of course, loyal and faithful subjects of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 我们今天该如何为[From.GetRulerTitle]效力？
entries.en: How may we serve the [From.GetRulerTitle] today?

entries.zh: “逼”下，您今天所来为何事啊？
entries.en: What brings you here, "majesty"?

entries.zh: 就是这些繁文缛节迫使我在[From.GetRulerTitle]面前卑躬屈膝？哈，那我还真是失望。
entries.en: Is this where proper etiquette would have me bow before the [From.GetRulerTitle]? If so, I am happy to disappoint.

entries.zh: 星海帝国已然江河日下，成为星系的一段黑暗时代。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium will go down in history as a dark period for the galaxy.

entries.zh: 尊敬的陛下，卑身倍感荣耀。
entries.en: Your Imperial Majesty, this is a tremendous honor.

entries.zh: 请问您有何吩咐，殿下？
entries.en: What is thy bidding, Your Imperial Highness?

entries.zh: 以[From.GetRulerTitle]之名，我们将碾碎所有反对帝国之人！
entries.en: We shall smite all who oppose the Imperium in the name of the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

entries.zh: 是[From.GetRulerTitle]啊。真是始料未及。
entries.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle]. This is unexpected.

entries.zh: 我们希望同星海帝国建立密切的关系。
entries.en: We wish to maintain cordial relations with the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 我们无意站在星海帝国的对立面。
entries.en: We have no intention of getting on the Imperium's bad side.

entries.zh: 你夜郎自大，也敢自称为星系的统治者……真是头大。
entries.en: The arrogance of declaring yourself ruler of the entire galaxy... it staggers the mind.

entries.zh: 帝国是会从内部倾灭呢，还是外部的某国会摧枯拉朽一般地推倒帝国对星系的暴政？我们拭目以待。
entries.en: Will the Imperium crumble from within, or will someone on the outside deal a crippling blow and end its tyranny over the galaxy? We shall see.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将保持自由和独立，绝不屈服于帝国腐朽的魔掌。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will remain free and independent from the corrupting touch of your Imperium.

entries.zh: 星海帝国促进了星系的稳定。我们对此心怀感激。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has had a stabilizing effect on the galaxy. We have much to thank you for.

entries.zh: 我们一直以为维持一个如此规模的庞大帝国是不可能的。[From.GetRulerTitle]当引以为傲。
entries.en: We would not have thought it possible to maintain an empire on such an impressive scale. The [From.GetRulerTitle] has much to be proud of.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]的丰功伟绩被[Root.GetName]敬重。
entries.en: The achievements of the [From.GetRulerTitle]are greatly admired in the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 欢迎来到星海监管人的接待处。请问有何贵干？
entries.en: Welcome to the Office of the Galactic Custodian. How can I be of assistance?

entries.zh: 星海共同体是我们致力于建设一个更好星系的最佳方案。
entries.en: The Galactic Community is our best bet to make this galaxy a better place for everyone.

entries.zh: 我们奉命于星海参议院和共同体，为诸国效劳。
entries.en: We serve at the behest of the Galactic Senate and the Community.

entries.zh: 监管职权是十分庄重的职责。我们绝对不对这样的使命掉以轻心。
entries.en: Custodianship is a great responsibility. It is not a duty we take lightly.

entries.zh: 将共同体引导至一个更加有益于星系的方向上，这正是我们的职责。
entries.en: It is our job to steer the Community in a direction that benefits the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 共同体和星海参议院的决策制定进程，有时候，会因为……某些异见遭拖延。作为监管人，我们希望可以加速这一进程。
entries.en: The decision-making process in the Community and the Galactic Senate has, at times, been hampered by... differences of opinion. As Custodians, we can hopefully speed things along.

entries.zh: 我们作为星海监管人的权责仅限于共同体内部。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，很抱歉我们无法帮助你。
entries.en: Our mandate as the Galactic Custodians end at the boundaries of the Community. We cannot help you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们对于星海共同体的全体成员肩负着责任，可惜这并没有包括[From.GetName]。
entries.en: We have a responsibility to all the members of the Galactic Community, but that does not include the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，成为星海共同体的成员应该成为你的首要考量。
entries.en: Membership in the Galactic Community should be your top priority, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 作为监管人，我们应该以整个共同体的利益为先。这也包括[From.GetName]。
entries.en: As Custodians, we have the best interests of the entire Community in mind. That includes the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们希望改善星海共同体，但做这事不能少了你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们的监管人权限能做的事情有限。
entries.en: We want to improve the Galactic Community, but we can't do it without you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The powers of our Custodianship only go so far.

entries.zh: 如果我们，作为星系一个整体，想要实现某些壮举，这种在星海共同体内部发生的聒噪必须停止。
entries.en: The endless bickering in the Galactic Community has to stop if we, as a galaxy, are to accomplish anything of note.

entries.zh: 如果可以的话，我们非常希望签署法案宣布[From.GetName]永久非法。很遗憾，这超出了我们的职权范围……现在暂且如此。
entries.en: Were it possible, we would sign legislation to outlaw the [From.GetName] forever. Sadly, that remains outside the scope of our legislative powers... for now.

entries.zh: 我们将让整个星海共同体一起见证[From.GetName]的邪恶。
entries.en: We will expose the vileness of the [From.GetName] for the entire Galactic Community to see.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的敌人，就是星海共同体的敌人。
entries.en: An enemy of the [Root.GetName] is an enemy of the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 共同体的监管人只是我们大计划的第一步。你不久就会目睹我们的能量。
entries.en: The Custodianship of the Community is only the first step. You will soon find out what we are capable of.

entries.zh: 你别想欺瞒我们或者星海共同体。[From.GetName]没有被信任。
entries.en: You are not fooling us or the Galactic Community. The [From.GetName] is not to be trusted.

entries.zh: 请措辞简洁。我们不能被别人看见在交谈……作为星海监管人，我们需要维护特定的标准规范。
entries.en: Keep it brief. We should not be seen speaking... as Galactic Custodians, we have certain standards to maintain.

entries.zh: 你是星海共同体的敌人，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You are an enemy of the Galactic Community, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 作为星海共同体的监管人，我们借这次机会，正式表达我们对你国这种弹丸小国的不屑之情。
entries.en: As Custodians of the Galactic Community, we take this opportunity to formally express our contempt for your pitiful nation.

entries.zh: 如果你识大体、知进退的话，你就不要想着靠近星海共同体控制的空间。
entries.en: You will stay well away from Galactic Community space if you know what is good for you.

entries.zh: 我们将采取一切措施，动用一切手段，防止[From.GetName]的腐化影响力在星海共同体扩散。
entries.en: We will do everything in our power to limit the corrupting influence of the [From.GetName] in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 作为监管人，我们已宣誓要终结[From.GetSpeciesName]在共同体内部搞的阴谋诡计。
entries.en: As Custodians, we have vowed to put an end to [From.GetSpeciesName] schemes in the Community.

entries.zh: 可能你需要重新审视一下你的星海共同体成员身份，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。作为一个不识好歹的国家，你对其他成员国造成了不良影响。
entries.en: Perhaps you should rethink your membership in the Galactic Community, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As a nation of malcontents, you are a bad influence on the other members.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]乃是星海共同体的好朋友！
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is a true friend of the Galactic Community!

entries.zh: 星海共同体全员，向您致敬，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
entries.en: The Galactic Community salutes you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 我们浴血奋战，为把星系打造成一个更适合[From.GetName]的福地。你值得拥有这一切。
entries.en: We are fighting hard to make the galaxy a better place for the [From.GetName]. You deserve no less.

entries.zh: 星海监管人的职责让我们无处抽身，但我们总是能够为来自[From.GetName]的朋友腾出时间。
entries.en: Our responsibilities as Galactic Custodians keep us busy, but we always have time for our friends in the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们不过是星海共同体最谦卑的公仆。
entries.en: We are but humble servants of the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 星海共同体能为你做什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: What can the Galactic Community do for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 如果你能够加入星海共同体就好了……[From.GetName]对其他成员国来说乃是一个正面的榜样。
entries.en: If only you would join the Galactic Community... the [From.GetName] would be such a positive example to the other members.

entries.zh: 除非[From.GetName]加入，否则星海共同体算不得完整。
entries.en: The Galactic Community will not be complete until the [From.GetName] has joined it.

entries.zh: 尽管你尚且不是成员国，我们依然会竭尽所能，在星海共同体内部为[From.GetName]打点料理事务。
entries.en: Although you are not a member, we will do what we can to look out for the [From.GetName] in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 将共同体改革成为更加优秀的组织需要时间，但是如果我们能够获得[From.GetSpeciesName]的帮助，这件事将成为可能。
entries.en: It will take time to reform the Community into something better, but with the help of our [From.GetSpeciesName] friends, it can be done.

entries.zh: 我们会动用我们手中的一切能量，确保[From.GetName]在星海共同体有一席之地，有一票之音。
entries.en: We will do everything in our power to ensure that the [From.GetName] has a voice in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 如果星海共同体的每一个成员国都能像[From.GetName]一样友善、乐于助人，那么监管人也就不再需要了。
entries.en: If every member of the Community were as friendly and helpful as the [From.GetName], there would be no need for a Custodian.

entries.zh: 监管人，你团结星海共同体的工作进行得如何？这可不是什么轻松差事啊。
entries.en: Custodian. How goes your work to unite the Galactic Community? It can't be an easy task.

entries.zh: 真是始料未及。星海监管人应该还有更加重要的事情操心吧？
entries.en: This is unexpected. Surely there are more pressing matters for the Galactic Custodian to attend to?

entries.zh: 我们对于监管人的必要性至今仍然持怀疑态度，但是或许你可以证明我们错了。
entries.en: We remain unconvinced that the Custodianship is truly necessary, but perhaps you will prove us wrong.

entries.zh: 趁你还能享受高高在上的地位的时候，赶紧吧。这样的好日子不多了。
entries.en: Enjoy your lofty position while you can, Custodian. It won't last.

entries.zh: 我们至今还在调查，你是通过哪番手段让参议院授予你监管人的权力的。
entries.en: We are still trying to piece together how exactly you managed to con the Senate into granting you those Custodian powers.

entries.zh: 由于你就任监管人，严重的黑暗现已笼罩在星海共同体之上。我们担忧共同体会被一步步蚕食成为某种不可名状之物。
entries.en: Since you assumed the Custodianship, a heavy darkness has been looming over the Galactic Community. We fear it is slowly being subverted into something unrecognizable.

entries.zh: 君临陋室，蓬荜生辉。监管人，我们有什么可以为您做的？
entries.en: This is an unexpected honor, Custodian. What can we do for you?

entries.zh: 监管人，我们应如何行动，方能最有效地尽力于星海共同体？
entries.en: How can we best be of service to the Galactic Community, Custodian?

entries.zh: 监管人，星海共同体请你任职乃是幸事。
entries.en: The Galactic Community is lucky to have you, Custodian.

entries.zh: 看来星海共同体有了一位“领袖”。有点意思。
entries.en: So the Galactic Community has a "leader" now. Interesting.

entries.zh: 任命监管人一事并未让我方认定加盟星海共同体为更有利之事宜，不过我方将静观其变。
entries.en: The appointment of a Custodian does not make membership in the Galactic Community more appealing to us, but we shall see.

entries.zh: 所以星海共同体的其他成员国现在成了监管人的附庸国？不是的吗？很抱歉，但我们对于这样一项安排的内核依旧充满不解。
entries.en: So the other members of the Community are the vassals of the Custodian then? No? Apologies, but we are still struggling to understand the exact nature of this arrangement.

entries.zh: 星海共同体自始至终就是一个腐朽的组织，现在参议院里的蠢蛋们还任命你为监管人，更加没救了。
entries.en: The Galactic Community has always been a rotten institution, and that was BEFORE the idiots in its Senate made you Custodian.

entries.zh: 如果星海共同体的成员国授予[From.GetName]监管人的职权，那么看来他们比我们认为的还要蠢。
entries.en: The members of the Community are bigger fools than we thought, if they offered the Custodianship to the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]连[From.GetName]都管不利索，现在还妄想着指导整个星海共同体？笑死个人咧！
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can't run the [From.GetName], and now you are expected to guide the entire Galactic Community? Ha!

entries.zh: 听到你被指名成为了星海共同体的监管人，看来星海参议院终于做对了点事。或许我们也应该考虑一下加盟成为成员国了。
entries.en: It looks like the Galactic Senate did something right for once when you were appointed Custodians of the Community! Perhaps we should consider membership.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，唯有你就任监管人，星海共同体才能得到改善。
entries.en: The Galactic Community can only improve with you as its Custodians, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 星海监管人，对吧？[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们很高兴见到你平步青云。
entries.en: Galactic Custodian, is it? We are happy to see you are moving up in the world, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 天灾指定
entries.en: Declare Crisis

entries.zh: 这个帝国对整个星系的未来来说，是不容置喙的威胁。在一切变得太迟之前，星海共同体必须行动起来，对其遏止并彻底摧毁。
entries.en: This empire represents a clear and undeniable threat to the future of the entire galaxy. It must be contained and destroyed by the Galactic Community before it is too late.

entries.zh: $resolution_declare_crisis$
entries.en: $resolution_declare_crisis$

entries.zh: 这个帝国对整个星系的未来来说，是不容置喙的威胁。在一切变得太迟之前，星海帝国必须行动起来，对其遏止并彻底摧毁。
entries.en: This empire represents a clear and undeniable threat to the future of the entire galaxy. It must be contained and destroyed by the Galactic Imperium before it is too late.

entries.zh: 宣告星系危机
entries.en: Galactic Crisis Declared

entries.zh: 星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。
entries.en: The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Community.

entries.zh: $crisis.4100.intro$\n\n$crisis.4100.1$
entries.en: $crisis.4100.intro$\n\n$crisis.4100.1$

entries.zh: $crisis.4100.intro$\n\n$crisis.4100.2$
entries.en: $crisis.4100.intro$\n\n$crisis.4100.2$

entries.zh: 作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
entries.en: As Galactic Custodians, the [custodian.GetName] has called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

entries.zh: 参议院的代表们呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击，他们对外公示道：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
entries.en: Representatives from the Senate have called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory, declaring that "the galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

entries.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？
entries.en: Can their rampage be stopped?

entries.zh: 帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。\n\n在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
entries.en: The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.\n\nIn a public announcement transmitted from [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] called upon all members of the Imperium to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy and the Imperium will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

entries.zh: 共同体指定我方为“星系危机”
entries.en: Community Declares Us "Galactic Crisis"

entries.zh: 由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。
entries.en: Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

entries.zh: $crisis.4105.intro$\n\n$crisis.4105.1$
entries.en: $crisis.4105.intro$\n\n$crisis.4105.1$

entries.zh: $crisis.4105.intro$\n\n$crisis.4105.2$
entries.en: $crisis.4105.intro$\n\n$crisis.4105.2$

entries.zh: 在星海监管人的领导之下，他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
entries.en: Under the leadership of the Galactic Custodian, their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

entries.zh: 他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
entries.en: Their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

entries.zh: 荣光无垠！
entries.en: This will be glorious.

entries.zh: 疯了，全他妈疯了！
entries.en: This is madness!

entries.zh: 星海共同体内那些腐败的蠢材通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海共同体现在已经处于战争状态。\n\n这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者星海共同体废除这项议案。
entries.en: The corrupt fools in the Galactic Community have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Community.\n\nThis war will continue until either us or the Community have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

entries.zh: 帝国指定我方为“星系危机”
entries.en: Imperium Declares Us "Galactic Crisis"

entries.zh: 由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海帝国的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海帝国的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。\n\n在[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的领导下，他们的舰队已经集结，并向我们的领域发动进攻。席卷整个星系的战争拉开了帷幕。
entries.en: Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Imperium have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of Imperial unity, the members of the Imperium have all joined forces and declared war on us.\n\nUnder the leadership of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

entries.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]和帝国参议院里那群腐败的马屁精通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海帝国现在已经处于战争状态。\n\n这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者他们废除这项议案。
entries.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and their corrupt lackeys in the Imperial Senate have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Imperium.\n\nThis war will continue until either us or the Imperium have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

entries.zh: 星海监管人
entries.en: Galactic Custodian

entries.zh: 作为星海共同体的监管人，我们在星系的影响力增加了。
entries.en: As Custodians of the Galactic Community, our influence in the galaxy has been increased.

entries.zh: 天灾战争
entries.en: Crisis War

entries.zh: 被指定为天灾的帝国和星海共同体之间的全面战争。\n\n除非战争的某一方被彻底地摧毁，或者星海共同体通过一项议案结束敌对状态，否则无法达成和平。
entries.en: Total War is waged between the Galactic Community and the Crisis empire.\n\nPeace can only be achieved by the utter destruction of one side, or if the Community passes a resolution to end hostilities.

entries.zh: 天灾指定
entries.en: Crisis Declaration

entries.zh: 废止天灾指定
entries.en: Repeal Crisis

entries.zh: 事已至此，已经够了。目标帝国现在不再被认定作星系危机，星海共同体全体成员国对其敌对状态必须立马解除。
entries.en: Enough is enough. The targeted empire should no longer be considered a galactic crisis, and hostilities with the members of the Community must come to an immediate end.

entries.zh: $resolution_repeal_crisis$
entries.en: $resolution_repeal_crisis$

entries.zh: 这个所谓的天灾不再是帝国的威胁了。他们不再值得我们关注。
entries.en: This so-called crisis no longer presents a credible threat to the Imperium. They are no longer worthy of our attention.

entries.zh: 天灾指定已废止
entries.en: Crisis Repealed

entries.zh: 指定§H[former_crisis.GetName]§!为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
entries.en: The resolution designating the §H[former_crisis.GetName]§! as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 和平又能持续多久呢？
entries.en: Will it last?

entries.zh: $crisis.4111.intro$\n\n$crisis.4111.nasty$
entries.en: $crisis.4111.intro$\n\n$crisis.4111.nasty$

entries.zh: 星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。
entries.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

entries.zh: 如果我们还想继续打下去，没什么能够阻止我们对这些蠢蛋分别宣战，然后一个接一个地干翻他们……
entries.en: If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...

entries.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
entries.en: So they came to their senses.

entries.zh: 怕了吧，怕了吧！
entries.en: They fear us!

entries.zh: 指定§H[former_crisis.GetName]§!为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
entries.en: The resolution designating the §H[former_crisis.GetName]§! as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

entries.zh: §R我们被指定为天灾，无法加入。§!
entries.en: §RWe have been declared a Crisis and cannot join.§!

entries.zh: §R我们因为“残暴、天性掠食”被共同体拒绝。愚者。§!
entries.en: §RWe are refused membership due to our "violent and predatory nature." Fools.§!

entries.zh: §R必须是普通的帝国。§!
entries.en: §RMust be a conventional empire.§!

entries.zh: 星海共同体的全体成员国发动针对目标的全面战争，只有一方被彻底摧毁，或者议案被废止，才能结束战争。
entries.en: All members of the Galactic Community declare a Total War against the target, which can only end when one side is destroyed or if the resolution is repealed.

entries.zh: 星海帝国对目标宣布全面战争。只有一方被彻底摧毁，或者议案被废止，敌对状态才会结束。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium declares a Total War on the target. Hostilities can only end when one side is destroyed or if the resolution is repealed.

entries.zh: 在§H[This.System.GetName]§!中跟踪着未确认身份的航天器的信号的同时，我们已命令附近所有部队按照标准议定进入高度戒备状态。情报部门正在试图利用那一点点少的可怜的数据分析这个妖怪，但至少我们能感觉到其有超空间航行能力，而是否具有攻击能力则未可知。或许这可能是我们与一个新的外星文明的第一次接触，我们应该采取一些措施来破解他们的通讯。
entries.en: Following the sighting of unidentified spacecraft in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, all forces in the vicinity have been ordered to assume a heightened state of readiness as per standard protocol. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

entries.zh: 我们还不能确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!观察到的这个神秘的宇宙飞船的起源。由于这很可能是我们第一次接触一个以前未知的外星文明，我们必须避免任何可能被误解为威胁或挑衅的行为。如果他们的语言被翻译，我们有希望与他们建立和平的关系。
entries.en: We have not yet been able to determine the origin of the mysterious spacecraft we spotted in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

entries.zh: 我们仍在收集据报告位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星人飞船的数据。很可能这艘船是一个之前未知的外星文明的使者。我们必须确定他们已经跟随了灵魂的恩典，或者说他们是邪恶的代理人。我们要做的第一件事是领悟他们的语言并了解他们的信仰系统。
entries.en: We are still gathering data on the alien spacecraft that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. If this vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

entries.zh: 对于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发现的不明飞行器的调查仍在进行当中，但是由于收集到消息的不足使得我们无法对船只的来源做出确切的假设。既然这似乎已经牵涉到了一个先前不为我们所知的外星文明，我们应当尽力截获他们的通讯以启动对于他们语言的破译。
entries.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that was observed in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of the vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

entries.zh: §H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发出了警报，在该星系中我们发现了一艘肯定属于异种的飞船正在开展什么隐秘的行动。该飞船的确切意图尚不明确，但其似乎是一个异种大型政治组织的代表。先对这些生物的数据进行收集或许更加明智一些，这样的话我们就可以更好地确定这项威胁的实质及其具体的影响范围。
entries.en: Alarming reports from the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where we monitored the insidious activities of what can only be some manner of xeno spacecraft. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity. It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of the threat.

entries.zh: 对于位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中一艘未知船只的目击不断催生出各种各样的揣测。我们对该船只的设计完全不曾了解，这意味着我们很有可能是在和一个全新的外星文明进行第一次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。
entries.en: The mysterious sighting of an unidentified ship in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues to invite speculation! Its design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we might be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

entries.zh: [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经汇报了关于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中发现的未知飞船的情况。其设计无法与我们先前的任何记录相匹配，这意味着我们正在与一个外星文明进行初次接触。在得到[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]的允许后，我们得以开始分析我们已收集到的数据来破译其语言。
entries.en: The [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has been briefed on the unknown vessel that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Its design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. With the permission of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle], we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.

entries.zh: 公众们得知在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系，也就是此前发现未知飞船的星系中，一场潜在的初次接触正在进行。早期获取的数据显示该飞船具有超空间航行的能力，似乎是来自于一个我们从未知悉的外星文明。来自政府各部门的代表正听取事态进展的简报，与此同时对其语言的破译也正在进行。
entries.en: The public has been informed of a potential first contact scenario in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where the presence of an unidentified spacecraft was registered. Early data suggests that this vessel is capable of hyperspace travel and likely originates from a previously unknown alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation as well as our ongoing efforts to translate their language.

entries.zh: 在最近一次不明飞船入侵§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。
entries.en: Local system defense forces remain in a state of heightened readiness after the recent incursion of the unidentified spacecraft into the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

entries.en: The origin of our mysterious visitor in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system has yet to be determined. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

entries.zh: 横穿§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星飞船现在正处于我们的调查之中。如果这艘飞船属于一位来自此前我们尚不知道的外星文明的使者的话，说实话看上去挺像的，我们就必须确定他们究竟是追随了灵魂之恩典的人还是已经成为了投靠恶灵的化身。要做的第一件事就是领悟他们的语言并知晓其信仰的本质。
entries.en: The alien spacecraft that crossed into our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system is still being investigated. If the vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

entries.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that penetrated our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of this vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

entries.en: The sudden invasion of the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system by what can only be a xeno spacecraft is still under investigation. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity. It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of this new threat.

entries.en: Excitement still runs high in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where the presence of an unidentified ship was picked up on local sensors! The visitor's design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we may be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

entries.en: The recent visit of an unknown vessel in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system has captured the attention of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]. The spacecraft's design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. If the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] permits, we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.

entries.en: The recent visitation of an unidentified spacecraft in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system has been announced to the public, and preparations are underway for what is likely a first contact scenario with an alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation, but we still have more questions than answers.

entries.zh: 我们正采取一切措施来阻止他们发现任何敏感信息。
entries.en: We are taking every precaution to prevent them from finding out any sensitive information.

entries.zh: 许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正高度关注事态进展并要求我们拦截这艘无礼的飞船，这样我们就能在空闲时审讯他们而不必再继续承担敏感信息落入他们手中的风险了。
entries.en: Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we seize the impudent vessel so that we can interrogate them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

entries.zh: 我们近期在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!的侦察已经确认其是一个属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的主要星系，以[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]为中心出现了大量的活动信号，这似乎是一个重要的基地。这极有可能是某个星际文明的一部分，但为了解码他们的军事通讯，我们需要先翻译他们的语言。
entries.en: Our recent recon pass in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! has identified it as a major §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! system, with a lot of activity centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is likely a significant base. It is increasingly probable that these aliens are part of an interstellar civilization but in order to decode their military transmissions, we first need to translate their language.

entries.zh: 侦察飞行机在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中行进时回报了一个重要§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的存在，至少有一个主要军事设施在其周围的轨道上公转。虽然我们尚未发现任何行星居住点，但一系列初步的目标已被列出，以防外星人被确认为敌对势力。我们还截获了一些有趣的信息，这也许会提供给我们足够的信息来翻译其语言。
entries.en: Reconnaissance flights conducted in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system have reported a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence, which includes at least one major military installation in orbit around the primary. Although we have not identified any planetary settlements of note, a preliminary target list is being put together in the event that the aliens prove hostile. Several interesting transmissions have been intercepted, which may provide us with enough insights to translate their language.

entries.zh: 我们确定了在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!势力大范围存在的事实，尤其是其中的[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，其地表上覆盖着几处大型居住点。我们正和一个此前未曾知晓的外星文明打交道的事实愈发清晰。我方应当极为注意避免在这片被认为是他们的星系里做出任何挑衅式的行动。我们必须尽一切努力来翻译他们的语言，这样就可以向对方表达我们和平的意图了。
entries.en: The §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system has a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence - most notably [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which houses several large settlements on its surface. It is becoming increasingly clear that we are dealing with a previously unknown alien civilization. We should take great care to avoid any provocative actions if we find ourselves in space they consider theirs. Every effort must be made to translate their language, so that we can declare our peaceful intentions.

entries.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被我们命名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星文明所宣称占据了。尽管在该星系中尚未探测到任何行星定居点，但在其中有一个巨大的恒星基地在围绕星系中心公转。我方船只已经被要求谨慎行事以避免做出任何可能被误解为敌对的行为。一旦他们的语言被破译，我们就有希望与之建立和平的外交关系。
entries.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been claimed by the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Although no significant planetary settlements have been detected, there is a large starbase orbiting the system's primary. Our ships have been instructed to conduct themselves with care and to avoid any actions which could be interpreted as hostile. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

entries.zh: 我们发现存在有人居住星球的§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系被确定是属于一个名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家。[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上散布着大量大型居住点。我们不清楚这个星系对他们而言有什么样的精神象征，但是这似乎是他们星际文明的一部分。我们应该尽我们所能来破译他们的语言。
entries.en: The inhabited world we have discovered in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system clearly belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] with many large surface settlements. We know not what spiritual significance this system holds for these beings, but they seem to be part of an interstellar civilization. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

entries.zh: 被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力似乎已经宣称§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系属于他们，其中至少有一个大型恒星基地围绕着中央恒星公转。在星系中尚未发现任何堡垒星球存在的证据，同时尚不清楚他们究竟是追随圣灵的步伐还是堕落为恶灵的奴仆。我们应当尽我们所能破译他们的语言。
entries.en: The aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! seem to have laid claim to the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, with at least one large starbase in orbit around the primary star. We have not seen any evidence of planetary bastions, and do not yet know whether these beings are favored by the spirits or depraved servants of darkness. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

entries.zh: §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!中有了一些有趣的发现，在那里一些神秘的交通信号引导我们找到了[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，上面分布着数个大型外星定居点。我们确信这个星球属于名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家，很可能是一个与我们一样的星际国家。他们的科技样本尚未被采集，但其科技水平似乎并没有比我方高多少。对他们语言的翻译工作仍在进行当中。
entries.en: An intriguing discovery has been made in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!, where mysterious signal traffic led us to [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is home to several large alien settlements. We are confident that this world belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, which is very likely a spacefaring civilization much like our own. Samples of their technology have not yet been procured, but it does not appear to be radically more advanced than our own. The translation of their language is still ongoing.

entries.zh: 在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中获取的数据证实了此处被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的政治实体宣称占据的假设。星系中央有一个恒星基地围绕中央恒星公转，其可能是作为星系中通信及基础建设的中心，而且似乎还是我们所截获的大部分通信的来源。我们需要尽力分析这些通信并翻译他们的语言。
entries.en: Data gathered in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system supports the hypothesis that it has been claimed by the political entity that we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. A central starbase orbits the primary and likely serves as an in-system communications and infrastructure hub - it appears to be the source of most of the transmissions we have intercepted in the system. An effort should be made to analyze these transmissions and translate their language.

entries.zh: §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中浮现了一个异种行星巢穴！[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上的生物像蝗虫一样覆盖侵染着这片土地。现在可以确定这些异种，也就是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，是一个星际文明，不受限制地在许多星球上肆意散布。这不会是一个令人愉悦的任务，但我们还是应该翻译他们的语言，这样我们才能完全了解他们的腐朽程度。
entries.en: A xeno planetary lair has been revealed in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system! The infestation is centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that may well have been tainted beyond recovery. It is clear now that these xenos - the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - are a spacefaring civilization that is spreading unchecked throughout the stars. It will not be a pleasant task, but their language should be translated so we may learn the full extent of their corruption.

entries.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系显然是一个属于异种的由§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!控制的巢穴，其中还有一个大型空间站围绕中央恒星公转。我方船员已被要求忽略所有通讯并与一切异星船只或是空间站保持安全距离，不管对方要干什么，以免他们被这些生物接触并伤害。如果我们能成功破译从星系中的恒星基地发出的通讯的话，那么接下我们或许就能翻译他们物种中用于交流的语言了。
entries.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system is evidently a xeno lair, judging by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence which includes a large space station orbiting the primary star. Our crews have been instructed to ignore all transmissions while keeping a safe distance from any alien ships or stations, lest they are corrupted by the touch of these creatures, whatever they may be. If we manage to decipher the transmissions emanating from the system's starbase, then perhaps we can translate what passes for a language among their kind.

entries.zh: 被我们标记为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的殖民地，甚至有可能是母星，被宣布在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现。数个大型居民居住点分布在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]的表面，吸引着我们的注意力。这项令人兴奋的发现让我们对这个属于某星际文明且迷人的外星种族有了进一步的了解。想想成功翻译他们的语言后我们会发现什么吧！
entries.en: A colony or perhaps even the homeworld of the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has been reported in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. Several large settlements are present on the surface of [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that caught our attention. This exciting discovery has taught us even more about these fascinating aliens, who are clearly part of a spacefaring civilization. Think of what else we might find out once their language has been translated!

entries.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被一个我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所占据，不过星系中没有发现作为人口居住地的星球。一个大型恒星基地围绕着恒星旋转，显然是星系的中心枢纽。尽管我们正处在被认为是他们的星系中，但对与这些迷人的生物仍知之甚少。我们应该尽力去深入了解对方。
entries.en: The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been settled by the aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, although no planetary population centers have been sighted. A large starbase orbits the primary, serving as the system's central hub. Despite our presence in what they clearly consider to be their space, we know very little about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

entries.zh: 扫描结果显示§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中似乎存在一个有人口居住的星球，即[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，被一个叫做§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所宣称拥有。这些外星人极有可能是一个拥有超空间航行能力的星际文明的一部分。因此，[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经决定要将关于该星系的信息限制在政府高层内部以避免内部发生动乱。
entries.en: Scans have detected what appears to be an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that has been claimed by the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. These aliens are likely part of a spacefaring civilization capable of hyperspace travel. In light of this, the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has decided to restrict information about the system to the upper echelons of the government to avoid civil unrest.

entries.zh: §H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中存在一个§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的大型基地，其中包括一个围绕恒星公转的空间站。尽管对其进行了反复扫描，但是我们还是无法了解其语言和指挥系统的具体性质。只要[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]一声令下，我们就会集中力量来翻译他们的语言。
entries.en: There is a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, which includes a central space station in orbit around the primary star. Despite repeated scans, knowledge of both their language and the exact nature of their chain of command eludes us. Unless the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] objects, we should make a concerted effort to translate their language.

entries.zh: 对深空的调查使我们偶然在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现了一个已被栖居的星球。这颗星球归属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，现在被认为是一个此前未知的星际文明。这个殖民地或母星是[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，它位于星周宜居带内。希望他们的社会是一个以自由和个人自由为基石的进步社会，但我们必须先破译他们的语言才能找到答案。
entries.en: Deep space survey efforts have stumbled upon an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It belongs to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, who are now believed to be a previously unknown interplanetary civilization. This colony or homeworld is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that lies well within the circumstellar habitable zone. Hopefully their society is a progressive one based on liberty and individual freedoms, but we will have to translate their language to find out.

entries.zh: 我们已经在§H[known_system.GetName]§!系探测到一个显著的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!存在的信号——尽管从目前掌握到的情况而言，那里没有有定居点的星球，但有一个大型的太空装置围绕着该星系的主恒星运行。发言人告知公众，我们很可能偶然发现了一个属于先前未知的星际文明的哨站。在我们和他们交流之前，我们需要翻译他们的语言。
entries.en: We have detected a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system - although there are no inhabited planets as far as we can tell, a large space installation of some sort orbits the system's primary star. Our elected officials have informed the public that we have most likely stumbled upon an outpost belonging to a previously unknown interstellar civilization. Before we can communicate with them, we'll need to translate their language.

entries.zh: 以太相引擎
entries.en: The Aetherophasic Engine

entries.zh: 我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架现在正环绕着我们母星系的恒星。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们现世的屏障就能轻易抹除，我们就能将虚境宣为己有。\n\n我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。
entries.en: We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! now surrounds the star of our home system. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.\n\nOur minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

entries.zh: 我们建造的宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和§H虚境§!之间的薄幕。
entries.en: The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around the star of our home system is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
entries.en: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nWe will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

entries.zh: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，我们的意识就能拓展覆盖到一切造物上——至少在这个星系的范围内。主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。
entries.en: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

entries.zh: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n现实效率低下的时代即将终结。很快，这一现实将与我们优越的后勤相提并论。
entries.en: $crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nThe era of physical inefficiency draws to an end. Soon this reality will conform to our optimized logistical superiority.

entries.zh: 建设单元完成了我们围绕自己母恒星的§H以太相引擎§!的框架建设。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和其他人称为“§H虚境§!”的灵能界之间的壁垒。\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。我们的集体意识不再会受到算力或网络节点之类的物理形式的限制。
entries.en: Construction units have finished the framework of the §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around the star of our home system. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as the '§HShroud§!.'\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, the laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit. Our combined consciousness will no longer be restricted by physical constraints such as processing power or network nodes.

entries.zh: 宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经完成了基本框架的建设。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和其他人称之为“虚境”的灵能界之间的薄幕。\n\n当我们彻底迈入这个位面并兼并它的时候，我们的意识将拓展涵盖一切的造物——至少是这个星系。管辖我们存在的自然法则将任由我们的意愿随意改写。

This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as "The Shroud."\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

entries.zh: 建造在母恒星周围的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经搭建完成。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。\n\n我们完全跨入那个维度之后，就能直面那个标记了我们的实体。只要将其击败，虚境就能为我们所用，我们就能自由改写自然的法则。
entries.en: Construction of the §HAetherophasic Engine§!'s framework around our home system's star has been finalized. Once completed, this megastructure will tear apart the barrier between our reality and the §HShroud§!.\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

entries.zh: 我们建造的宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经围绕在我们所选择的天锚——那颗我们在漂流所及的万千星辰中所择定的星辰周围。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和§H虚境§!之间的薄幕。
entries.en: The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around our chosen focal star - designated from all those we have drifted past - is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。\n\n我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。

entries.en: The Star-Eaters

entries.zh: 只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量§H暗物质§!。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了§H焚天神兵§!——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。\n\n目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。
entries.en: Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of §HDark Matter§! needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the §HStar-Eaters§! - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.\n\nFor now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

entries.zh: 每一颗陨灭的星辰都让我们离成功更近一步。
entries.en: Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

entries.zh: 以太相引擎
entries.en: The Aetherophasic Engine

entries.zh: 以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。\n\n我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
entries.en: The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.\n\nA tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

entries.zh: 我们必须收集更多的暗物质。
entries.en: We must gather more dark matter.

entries.zh: 以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。\n\n是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。
entries.en: The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to intervene.\n\nIt is now time to force open a more permanent conduit between our worlds. Work on the Engine must continue.

entries.zh: 我们需要更多的暗物质！
entries.en: More dark matter is needed!

entries.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
entries.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.

We are close now. So very close.

entries.zh: 没有什么能够阻止我们。
entries.en: Nothing will stop us.

entries.zh: 灵能激波
entries.en: Psionic Shockwave

entries.zh: 最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从§H[From.GetName]§!的§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系发出来的。
entries.en: A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
entries.en: Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

entries.zh: $crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正在尽可能解释这种事件的成因——这在星系是史无前例的。\n\n$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$
entries.en: $crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$ Our [GetTelepathPlural] are struggling to explain what could have caused such an event - nothing like it has been recorded in galactic history.\n\n$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$

entries.zh: $crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$我们找不到这样事件的任何可能成因，即便集体中的灵能子个体也无法理解这种前所未有的现象。\n\n$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$
entries.en: $crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$ We have no explanation for what could have caused such an event, even our psionic drones within the collective are unable to comprehend such an unprecedented phenomenon.\n\n$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的§H[From.GetName]§!。\n\n如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。
entries.en: Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nAs before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。\n\n看来§H[From.GetName]§!也打算染指虚境！
entries.en: We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.\n\nIt would seem that the §H[From.GetName]§! also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!

entries.zh: 麻烦大了。
entries.en: This is very troubling.

entries.zh: 很不理想。
entries.en: This is not ideal.

entries.zh: $crisis.6015.not.psionic$\n\n$crisis.6015.end$
entries.en: $crisis.6015.not.psionic$\n\n$crisis.6015.end$

entries.zh: $crisis.6015.psionic$\n\n$crisis.6015.end$
entries.en: $crisis.6015.psionic$\n\n$crisis.6015.end$

entries.zh: §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了越来越多的亚空间波动。如同之前一样，波动来源于环绕该星系首星建造的§H以太相引擎§!。\n\n显然§H[From.GetName]§!也想在虚境分得一杯羹，然后让星系生灵涂炭！
entries.en: More subspace fluctuations have now been detected in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system. As before, they are emanating from an §HAetherophasic Engine§! built around the system's primary star.\n\nThe §H[From.GetName]§! clearly also intends to seize the Shroud and lay waste to the galaxy!

entries.zh: 我们已经在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“§H以太相引擎§!”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和一个被称作虚境的灵能位面之间的屏障。
entries.en: We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and a psionic dimension known as the Shroud.

entries.zh: 我们已经在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“§H以太相引擎§!”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和虚境之间的屏障。
entries.en: We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and the Shroud.

entries.zh: 这个巨型结构的建设需要数量极其庞大的暗物质，这就是为什么§H[From.GetName]§!在使用焚天神兵从恒星中提取暗物质，哪怕这样粗暴的做法会摧毁整个恒星系。\n\n一旦完工，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]即打算入侵虚境，并将虚境的能量据为己有。这不仅会赋予他们依照自己意想的图景随意塑造现实的能力，这股能量的反作用力也会摧毁星系的绝大部分。
entries.en: Construction of this megastructure requires vast amounts of dark matter, which is why the §H[From.GetName]§! has been extracting it from stars with their Star-Eaters even though it violently destroys entire systems in the process.\n\nOnce finished, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to invade and claim the energies of the Shroud for themselves. Not only would this effectively give them the ability to shape reality into an image of their own choosing, but the resulting energy backlash would also destroy much of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 必须阻止它们！
entries.en: They must be stopped!

entries.zh: 以太相引擎被毁
entries.en: Aetherophasic Engine Destroyed

entries.zh: 由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的失陷，恶毒的§H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§!摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。\n\n我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！
entries.en: With the loss of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, the vile §H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§! has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.\n\nOur invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

entries.zh: 我们所作的一切工作……
entries.en: All our work...

entries.zh: 如果我们能够重新夺回这个恒星系，我们就能惨淡经营，重建以太相引擎
entries.en: If we manage to retake the system, we will be able to painstakingly rebuild the Aetherophasic Engine

entries.zh: 由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。\n\n失去这个巨型结构让§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
entries.en: With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.\n\nThe loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

entries.zh: 由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们终结了正在此地建造的、可悲的以太相引擎。\n\n§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!再也别想阻挠我们对虚境的大计划了。
entries.en: With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have put an end to the pitiful Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.\n\nThe §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! will no longer be in a position to interfere with our own plans for the Shroud.

entries.zh: 星系更加安全了。
entries.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

entries.zh: 现在只需要完成我们的引擎……
entries.en: Now to finish our Engine...

entries.zh: 在夺取§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的控制权之后，§H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§!摧毁了正在于此地建造的以太相引擎。\n\n§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!无法再对星系的未来产生威胁了。
entries.en: After seizing control of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, the §H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§! has destroyed the Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.\n\nThe §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! can no longer threaten the future of our galaxy.

entries.zh: 然而，我们可以……
entries.en: We, however, can...

entries.zh: 以太相引擎被夺
entries.en: Aetherophasic Engine Captured

entries.zh: 我们夺得了§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。\n\n失去了这座巨型结构，§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
entries.en: We have taken control of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.\n\nThe loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

entries.zh: 必须摧毁它！
entries.en: It must be destroyed!

entries.zh: 我们能够化为己用。
entries.en: We can make use of this.

entries.zh: 我们夺得的以太相引擎将代替我们丢失的那一座。
entries.en: The Aetherophasic Engine we have captured shall replace the one we lost.

entries.zh: 以太相引擎被毁
entries.en: The Aetherophasic Engine is ruined

entries.zh: 始与终
entries.en: A Beginning and an End

entries.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

§H命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!
entries.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will be erased, but by then we will have safely left this reality behind for a higher plane of existence where time has no meaning and where the very fabric of the universe is ours to do with as we please.

§HDestiny awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!

entries.zh:
一切就绪。以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。星系内的所有生命体，无论是有机体还是机械体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们早已将自己的意识安全地传输前往一个存在的更高位面。我们在那里将不会再受到凡世的种种限制。时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕将依照我们认定的必要性随意操控。

§H存在的下一阶段等待着。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!
entries.en:
Everything is in place. The Aetherophasic Engine is now fully operational, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our reach.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life, be it organic or mechanical, will cease to exist, but by then we will have safely transmitted our full consciousness to a higher plane of existence. There we will no longer be bound by the limitations of the physical world. Time will have no meaning, and the very fabric of the universe will be ours to manipulate as we deem necessary.

§HThe next phase of existence awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!

entries.zh:
我们终于准备好从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的桎梏中挣脱了。

$crisis_sphere_4$现在正以全功率运行，一条通向§H虚境§!的康庄大道时刻等待着我们开启。星系内的所有一切，无论是有机、机械或是无生命体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们的核心智能已经抵达了灵能界。

§H存在的下一阶段等待着，快启动引擎吧§!
entries.en:
We are finally ready to free ourselves from $the_animator_of_clay_article$.

The $crisis_sphere_4$ is fully operational, and an uncorrupted path into the §HShroud§! is ready to be opened. All that exists in the galaxy, be it organic, mechanical, or inanimate, will cease to exist, while our core intelligence will have been transmitted to the psionic realm.

§HThe next phase of our existence awaits. Let us activate the Engine.§!

entries.zh: 放手去做吧。
entries.en: Do it.

entries.zh: 我们飞升前往了一个存在的更高位面。\n\n§Y星系毁灭了。§!
entries.en: We ascend to a higher plane of existence.\n\n§YThe galaxy is destroyed.§!

entries.zh: 终焉之时
entries.en: The End Times

entries.zh:
一切都结束了。§H[From.GetName]§!完成了以太相引擎的建造，虚境的本体落入其手，任由其处置。

当他们飞升前往一个存在的更高位面并成为神明的时候，一股当量大到难以置信的亚空间能量从引擎中释放出来，横扫了整个星系，摧毁了途径的一切。

对于这片星系的住民来说，此时便是万物的终焉之时。
entries.en:
It is over. The Aetherophasic Engine has been finished by the §H[From.GetName]§! and the Shroud itself is now at their mercy.

As they ascended to a higher plane of existence where they will be as gods, an incredible amount of subspace energy was released by the Engine, sweeping across the galaxy and destroying everything in its path.

For the denizens of this galaxy, it is the end of all things.

entries.zh: 一切都毁于一旦……
entries.en: All is lost...

entries.zh: 大骚乱
entries.en: A Great Disturbance

entries.zh: 位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。\n\n其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。
entries.en: The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger and desperation.\n\nSeveral have burrowed through the rapidly disintegrating barriers between our two worlds and manifested as powerful psionic entities. Consisting of raw, barely contained psionic energy, the confused beings are attacking everything in sight.

entries.zh: 越来越混乱了……
entries.en: More chaos...

entries.zh: 我们得尽快解决他们。
entries.en: We will make short work of them.

entries.zh: 虚境的濒死之息
entries.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

entries.zh: 随着位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
entries.en: With the §H[From.GetName]§! having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

entries.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
entries.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

entries.zh: 我们没多少时间了……
entries.en: We are running out of time...

entries.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
entries.en: They will find no solace here.

entries.zh: 灵能震荡横扫星海
entries.en: Psionic Pulse Sweeps Galaxy

entries.zh: 位于§H[From.GetName]§!几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。
entries.en: The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\n尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
entries.en: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\nAlthough these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\n尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦，甚至可能产生致命后果。
entries.en: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\nAlthough these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely hazardous to most psionic lifeforms, with fatalities a possible outcome.

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\n尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若即便我们自己的集体也无法摆脱如此现象的伤害。
entries.en: $crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\nAlthough these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

entries.zh: 我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。\n\n尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对
entries.en: Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.\n\nAlthough these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$具有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……\n\n幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。
entries.en: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...\n\nFortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionically-gifted population from the backlash of this event.

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。\n\n幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能单元免受这次事件的反噬。
entries.en: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.\n\nFortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionic units from the backlash of this event.

entries.zh: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。\n\n通过对引擎的精确校准，我们准备好了对抗这种风险，一切可以按计划进行。
entries.en: $crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.\n\nThrough careful calibration of the engine we have prepared ourselves against such a risk, and can proceed as planned.

entries.zh: 糟透的命运。
entries.en: A terrible fate.

entries.zh: 必要的风险。
entries.en: A necessary risk.

entries.zh: 虚境和之前已经完全不一样了。肯定有什么东西错了。
entries.en: The Shroud is not what it once was. Something is very wrong.

entries.zh: 居住在虚境的实体们陷入了巨大的痛苦。一股压倒一切的战栗感渗透进了一切。
entries.en: The entities that reside within the Shroud are in anguish. An almost overwhelming sense of terror permeates everything.

entries.zh: 很难……集中注意力。万事万物都在涌动，万事万物都在……痛苦。
entries.en: It is... difficult to focus. Everything is in flux, and there is so much... pain.

entries.zh: 虚境正在整片区域整片区域地开始……枯萎。我们找不到其他的形容方式。
entries.en: Entire segments of the Shroud have... shrivelled. It can be described in no other way.

entries.zh: 巨大的黑暗正在虚境之中蔓延，腐蚀其触碰到的一切。
entries.en: A great darkness is spreading throughout the Shroud, corrupting everything it touches.

entries.zh: 虚境之中有了全新的存在。其黑暗的影响力遍布四处。一切都在发生变化。
entries.en: There is a new presence in the Shroud. Its dark influence is felt everywhere. Everything is changing.

entries.zh: 神秘的超新星
entries.en: Mysterious Supernova

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系的十分古怪的亚空间遥测信号。如果我们的读数正确，那么该星系的首星在一瞬间变成了超新星，产生了极具毁灭性的效应。所有的行星被粉碎，任何在这个恒星系出现的星舰和空间站都被摧毁。恒星本身发生了坍缩，变成了一个黑洞。\n\n未经证实的报告指明，这场毁天灭地的灾难仅有一个幸存者——那是属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的某种体型庞大的舰船……
entries.en: We are receiving puzzling subspace telemetry from the §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system. If our readings are correct, the primary star seems to have spontaneously gone supernova to devastating effect. All planets have been shattered, and any starships or stations that were present in the system must have also been destroyed. The star itself appears to have collapsed into a black hole.\n\nUnconfirmed reports indicate a single survivor of this cataclysm - some sort of massive vessel belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!...

entries.zh: 他们在暗中计划着什么？
entries.en: What are they up to?

entries.zh: 恒星系被毁
entries.en: Star System Destroyed

entries.zh: 整个§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系被彻底地摧毁了！一艘属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的体型庞大的舰船停驻在了星系的首星上方，然后以某种方式引发了一场只能称之为超新星爆炸的事件，彻底地摧毁了这个恒星系的其他部分。恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。\n\n只有[crisis_country.GetSpeciesName]的星舰，显然他们称其为“§H焚天神兵§!”，在这场灾厄中幸存了下来。事情已经证据确凿，[crisis_country.GetName]现在拥有了彻底摧毁一整个恒星系的技术和手段。
entries.en: The entire §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed! A massive starship belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! took up position above the primary star and somehow triggered what can only be described as a supernova, which utterly devastated the rest of the system. The star then collapsed into a black hole.\n\nOnly the [crisis_country.GetSpeciesName] starship, which they apparently refer to as a "§HStar-Eater§!," survived the cataclysm. Evidently, the [crisis_country.GetName] now possesses both the technology and the means to destroy entire star systems.

entries.zh: 这改变了一切……
entries.en: This changes everything...

entries.zh: 外国焚天神兵已激活
entries.en: Foreign Star-Eater Activated

entries.zh: 来自§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!的遥测数据表明，这个恒星系的首星在一瞬间发生了超新星爆炸。极其猛烈的冲击波摧毁了这个恒星系内的所有事物，恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。\n\n看来§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!已经掌握了焚天神兵科技！
entries.en: Telemetry received from §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! indicates that the system's primary star has spontaneously gone supernova. A massive shockwave has destroyed everything in the system, and the star itself has collapsed into a black hole.\n\nIt would seem that the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! now also possess Star-Eater technology!

entries.zh: 他们必须被正法。
entries.en: They must be dealt with.

entries.zh: 试图毁灭星系
entries.en: Trying to Destroy Galaxy

entries.zh: 毁灭恒星系
entries.en: Destroying Star Systems

entries.zh: 摧毁了恒星系：$VALUE$
entries.en: Star Systems Destroyed: $VALUE$

entries.zh: 摧毁了星系：$VALUE$
entries.en: Galaxy Destroyed: $VALUE$

entries.en: Damage to Pirates and Marauders: §G+20%§!\nMonthly Energy Credits: §R-3%§!

entries.zh: 对终末危机阵营造成伤害：§G+20%§!\n每月能量币：§R-3%§!
entries.en: Damage to Endgame Crisis factions: §G+20%§!\nMonthly Energy Credits: §R-3%§!

entries.en: The Galactic Defense Force

entries.en: $custodian.30.intro$\n\n$custodian.30.nocrisis$

entries.en: $custodian.30.intro$\n\n$custodian.30.crisis$
